Some choices are flexible, although switching programs can involve additional time and extra fees.
有些选择比较灵活，但转换项目可能需要额外时间和费用。
A
The employer offers a mentor, but the advertisement says nothing about protected study time.
雇主提供导师，但广告完全没提有保障的学习时间。
B
Request a written schedule so you can judge whether the training goes beyond ordinary labor.
要求提供书面安排，以便判断培训是否超出了普通劳动的范围。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
Would a university degree always lead to higher earnings than completing a recognized apprenticeship?
大学学位一定比完成受认可的学徒项目带来更高收入吗？
B
No single comparison covers every occupation, region, or person's experience in the job market.
没有一种比较能涵盖所有职业、地区或个人的就业经历。
A
Then I should compare actual course content and likely expenses instead of following a slogan.
那我应该比较实际课程内容和预期费用，而不是相信一句口号。
B
Exactly, and speak to recent graduates whose circumstances resemble your own situation reasonably closely.
没错，也要与处境和你比较相似的近期毕业生交谈。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
I could interview one apprentice and one college student about a typical working week.
我可以各采访一位学徒和大学生，了解他们一周的日常安排。
B
Ask both about supervision, assessment, and opportunities to practice tasks without making costly mistakes.
问双方如何接受指导、考核，以及有没有机会练习而不造成昂贵损失。
A
Their answers would help me identify which environment supports the way I learn best.
他们的回答会帮助我判断哪种环境最适合自己的学习方式。
B
Make a comparison table, then explain which tradeoff you personally consider acceptable and why.
做一张对照表，再说明自己能接受哪项取舍以及原因。

vocab.collocation: whereas the workshop focuses on repairs

practice.speaking: 分别扮演顾问和学生，用同样三个维度比较大学与学徒项目，最后给出有条件的建议。
practice.writing: 写110–130词比较段落，使用 whereas，并解释一种选择对某类学习者的优势和限制。

listening.question: 为什么顾问建议索要书面培训安排？
listening.answer: 为了判断项目是否包含真正的学习培训，而不仅是普通劳动。

practice.review: 录音中找出三个公平比较维度；把 always 或 everyone 之类绝对说法改成限定表述。

title: 线上课程里的隐形门槛
scene: 教师与学生讨论家庭上网条件对作业的影响。
objective: 解释数字学习障碍，提出不降低学习目标的替代安排。
grammar: although 引出让步：Although I have a phone, I cannot edit long documents easily. 承认事实后指出它不能解决的困难。

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
Although I have internet access, my connection often drops during the live evening lessons.
虽然我能上网，但在晚间直播课中经常断线。
B
Would a recording help, or is the main problem downloading large files on your phone?
录播有帮助吗，还是主要问题是手机难以下载大文件？
A
Both are difficult because I share one device with my sister, who studies at night.
两者都很难，因为我和妹妹共用一台设备，她也在晚上学习。
B
Then a deadline extension alone would not solve the underlying problem you are describing.
那么仅仅延长截止时间，无法解决你描述的根本问题。
A
Could the school lend equipment and provide materials that students can use without a connection?
学校能否借出设备，并提供学生可以离线使用的材料？
B
We have a small lending program, although students may not know how to apply.
我们有一个小型借用计划，但学生可能不知道如何申请。
A
The instructions appear inside the learning platform, which some families already struggle to open.
说明放在学习平台里面，而有些家庭连平台都难以打开。
B
That creates a barrier, so we should also explain the process through printed notices.
这形成了障碍，所以也应该通过纸质通知解释申请流程。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
I do not want teachers to assume that missing homework means I am not interested.
我不希望老师以为没交作业就意味着我没有兴趣。
B
They need enough information to offer support without asking you to explain everything publicly.
老师需要足够信息来提供支持，但不该要求你当众说明一切。
A
Perhaps students could privately choose from several common difficulties on a short request form.
也许学生可以私下在简短申请表上勾选几种常见困难。
B
That would make asking for help easier, especially for people who feel embarrassed initially.
这样求助会更容易，尤其对最初感到不好意思的人。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
For tomorrow, can I submit handwritten notes and discuss my answer during the next class?
明天我能先提交手写笔记，下节课再口头说明答案吗？
B
Yes, as long as your notes address the same questions and demonstrate the required understanding.
可以，只要笔记回答同样的问题，并体现要求掌握的内容。
A
I can meet the learning goal if the submission method fits the tools available.
只要提交方式适合我能使用的工具，我就能达到学习目标。
B
We should judge your understanding separately from the quality of your household's internet service.
我们应把你对知识的理解与家庭网络质量分开评价。

practice.speaking: 向老师用90秒解释两个具体上网障碍，并提出保持相同学习目标的替代提交方案。
practice.writing: 写120–140词学校建议，分析一种数字门槛，并用 although 承认已有资源仍存在的限制。

listening.question: 为什么把设备借用说明只放在线上平台不够？
listening.answer: 因为最需要帮助的家庭可能已经无法顺利打开该平台。

practice.review: 检查方案是否区分学习要求与提交形式，并指出一个保护学生隐私的设计。

title: 重返课堂的成年人
scene: 成人学习者与课程协调员设计可持续的学习安排。
objective: 协调工作照护与学习，明确支持条件和进度检查。
grammar: used to 表达过去习惯，be used to 表达目前适应：I used to study at night; I am used to early shifts. 注意后者接名词或动名词。

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
I used to enjoy mathematics, but returning to school after fifteen years feels intimidating.
我过去喜欢数学，但十五年后重返校园让我有些害怕。
B
Our introductory course includes a refresher unit, so you will not need to remember everything.
入门课程含复习单元，所以你不必事先记得所有知识。
A
My biggest concern is childcare because my partner works several evenings during the week.
我最担心照护孩子，因为伴侣每周有几个晚上要工作。
B
We offer two class schedules, and one allows you to complete part of the work remotely.
我们提供两种课表，其中一种允许远程完成部分学习。
A
A flexible schedule helps, although I still need a predictable routine for my family.
灵活课表有帮助，不过我仍需要可预期的家庭作息。
B
Consider a lighter workload initially, especially while you discover how much preparation each class requires.
开始时可以少选些课，尤其是在摸清每节课准备量的阶段。
A
Would taking fewer courses delay my progress so much that returning becomes less worthwhile?
少选课程会不会拖慢进度，让返校变得不那么值得？
B
Steady progress can be more sustainable than an ambitious plan that becomes impossible to maintain.
稳定进步可能比无法维持的宏大计划更可持续。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
I am used to early shifts, so studying before breakfast might fit my energy better.
我习惯早班，所以早餐前学习可能更符合我的精力状态。
B
Try that routine for two weeks and record when you actually finish the planned exercises.
试行两周，并记录实际何时完成计划中的练习。
A
If I repeatedly miss a session, should I simply work harder the following evening?
如果我反复错过学习时间，是不是下一晚加倍努力就行？
B
First identify whether time, fatigue, or unclear instructions caused the difficulty, because each needs different support.
先判断困难来自时间、疲劳还是说明不清，因为支持方式各不相同。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Then my first goal should be completing the foundation unit consistently, rather than racing ahead.
那我的首个目标应该是稳定完成基础单元，而不是急着往前赶。
B
Exactly, and schedule a short review with your instructor before your first assessed assignment.
没错，并在首次计分作业前安排一次与老师的简短复盘。
A
I will bring my practice notes and explain which questions I can solve independently.
我会带上练习笔记，说明哪些题目已经能独立解决。
B
That evidence will help us adjust your plan while recognizing the skills you have already developed.
这些证据能帮助我们调整计划，同时认可你已经掌握的技能。

practice.speaking: 设计并口述两周成人学习计划，包含照护安排、失败后的诊断步骤和一次教师复盘。
practice.writing: 写120–140词学习计划，正确各使用一次 used to 与 be used to，并定义可观察的进步指标。

listening.question: 协调员认为错过学习时间后应先做什么？
listening.answer: 先判断原因是时间不足、疲劳还是指令不清，再选择相应支持。

practice.review: 用三句话分别表达过去习惯、现在适应的安排、未来计划，并确认三种时态或结构正确。

title: 公交线路调整听证会
scene: 居民与规划员讨论公交提速是否会增加步行负担。
objective: 区分平均效率与不同乘客的实际体验。
grammar: by 加动名词说明实现方式：We could reduce delays by changing the signal timing. 方式必须与结果有清晰联系。

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The proposed bus route would reach downtown faster, but our neighborhood would lose two stops.
拟议公交线路能更快抵达市中心，但我们社区会失去两个站点。
B
We removed those stops to reduce delays caused by frequent turns on narrow residential streets.
取消这些站是为了减少公交在狭窄住宅街道频繁转弯造成的延误。
A
For commuters near the main road, that change would probably make the journey more convenient.
对住在主路附近的通勤者来说，这种改变大概会让出行更方便。
B
However, older residents might face a longer walk, especially during hot afternoons or heavy rain.
不过，年长居民可能要走更远，尤其在炎热午后或大雨天。
A
Could you improve reliability by changing the traffic signals instead of removing every neighborhood stop?
能否调整交通信号来提高准点性，而不是取消社区内的所有站点？
B
That option requires coordination with another department, but it deserves examination before the route changes.
那需要与另一部门协调，但在线路调整前值得研究。
A
We should compare total travel time, including the walk from each person's front door.
我们应比较总出行时间，包括从每个人家门口开始的步行。
B
Agreed, because measuring only the time on board can hide an important disadvantage for some riders.
同意，因为只算车上时间会掩盖部分乘客面临的重要不利因素。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
Would a temporary shuttle connect the housing complex with the faster service on the avenue?
临时接驳车能否连接住宅小区与大路上的快速公交？
B
It might, although an extra transfer can create difficulties for passengers carrying groceries or using wheelchairs.
可能可以，但多一次换乘会给提购物袋或使用轮椅的乘客带来困难。
A
Then residents should test the complete journey before officials decide whether the redesign is successful.
那么居民应该测试完整行程，官员再决定调整是否成功。
B
We can invite several groups to record walking time, waiting time, and any obstacles they encounter.
我们可以邀请不同群体记录步行、等待时间和遇到的障碍。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
I would support a faster route if the plan also protects access for less mobile residents.
如果方案也保障行动不便居民的可达性，我会支持更快的线路。
B
That condition gives us a clearer design goal than simply asking whether people support change.
这个条件比只问大家是否支持改变，能给出更清晰的设计目标。
A
Please publish the comparison before the next meeting so residents can examine the different tradeoffs.
请在下次会议前公布比较结果，让居民研究不同取舍。
B
We will include the assumptions behind each option and explain where reliable information remains unavailable.
我们会列出每个选项的假设，并说明哪些方面还缺乏可靠信息。

practice.speaking: 作为听证会居民发言两分钟，承认一项公交调整优点，再用两个群体的旅程说明隐藏成本。
practice.writing: 写120–140词反馈，提出一个改进方式，并说明为什么只测车上时间不足。

listening.question: 为什么临时接驳车未必解决所有问题？
listening.answer: 额外换乘可能让提购物袋或使用轮椅的乘客出行更困难。

practice.review: 画出门到门旅程的三个时间部分，并在发言中全部提及。

title: 自行车道与街边商店
scene: 店主与骑行者讨论装卸货和骑行安全。
objective: 表达利益冲突并提出可验证的空间安排。
grammar: unless 表示除非：Deliveries will block the lane unless loading space is provided. 用它说明方案成功所需的条件。

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The new bike lane passes my bakery, and delivery drivers say they cannot unload safely.
新自行车道经过我的面包店，送货司机说他们无法安全卸货。
B
Cyclists also feel unsafe when trucks block the lane and force them into moving traffic.
卡车挡道迫使骑行者进入机动车流时，他们也觉得不安全。
A
We need a loading zone close enough for workers carrying heavy bags of flour.
我们需要一个足够近的装卸区，方便工人搬运沉重的面粉袋。
B
Could the city reserve a parking space for deliveries during the quiet early morning hours?
市政府能否在清晨较清静时预留一个车位用于送货？
A
That compromise might work, provided suppliers arrive within the agreed window instead of coming unpredictably.
这个折中办法可能可行，前提是供应商按约定时段到达，而不是随意来。
B
A clear sign would explain the restriction, but enforcement would still matter when drivers ignore it.
清晰标志能解释限制，但司机不遵守时仍需要执法。
A
I had assumed that every cyclist wanted to remove all parking from the entire street.
我原以为每个骑行者都想取消整条街所有停车位。
B
Most people I know want a continuous route where they do not need to swerve suddenly.
我认识的大多数人希望路线连续，不必突然转向躲避。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
If loading happens inside the bike lane, a painted boundary will not offer much protection.
如果在自行车道内装卸，一条油漆分界线就提供不了多少保护。
B
Then we should examine whether the loading bay can sit between the sidewalk and a separate entrance.
那应该研究装卸区能否设在人行道与独立入口之间。
A
The sidewalk must stay clear because parents often push strollers past the bakery entrance.
人行道必须保持畅通，因为家长经常推着婴儿车经过店门。
B
Agreed, and we should measure the available space before suggesting a layout that cannot physically fit.
同意，而且提出布局前应测量可用空间，避免方案根本放不下。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
I can ask our suppliers which delivery times they could reliably follow next month.
我可以问供应商，下个月能稳定遵守哪些送货时段。
B
I will ask riders to identify the precise locations where they currently encounter dangerous obstructions.
我会请骑行者标出目前遭遇危险障碍的准确位置。
A
Unless we gather both perspectives, the discussion may become a contest between two misleading stereotypes.
除非收集双方视角，否则讨论可能变成两种误导性刻板印象之间的争执。
B
A workable design should make ordinary deliveries possible while reducing predictable conflicts on the street.
可行的设计应保障正常送货，同时减少街上可预见的冲突。

practice.speaking: 以店主身份提出配送方案，再切换为骑行者指出一个安全漏洞并修正。
practice.writing: 写120–140词街道改造建议，使用 unless，明确装卸时间、位置和执法条件。

listening.question: 为什么只画分界线不能充分保护骑行者？
listening.answer: 如果车辆仍在自行车道内装卸，骑行者还是会被迫进入机动车流。

practice.review: 核对方案是否同时保证骑行连续性、人行道畅通与配送空间，至少给出一项可测量条件。

title: 车站电梯停运的后果
scene: 乘客与站务人员分析无障碍路线信息。
objective: 说明表面可用服务与实际可达路线的区别。
grammar: 关系从句 where 描述地点：The entrance where the elevator is located closes early. 用从句限定具体位置。

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The station website says this entrance is accessible, but the elevator has been out of service.
车站网站说这个入口无障碍，但电梯一直停运。
B
Maintenance is scheduled for tomorrow, and another elevator operates near the north side of the station.
维修安排在明天，车站北侧附近还有另一部电梯运行。
A
The detour takes me across a busy intersection where the pedestrian signal changes very quickly.
绕行需要经过繁忙路口，而那里的行人信号变得很快。
B
I understand that an alternative entrance is not necessarily an equivalent route for every passenger.
我明白，替代入口不一定对所有乘客都意味着同样可行的路线。
A
Could the service alert describe the crossing and show the distance to the working elevator?
服务通知能否说明过街情况，并标出到正常电梯的距离？
B
Yes, the current notice mentions the outage but leaves out those practical details entirely.
可以，目前通知提到了故障，却完全省略这些实际细节。
A
Someone with limited mobility needs enough information to decide whether the journey is still manageable.
行动受限的人需要足够信息，才能判断这趟出行是否仍可应付。
B
We should publish a map that identifies slopes, curb ramps, and places to rest along the way.
我们应公布地图，标明沿途坡道、路缘斜坡和休息地点。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
Please avoid saying the station remains fully accessible when the replacement route creates additional barriers.
当替代路线增加了障碍时，请避免说车站仍然完全无障碍。
B
A more accurate message would explain which facilities work and which passengers may need assistance.
更准确的通知应解释哪些设施可用，以及哪些乘客可能需要协助。
A
Could staff meet passengers at the bus stop while repairs are being carried out?
维修期间，工作人员能否到公交站接应乘客？
B
We can check staffing levels, although any assistance service must have clear hours and contact details.
我们可以查看人手，但任何协助服务都必须写明时间和联系方式。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
I would like to test the revised directions with someone unfamiliar with this neighborhood.
我想请一个不熟悉附近环境的人测试修改后的路线说明。
B
That could reveal unclear landmarks that regular staff members no longer notice during daily work.
这样可能发现含糊地标，而熟悉这里的员工日常工作时已不再注意。
A
Then we can report whether a first-time visitor reaches the platform without asking strangers for help.
之后就能报告首次到访者能否不向陌生人求助而抵达站台。
B
That practical test would tell us more than simply checking whether a map exists online.
这种实际测试比只检查网上有没有地图，更能说明问题。

practice.speaking: 口述一则电梯故障通知，包含替代路线、额外障碍和求助方式，不使用笼统保证。
practice.writing: 写130–150词乘客反馈，用一个 where 从句定位问题，并建议一次可执行的路线测试。

listening.question: 首次到访者测试路线，主要能发现什么？
listening.answer: 发现熟悉车站的员工可能忽略的模糊地标或不清楚的说明。

practice.review: 检查通知能否回答从哪里走、会遇到什么、如何求助；删除无法验证的 fully accessible。

title: 包裹配送挤占路边空间
scene: 物业经理与快递协调员讨论集中配送点。
objective: 分析效率方案对不同使用者带来的不同影响。
grammar: instead of 加名词或动名词表达替代：Drivers could use a hub instead of stopping outside every building. 不接完整限定句。

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
Delivery vans stop outside our apartment building all afternoon, making the entrance difficult to use.
送货车整个下午都停在公寓楼外，让入口很难通行。
B
A shared parcel hub could reduce the number of vehicles stopping outside each individual building.
共享包裹站可以减少在每栋楼外分别停车的车辆数量。
A
That sounds efficient, but residents would need to collect their packages from another location.
听起来高效，但居民得去另一个地点取包裹。
B
We could place secure lockers beside the grocery store, where many residents already shop regularly.
可以把安全储物柜设在杂货店旁，许多居民本来就经常去那里购物。
A
Some packages are bulky, and carrying them home might be difficult for people without cars.
有些包裹体积大，没有车的人可能很难把它们搬回家。
B
Then doorstep delivery should remain available for oversized items and residents who need additional assistance.
那么大件物品和需要额外帮助的居民仍应保留送货上门服务。
A
Would those exceptions make the system too complicated for drivers following a busy delivery schedule?
这些例外会不会让系统对忙着送货的司机来说太复杂？
B
Clear labels and predictable collection times could help, although the procedure would need careful testing.
清晰标签和固定取件时间可能有帮助，但流程需要认真测试。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
Instead of judging success by fewer vans, we should include the extra journeys residents make.
不能只看货车减少多少，还应计算居民额外出行。
B
Exactly, because shifting work from a company to customers does not automatically reduce the total burden.
没错，把工作从公司转给客户，并不会自动降低总负担。
A
We also need a plan for parcels that remain uncollected after several working days.
对于几个工作日后仍未领取的包裹，我们也需要处理方案。
B
A reminder system could help, but it should not assume every resident owns a smartphone.
提醒系统可能有用，但不能假设每位居民都有智能手机。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
I will interview residents about typical package sizes and how easily they can reach the store.
我会采访居民，了解常见包裹大小和前往商店是否方便。
B
I will estimate the space required and check whether evening collections would disturb nearby apartments.
我会估计所需空间，并检查晚间取件会不会打扰附近住户。
A
If the pilot creates fewer blocked entrances without adding unreasonable trips, we could consider expanding it.
如果试点既减少入口堵塞，也没有增加不合理的行程，就可以考虑扩大。
B
Let us agree on those conditions before installing equipment that might be expensive to relocate.
先就这些条件达成一致，再安装以后搬迁可能很贵的设备。

practice.speaking: 向物业会议解释集中取件的两项好处与两项代价，提出大件包裹例外安排。
practice.writing: 写130–150词试点说明，使用 instead of，并定义同时衡量公司效率和住户负担的指标。

listening.question: 为什么仅统计送货车减少的数量还不够？
listening.answer: 因为居民可能为取件增加额外出行，总体负担未必降低。

practice.review: 检查是否计算了居民的额外路程、处理了无智能手机用户，并写明试点扩大条件。

title: 乡镇预约巴士的公平性
scene: 乡镇居民与交通协调员讨论预约制公共交通。
objective: 在需求稀疏条件下讨论便利、公平与资源使用。
grammar: as long as 表示前提：The service works as long as booking is simple. 它强调方案成立的必要条件。

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
Our village bus runs almost empty at noon, yet it is crowded after the clinic closes.
村里的公交中午几乎空着，可诊所关门后又挤满了人。
B
A demand-responsive service could adjust its route according to the trips passengers book in advance.
需求响应式服务可以根据乘客预先预约的行程调整路线。
A
Would people need an app, or could they make a reservation by calling a local number?
人们需要应用程序，还是可以拨打本地电话预约？
B
Telephone booking would be essential because some regular passengers do not use online services confidently.
电话预约必不可少，因为一些常客不熟悉线上服务。
A
I am concerned about spontaneity, since medical appointments sometimes finish much later than expected.
我担心临时变动，因为就诊有时会比预期晚很多结束。
B
The timetable could include a few fixed departures while leaving other trips available through reservations.
时刻表可以保留几个固定班次，其他行程通过预约安排。
A
That hybrid system might balance flexibility with the reassurance of knowing a bus will arrive.
这种混合制可能兼顾灵活性与知道公交必定到来的安心感。
B
We would need enough capacity to handle busy periods without rejecting passengers at short notice.
我们需要足够运力应付高峰，避免临时拒绝乘客。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
As long as bookings remain simple, I can see why this could serve scattered households better.
只要预约保持简单，我能理解它为何能更好服务分散的住户。
B
However, a cheaper operating budget would not prove that every community now receives better transport.
不过，运营预算降低并不能证明每个社区都获得了更好的交通服务。
A
Could we track refused bookings and compare waiting times across the villages along the route?
能否记录被拒预约，并比较沿线各村的等待时间？
B
Yes, and we should ask whether passengers stopped traveling because the new process felt too difficult.
可以，还应询问乘客是否因为新流程太难而放弃出行。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Otherwise, a fall in requests might be mistaken for a fall in people's actual needs.
否则，预约量下降可能被误认为真实需求下降。
B
That distinction matters when planners decide whether the service deserves funding in the following year.
规划者决定来年是否继续资助时，这个区别很重要。
A
Let us preserve the clinic departure during the trial and explain how other rides can be booked.
试行期间保留诊所关门后的班次，并解释如何预约其他行程。
B
Then residents can evaluate a real service change with safeguards instead of facing an unexplained replacement.
这样居民可以评估有保障的实际服务调整，而不是面对不明所以的替换。

practice.speaking: 用两分钟解释预约巴士的工作方式，处理一位晚结束就诊乘客的情境，并提出安全保障。
practice.writing: 写130–150词乡镇交通评价，区分预约数量与真实需求，使用 as long as 表明支持条件。

listening.question: 预约数量下降为什么不一定表示交通需求降低？
listening.answer: 人们可能因为预约流程困难而不再申请，并非不需要出行。

practice.review: 准确复述固定班次与预约班次的分工，并提出两项能发现隐藏需求的数据。

title: 排班软件如何理解生活
scene: 餐厅员工与经理讨论自动排班的限制。
objective: 解释优化指标遗漏的现实条件，提出人工复核流程。
grammar: 过去分词被动结构：The schedule is generated automatically. 被动句突出流程结果，再用 by 说明责任方。

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The new scheduling software assigned me closing shifts before two early starts next week.
新的排班软件下周给我安排了两次晚班接早班。
B
It is designed to match staffing levels with demand, but it may overlook recovery time.
它旨在让人手匹配需求，但可能忽略休息恢复时间。
A
My availability form lists those hours as possible, although working them together would be exhausting.
我的可工作时间表列了那些时段，但连着上会非常累。
B
Then the system needs a constraint covering the minimum break between two consecutive shifts.
那么系统需要一项约束，规定连续两班之间的最短休息时间。
A
Could workers flag a problem before the schedule becomes final and childcare arrangements are made?
员工能否在排班定稿、安排孩子照护之前标出问题？
B
A review window would help, provided managers actually respond instead of approving every automated recommendation.
留出复核时间有帮助，前提是经理确实回应，而不是照单接受自动建议。
A
I also wonder whether employees who report fewer restrictions receive all the least desirable shifts.
我还想知道，限制较少的员工是否被分配了所有最不受欢迎的班次。
B
We should examine the distribution over several weeks, since a single schedule may hide that pattern.
应该查看几周的分配情况，因为单周课表可能掩盖这种规律。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
The schedule is generated automatically, but the company still chooses what the software should prioritize.
排班虽然自动生成，但仍是公司决定软件应该优先考虑什么。
B
Exactly, and those choices need explanation when the system affects people's sleep and family responsibilities.
没错，当系统影响睡眠和家庭责任时，这些选择需要得到解释。
A
Would publishing the basic rules make the process clearer without revealing everyone's personal circumstances?
公布基本规则能否让流程更清楚，同时不暴露大家的私人情况？
B
Yes, we can describe the criteria while keeping individual requests visible only to authorized staff.
可以说明标准，同时仅让获授权员工查看个人申请。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
For next month, let us test a minimum rest rule and allow corrections before Friday.
下个月先测试最低休息时长规则，并允许周五前修改。
B
We should record last-minute changes as well as staff complaints to see whether the process improves.
应该记录临时改班和员工投诉，以判断流程是否改善。
A
If the schedule looks efficient but creates frequent absences, the original measure of success is incomplete.
如果排班看似高效却造成频繁缺勤，原来的成功指标就是不完整的。
B
Our goal should include reliable coverage and a workload employees can sustain throughout the month.
目标应同时包含稳定人手覆盖，以及员工整个月都能承受的工作量。

practice.speaking: 扮演员工，解释连续晚早班的问题；再扮演经理提出两条软件约束和一个复核步骤。
practice.writing: 写130–150词内部备忘录，说明自动排班为何仍需人工负责，至少使用一个被动句。

listening.question: 为什么查看单周排班可能无法发现分配不公平？
listening.answer: 不受欢迎班次是否长期集中于某些员工，需要跨几周观察才看得出来。

practice.review: 用两项指标评估排班，其中一项必须反映员工体验，并明确谁有权修改结果。

title: 招聘筛选中的遗漏
scene: 招聘专员与部门主管审查简历筛选工具。
objective: 识别筛选规则的代理指标与实际能力之间的差距。
grammar: might have 加过去分词表达对过去的可能推测：The filter might have missed her experience. 推测不等于事实断言。

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The screening tool rejected this applicant, although her portfolio includes several projects relevant to our vacancy.
筛选工具拒绝了这位申请者，但她的作品集中有几个与空缺职位相关的项目。
B
Perhaps the filter expected a degree title that her training certificate did not contain.
可能过滤器要求某个学位名称，而她的培训证书没有这个名称。
A
That requirement was intended to identify technical knowledge, not exclude everyone who learned outside college.
这项要求原本用于识别技术知识，而不是排除所有非大学途径学习的人。
B
Then the credential may be a weak substitute for the ability we actually need.
那么资格证书可能不是我们真正需要的能力的可靠替代指标。
A
Could we review a sample of rejected applications before relying on the tool for another vacancy?
在下次招聘继续依赖该工具前，能否抽查一批被拒申请？
B
Yes, but reviewers should use consistent criteria so personal preferences do not simply replace the algorithm.
可以，但评审应使用一致标准，避免只是用个人偏好替换算法。
A
A short work sample could demonstrate whether candidates can solve the problems this role involves.
简短的工作样本能展示候选人是否能解决这个岗位涉及的问题。
B
We must keep the task reasonable, because unpaid assessments can discourage applicants with limited spare time.
任务必须适度，因为无偿测评可能劝退空闲时间有限的申请者。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
The filter might have missed her experience because she described the same skills using different terms.
过滤器可能因她用不同术语描述相同技能，而遗漏了她的经验。
B
That is plausible, although we should inspect the actual rejection reason before drawing that conclusion.
这有可能，但应检查实际拒绝原因，再得出结论。
A
Would it help to tell applicants which capabilities matter and how their evidence will be assessed?
告诉申请者看重哪些能力、如何评估证据，会有帮助吗？
B
Clear guidance could improve applications and make questionable decisions easier to challenge through a documented process.
清晰指南能改善申请，也让有争议的决定更容易通过记录在案的流程申诉。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
I will compare the rejected portfolio against the job requirements without looking at the applicant's school.
我会把被拒作品集与岗位要求对照，而不先看申请者学校。
B
I will check whether the software treated optional qualifications as compulsory during the initial screening.
我会检查软件在初筛时是否把可选资格当成了必需条件。
A
After that, we can decide whether the problem lies in the settings or the recruitment policy.
之后我们就能判断，问题出在软件设置还是招聘政策。
B
And we should correct affected decisions, rather than considering a technical explanation the end of the review.
还应纠正受影响的决定，而不是把技术解释当作复核终点。

practice.speaking: 讨论一名无大学学位但有作品集的申请者，提出两种可能被误拒原因，并说明如何核实。
practice.writing: 写130–150词招聘建议，使用 might have 区分推测与已确认事实，安排具体复核步骤。

listening.question: 为什么即使人工复核，也仍然需要一致标准？
listening.answer: 避免评审用个人偏好取代算法，而没有真正改善公平性与准确性。

practice.review: 把发言中的事实和推测分别标色；每个推测后至少跟一个验证办法。

title: 机器上线前的转岗培训
scene: 工厂员工与培训负责人讨论自动化后的技能安排。
objective: 将抽象培训承诺转化为有时间和考核的实施方案。
grammar: by the time 引导时间从句：By the time the machine arrives, staff will have completed training. 主句用将来完成时强调此前完成。

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The packing machine arrives in eight weeks, but nobody has explained which duties will change.
包装机八周后到货，可没人解释哪些职责会改变。
B
The transition plan includes retraining, although the current document does not specify who receives it.
过渡计划包含再培训，但目前文件没有明确谁能参加。
A
I would like to learn maintenance, since inspecting faults seems more useful than simply watching boxes.
我想学维护，因为检查故障似乎比只盯着箱子更有用。
B
That role requires basic diagnostic skills, and the course should include supervised practice on real equipment.
那个岗位需要基本诊断技能，课程应包括在指导下操作真实设备。
A
Will training happen during paid hours, or are workers expected to study after their shifts?
培训是在带薪时间进行，还是希望员工下班后学习？
B
Protected learning time needs to be part of the budget, otherwise participation may depend on personal circumstances.
有保障的学习时间必须纳入预算，否则参与情况可能取决于个人处境。
A
We also need a pathway for employees who find written technical instructions difficult to follow.
对于难以理解书面技术说明的员工，也需要提供学习路径。
B
Demonstrations and guided practice can support them while preserving the same safety and performance standards.
演示和指导练习可以支持他们，同时保持同样的安全与表现标准。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
By the time the machine arrives, each operator should have completed an assessed practice session.
机器到货时，每位操作员都应已经完成一次经过考核的练习。
B
That is a clearer milestone than saying everyone will receive support at some unspecified future date.
这比说未来某个不确定日期大家都会得到支持，有更清晰的阶段目标。
A
What happens if someone needs additional practice before handling the machine without direct supervision?
如果有人独立操作前需要更多练习，应该怎么办？
B
The plan should allow further coaching rather than treating the first assessment as a final judgment.
计划应允许进一步指导，而不是把第一次考核当作最终判断。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Could we meet with the equipment supplier to identify the tasks that will genuinely require new skills?
能否与设备供应商见面，找出真正需要新技能的任务？
B
Yes, then we can connect each training module to a responsibility workers will actually hold.
可以，然后把每个培训模块对应到员工实际承担的职责。
A
That would help us distinguish useful retraining from a certificate that has little practical value.
这样能区分有用的再培训与实际价值不大的证书。
B
We will publish the timetable, paid hours, assessment process, and options for anyone needing extra support.
我们会公布时间表、带薪时数、考核流程和额外支持选项。

practice.speaking: 介绍八周转岗培训计划，按设备到货前后安排时间，并说明首次考核未通过者的支持。
practice.writing: 写140–160词培训方案，使用 by the time 和将来完成时，列出两项可检验里程碑。

listening.question: 员工为什么认为维护培训比盯包装箱更有价值？
listening.answer: 维护培训能培养检查故障等新职责真正需要的技能，而非只是被动看守。

practice.review: 检查方案是否说明谁参加、是否带薪、如何考核、补练机会；准确说出到货前完成的两项任务。

title: 机器人警报为何被忽视
scene: 仓库主管与安全代表分析频繁误报。
objective: 解释人的行为与系统设计之间的因果链。
grammar: so many 加可数名词加 that 表示数量导致结果：There are so many alerts that workers stop noticing them. 注意 many 与 much 的搭配。

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The warehouse robot stopped again, and several workers walked around it without checking the warning light.
仓库机器人又停了，几名员工没看警示灯就绕了过去。
B
They say the sensor triggers repeatedly even when nothing is actually blocking the marked safety zone.
他们说即使标出的安全区没有东西阻挡，传感器也会反复触发。
A
So many false alarms occur that people are beginning to treat every warning as harmless.
误报多到人们开始把每次警告都当成无害提示。
B
That response is dangerous, but blaming individual workers would leave the equipment problem unresolved.
这种反应很危险，但只责怪员工会让设备问题继续存在。
A
Could technicians inspect the sensor alignment before managers send another reminder about following instructions?
在经理再次提醒大家遵守说明之前，技术人员能否先检查传感器对准情况？
B
Yes, and we should record when the alerts occur to identify environmental factors such as reflections.
可以，还应记录警报发生时间，找出反光等环境因素。
A
Production targets also create pressure because every interruption makes the team appear slower than expected.
生产目标也带来压力，因为每次中断都会显得团队速度不达预期。
B
Then supervisors must make clear that reporting a genuine hazard will not count against an employee.
那么主管必须明确，报告真实危险不会导致员工受到负面评价。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
Would separating urgent safety signals from routine status messages help workers decide how to respond?
把紧急安全信号与常规状态消息区分，能否帮助员工决定怎样应对？
B
Possibly, although any redesign needs testing so the new signals are understood under ordinary working conditions.
可能可以，但任何重新设计都需要测试，确保正常工作时能理解新信号。
A
We should include temporary staff, who may not recognize the meanings that experienced workers take for granted.
应该纳入临时员工，因为他们可能不知道老员工习以为常的信号含义。
B
And training should explain the correct action, rather than merely asking people to memorize different colors.
培训还应解释正确动作，而不是只要求记住不同颜色。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
For today's shift, let us pause that section and request an inspection from the maintenance team.
今天这个班次先暂停那一区域，并请维护团队检查。
B
Meanwhile, we can review the recent alerts without assuming that every interruption was a false alarm.
同时检查近期警报，但不能假定每次中断都是误报。
A
After the repair, we will compare alert frequency and observe whether staff respond appropriately during a drill.
修复后比较警报频率，并在演练中观察员工反应是否正确。
B
That combines a technical check with evidence about how the system works for the people using it.
这样既检查技术，也收集系统对实际使用者是否有效的证据。

practice.speaking: 复盘机器人误报事件，按设备、绩效压力、人员行为三层解释，最后给出当天行动。
practice.writing: 写140–160词安全简报，使用 so many...that，并区分立即控制措施与后续验证。

listening.question: 为什么仅提醒员工遵守警报还不足以解决问题？
listening.answer: 频繁误报和生产压力仍未处理，员工忽视警报的条件依然存在。

practice.review: 列出完整因果链，确保没有把所有责任归给个人；提出一个技术指标和一个行为指标。

title: 远程团队的自动会议纪要
scene: 项目成员与负责人核对自动摘要中的错误。
objective: 区分工具建议、实际决策与个人责任。
grammar: reported speech 转述会议意见：She said that the deadline might change. 转述时保留原话中的不确定性，不能把 might 改成 will。

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The automatic meeting summary says I agreed to deliver the prototype by next Monday.
自动会议摘要说我同意下周一交付原型。
B
I remember you describing that date as possible, provided the supplier sends the missing components.
我记得你说那一天有可能，前提是供应商寄来缺失零件。
A
The transcript includes that condition, but the summary seems to have removed it completely.
逐字稿包含这个条件，但摘要似乎把它完全删掉了。
B
Then we should correct the action item before another team relies on an inaccurate commitment.
那应该在另一个团队依赖这项错误承诺前，更正待办事项。
A
Could every task owner confirm their assignment instead of accepting the generated notes without review?
能否让每位任务负责人确认分工，而不是不经检查就接受生成的笔记？
B
That would create accountability, although the confirmation process should remain quick enough for everyday use.
这样能明确责任，不过确认流程也应足够快捷，适合日常使用。
A
I also noticed that a tentative suggestion about reducing tests appears as an approved decision.
我还注意到，一个减少测试的试探性建议，被写成已经批准的决定。
B
We need separate labels for proposals, decisions, and unresolved questions so readers can distinguish their status.
应分别标注提案、决定和未决问题，让读者区分状态。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
The summary is useful for locating topics, but it should not become the only record of agreement.
摘要有助于查找主题，但不应成为协议的唯一记录。
B
Especially when a small word like might changes the level of certainty in a person's statement.
尤其像 might 这样的小词，会改变一句话的确定程度。
A
Would sharing the recording link beside disputed items make it easier to verify what was said?
在有争议事项旁附录音链接，会不会更容易核实原话？
B
Yes, as long as access respects the permissions agreed when the meeting was originally recorded.
可以，只要访问符合当时录制会议所约定的权限。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
I will rewrite my task to say delivery depends on receiving the components by Thursday.
我会改写任务，说明交付取决于周四前收到零件。
B
I will ask the testing lead to clarify whether the proposed reduction was accepted or merely discussed.
我会请测试负责人澄清，减少测试是获得同意了，还是仅仅讨论过。
A
At our next meeting, we could review decisions aloud before allowing the software to generate a summary.
下次会议可以先口头确认决定，再让软件生成摘要。
B
That simple habit would give both people and the tool a clearer record to work from.
这个简单习惯能让人和工具都有更清晰的原始记录作为依据。

practice.speaking: 复述会议中一个有条件的承诺和一个暂定建议，然后示范如何纠正自动摘要的过度确定表达。
practice.writing: 写140–160词团队操作说明，规定提案、决策、待办的确认方式，并保留转述中的条件。

listening.question: 自动摘要对原型交付承诺漏掉了什么条件？
listening.answer: 交付取决于供应商是否及时寄来零件；更正后明确要在周四前收到。

practice.review: 对照自录原话与摘要，确认 might、if、provided 等条件或保留语没有被删除。

title: 追溯新闻标题的原始来源
scene: 编辑与实习记者核查有关学习方法的报道。
objective: 追踪二手报道到原始研究，区分发现与标题推断。
grammar: appear to 加动词表达有依据的谨慎判断：The results appear to support a narrower claim. 避免把初步证据写成已经证明。

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
This headline claims that handwritten notes always improve learning, but the linked article sounds considerably more cautious.
这个标题声称手写笔记总能改善学习，但链接文章的语气谨慎得多。
B
Before repeating it, we should trace the claim to the original study and examine what was actually measured.
转载前应追溯原始研究，查看究竟测量了什么。
A
The participants answered questions immediately after a short lecture, so the test did not measure long-term retention.
参与者在短讲座后立即答题，因此测试没有测量长期记忆保持。
B
That limitation matters because readers may interpret improved performance as a lasting benefit across every learning situation.
这个限制很重要，因为读者可能把表现改善理解为所有学习情境中的长期收益。
A
The article also mentions a small sample, although that detail disappears from the social media version.
文章还提到样本较小，但社交媒体版本删除了这个细节。
B
A small study can still be informative, provided its findings are presented with appropriate uncertainty and context.
小研究仍有参考价值，前提是呈现结果时保留适当的不确定性和背景。
A
Would it be accurate to say the findings appear to favor handwriting under the specific conditions tested?
说结果似乎在已测试的特定条件下支持手写，会准确吗？
B
Yes, and identify the outcome explicitly instead of allowing a broad word like learning to conceal the measurement.
准确，还要明确结果指标，别让学习这种宽泛词语掩盖具体测量内容。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
We should also check whether the groups received equal preparation time before the lecture began.
还应检查两组在讲座前是否获得同样的准备时间。
B
Otherwise, a difference in preparation could offer an alternative explanation for the difference in their scores.
否则准备程度的差异可能成为成绩差异的另一种解释。
A
The press release does not answer that question, so I will consult the methods section directly.
新闻稿没有回答，所以我要直接查研究方法部分。
B
Good, because a summary written to attract attention may omit details necessary for evaluating the underlying evidence.
很好，因为为吸引注意而写的摘要，可能省略评估证据所需的细节。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Our revised headline could describe a short classroom experiment rather than announcing a universal rule for students.
修改后的标题可以描述短时课堂实验，而不是宣布适用于所有学生的规则。
B
Then use the opening paragraph to state the result, the setting, and the main boundary on interpretation.
再在首段写明结果、情境和解释结果的主要边界。
A
That may sound less dramatic, but readers will know what the study does and does not establish.
这样也许不够戏剧化，但读者能知道研究确立了什么、没确立什么。
B
Clear qualification strengthens a report when it helps the audience match their confidence to the available evidence.
清楚的限定让读者信心与证据相称时，会加强报道的质量。

practice.speaking: 用两分钟把夸大研究标题改写为谨慎报道，交代研究对象、测量结果和两项限制。
practice.writing: 写140–160词新闻核查笔记，追踪原始来源并使用 appear to，说明尚需核实的一个方法问题。

listening.question: 为什么立即进行的课堂测验不能证明长期学习收益？
listening.answer: 它只测量讲座后短期表现，没有测量知识经过较长时间后能否保持。

practice.review: 对自己改写的标题逐词检查，把每个结论对应到研究测量指标，删除无法支持的 always。

title: 暴雨照片是真是假
scene: 两位社区志愿者核查群聊里的灾情图片。
objective: 分开判断图像真实性、拍摄时间和地点。
grammar: even if 引出假设让步：Even if the photo is real, its caption may be wrong. 条件成立也不自动支持另一结论。

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
A dramatic photograph of a flooded street is circulating with a caption naming our town this morning.
一张街道淹水的照片正在流传，配文称是我们镇今天早上的情况。
B
The image may be authentic, but we still need to verify when and where it was taken.
照片可能是真的，但仍需核实拍摄时间和地点。
A
I found an earlier upload showing the same storefront, which suggests the current caption may be misleading.
我发现较早上传的照片有同样店面，说明现在的配文可能误导。
B
Check whether that earlier post provides a location, and compare visible landmarks with an independent map.
看看早期帖子是否提供地点，并用独立地图对照可见地标。
A
The street signs are blurry, although the bridge in the background has a fairly distinctive shape.
路牌模糊，不过背景中的桥形状相当独特。
B
We can use that clue, but visual similarity alone should not be treated as conclusive proof.
可以利用线索，但不能仅凭视觉相似就认定为确凿证明。
A
Someone has already shared the picture as evidence that the evacuation route is completely blocked.
已经有人把照片当作撤离路线完全受阻的证据转发了。
B
Then our priority should be checking current official travel notices before spreading an unverified warning any further.
那么首先应查看最新官方交通通知，再决定是否继续传播未经核实的警报。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
Even if the photo is real, using an old image to describe current conditions would still misinform readers.
即使照片真实，用旧图描述当前情况仍会误导读者。
B
Exactly, authenticity and relevance are separate questions, and both matter when information may influence immediate decisions.
没错，真实性与相关性是不同问题，而信息会影响即时决定时两者都重要。
A
Should we tell the group that the photograph is fake before finishing the location check?
在完成地点核查前，要不要告诉群里这照片是假的？
B
No, explain the confirmed mismatch and identify what remains unknown, rather than replacing one unsupported claim with another.
不要，应解释已经确认的不符之处和未知项，而不是用另一个无依据说法替代。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
I can say the image appeared online earlier and therefore does not establish today's local road conditions.
我可以说图片此前已在网上出现，因此不能证明今天本地道路状况。
B
Add a link to the current transport notice so people have a practical source for planning their journeys.
附上最新交通通知链接，让人们有实际可用的出行参考来源。
A
Once the original location is verified, we can update the message without deleting the earlier explanation.
核实原始地点后可以更新消息，同时保留先前解释。
B
That preserves a transparent correction trail and helps others understand how the assessment changed with new evidence.
这样保留透明的更正过程，让别人理解判断如何随新证据变化。

practice.speaking: 录制90秒群聊核查说明，区分照片真假、时间、地点，并明确目前已知与未知。
practice.writing: 写140–160词核查报告，使用 even if，解释旧照片为何不能证明当前道路情况。

listening.question: 为什么不能直接把这张照片称为假照片？
listening.answer: 图片本身可能真实，已知问题是配文时间或地点不符，还需完成核查。

practice.review: 在陈述中分别标出真实性、时间、地点三项判断，并为每项列出所需证据。

title: 网络投票代表谁
scene: 社区记者与居民讨论网上民意调查。
objective: 识别自愿参与样本的局限，准确限定结论。
grammar: those who 作为名词性结构限定群体：The poll describes those who chose to respond. 不把回应者等同于全体居民。

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The neighborhood website says most residents oppose the park redesign, based on a poll posted last weekend.
社区网站根据上周末投票，声称多数居民反对公园改造。
B
Was the questionnaire sent to a representative sample, or could anyone visiting the page choose to respond?
问卷发给了代表性样本，还是任何访问页面的人都能自愿填写？
A
Participation was voluntary, and the link appeared mainly in a group already campaigning against the redesign.
参与是自愿的，而且链接主要出现在一个已经反对改造的群组里。
B
Then the responses may reveal strong concerns without accurately estimating how common those concerns are across the neighborhood.
那么回答可以揭示强烈担忧，却未必准确估计这些担忧在社区中的普遍程度。
A
The website lists many submissions, which makes the result look more reliable than a smaller interview project.
网站列出大量提交记录，让结果看起来比小型访谈项目可靠。
B
A larger biased sample does not automatically correct the selection process that produced the bias initially.
更大的偏差样本不会自动纠正最初产生偏差的选择过程。
A
Could repeated voting also influence the totals if the form does not require a unique response?
如果表格没有限制每人一次，重复投票是否也会影响总数？
B
Possibly, although we should inspect the settings before claiming that duplicate entries actually occurred in this poll.
可能，但声称本次存在重复填写前，应该检查设置。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
A fair summary might say most respondents opposed the plan, while noting how participants were recruited.
公允摘要可以说多数受访者反对，并交代参与者如何招募。
B
Yes, that accurately describes those who answered without extending the conclusion to people who never saw the questionnaire.
对，这准确描述了回答者，而不把结论延伸到没见过问卷的人。
A
What could planners do if they need a broader picture before making the final decision?
如果规划者要在最终决定前了解更广泛意见，可以怎么做？
B
Use several recruitment channels, contact households directly, and make participation possible for residents who are rarely online.
使用多种招募渠道、直接联系住户，并让很少上网的居民也能参与。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
They should still analyze the existing comments because the complaints might identify genuine problems in the design.
仍应分析现有评论，因为投诉可能指出设计中的真实问题。
B
Absolutely, representativeness affects estimates of prevalence, but it does not make every individual observation worthless.
当然，代表性影响普遍程度估计，却不意味着每条个人观察都毫无价值。
A
I will separate what the poll tells us about concerns from what it cannot establish about overall support.
我会区分投票揭示了哪些担忧，以及它无法说明怎样的整体支持度。
B
That distinction allows a useful discussion without either exaggerating the numbers or dismissing the residents who participated.
这种区分能让讨论有用，既不夸大数字，也不忽视参与居民。

practice.speaking: 向社区会议用两分钟解释大量网上投票为何不自动代表全体居民，同时保留评论的实际价值。
practice.writing: 写150–170词调查结果解读，分别描述参与者、招募方法和可支持的结论，并建议改进抽样。

listening.question: 样本不具代表性，是否意味着居民所有具体评论都没有价值？
listening.answer: 不是。它限制对意见普遍程度的估计，但具体评论仍可能发现真实设计问题。

practice.review: 把 most residents 改为符合证据的群体名称，并提出三种覆盖不同居民的招募方式。

title: 测评视频里的商业关系
scene: 消费者与媒体研究学生讨论一则耳机测评。
objective: 评估利益关系而不把披露自动等同于内容虚假。
grammar: the extent to which 表示程度：Consider the extent to which sponsorship shaped the comparison. 用来分析影响大小而非简单二分。

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
This headphone review seems detailed, but the creator received the product free and included a purchase link.
这个耳机测评看起来详细，但创作者免费获得产品，还附了购买链接。
B
Those disclosures identify a commercial relationship, although they do not establish that every statement in the review is false.
这些披露说明商业关系，但不能证明测评每句话都虚假。
A
The comparison emphasizes battery life while barely mentioning comfort, which matters more for my daily use.
比较侧重续航，却几乎没谈舒适度，而舒适度对我的日常使用更重要。
B
Then examine the evaluation criteria before deciding whether the recommendation addresses your particular needs and priorities.
那么先检查评价标准，再判断推荐是否符合你的具体需求和优先项。
A
Could the commission encourage the reviewer to highlight strengths while giving less attention to inconvenient weaknesses?
佣金是否会促使测评者突出优点，却较少关注不方便提及的缺点？
B
It creates an incentive worth considering, but we would need further evidence to claim deliberate deception.
它形成值得考虑的激励，但要声称故意欺骗还需要更多证据。
A
I found another review that describes its testing method and includes products from several competing brands.
我找到另一份测评，说明了测试方法，还纳入几个竞争品牌。
B
That transparency helps, especially if the same conditions were used consistently across all the items being compared.
这种透明度有帮助，尤其是对全部比较产品都一致采用相同条件时。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
We should consider the extent to which sponsorship shaped the selection of products, questions, and conclusions.
应考虑赞助在多大程度上影响了产品选择、问题设置与结论。
B
Exactly, influence can appear through omissions even when the individual facts that are presented remain technically accurate.
没错，即使呈现的单项事实技术上准确，影响也可能通过遗漏体现。
A
Would reading a few ordinary customer comments give me a more balanced picture of long-term comfort?
读一些普通顾客评论，会不会让我更全面了解长期佩戴舒适度？
B
It could add useful experiences, although anonymous comments may be selective, unverified, or based on very different expectations.
可能补充有用体验，但匿名评论也可能有选择性、未经核实，或基于不同期待。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Then I should combine transparent testing with reports about the features that matter for my use.
那我应结合透明测试，以及关注我实际需要功能的体验报告。
B
And keep your conclusion proportionate, since no collection of reviews can guarantee how comfortable a product will feel to you.
结论也要适度，因为再多测评也无法保证你自己的佩戴感受。
A
I can explain why one model looks promising without treating the creator's endorsement as independent proof.
我可以解释为何某款看起来不错，而不把创作者背书当作独立证明。
B
That approach evaluates the evidence and the commercial context while leaving room for uncertainty about personal experience.
这种方法同时评价证据和商业背景，并保留个人体验的不确定性。

practice.speaking: 评述一则假想赞助测评，区分已披露事实、可能影响与需要进一步证明的指控。
practice.writing: 写150–170词媒体分析，使用 the extent to which，讨论商业关系如何影响选题和遗漏。

listening.question: 为什么利益披露不能直接证明整篇测评虚假？
listening.answer: 披露说明存在商业关系和可能激励，但具体事实是否虚假仍需证据核查。

practice.review: 检查是否同时评估方法、遗漏和自身需求，并删除无证据的故意欺骗指控。

title: 错误报道如何公开更正
scene: 新闻编辑与记者拟定一则公开更正。
objective: 清楚纠错并追踪错误对下游结论的影响。
grammar: having 加过去分词表示先发生的动作：Having checked the record, we corrected the date. 分词短语的逻辑主语须与主句一致。

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
Our article said the community center had closed permanently, but the closure was only temporary during repairs.
我们的报道说社区中心永久关闭，其实只是维修期间暂时关闭。
B
We need a correction that states the error clearly and explains the accurate position without burying the change.
需要一则更正，明确指出错误并解释准确信息，不能把变化藏起来。
A
I have already replaced the sentence, although readers who saw the original version may never revisit the page.
我已替换那句话，不过看过原版的读者可能不会重看页面。
B
Then update the channels where we distributed the claim, including the newsletter and the social media post.
那么还要更新传播过该说法的渠道，包括通讯邮件和社交媒体帖子。
A
Should the notice explain that I misunderstood an ambiguous statement from the building manager during our interview?
通知应不应该解释，我误解了采访中楼宇经理的一句模糊表述？
B
Describe the verification failure briefly, but take responsibility rather than making the source appear solely responsible for our mistake.
可以简述核实失误，但要承担责任，别显得错误全在消息来源。
A
The headline also suggested that local services were disappearing, which depended on the mistaken closure claim.
标题还暗示本地服务正在消失，而这主要依赖那条错误关停说法。
B
We must reassess that broader conclusion instead of treating the correction as a minor change to one sentence.
必须重新评估更大结论，不能把更正当成只改一句的小事。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
Having checked the repair schedule, we can now report the expected reopening date with appropriate attribution.
核查维修时间表后，现在可以注明来源，报道预计重开日期。
B
Make clear that the date is an estimate, since construction work can encounter delays beyond the center's control.
说明日期是估计值，因为施工可能遇到中心无法控制的延误。
A
Would a dated note at the top help readers see immediately that the original report was materially wrong?
顶部带日期的说明，会不会帮助读者立即看出原报道有实质错误？
B
Yes, and retain enough detail for them to understand what changed without repeating the misleading claim unnecessarily.
会，并保留足够细节说明改变了什么，同时避免不必要地重复误导说法。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
I will also contact the organizations that quoted our article so they can review their own notices.
我也会联系引用报道的机构，让他们检查自己的通知。
B
That follow-through matters because an error can continue circulating after the original publisher has corrected its page.
这种后续行动很重要，因为原发布方修正页面后，错误仍可能继续流传。
A
For future interviews, I should confirm whether a closure is temporary before drawing conclusions about lost services.
以后采访应先确认停业是否临时，再推断是否失去了服务。
B
Turn that lesson into a checklist item, so the improvement becomes part of our routine editorial process.
把这个教训加入检查清单，让改进成为日常编辑流程的一部分。

practice.speaking: 口述60秒更正声明，说明错误、准确信息、受影响结论和后续修正渠道。
practice.writing: 写150–170词编辑复盘，使用 having checked，说明纠正事实后为何还必须重审标题和推论。

listening.question: 为什么只替换正文里的一句话还不够？
listening.answer: 旧读者可能看不到更正，而且标题、广泛结论及其他渠道传播的内容也受错误影响。

practice.review: 更正中核对四项：承认错误、准确替代、下游影响、流程改进；不把全部责任推给来源。

title: 干旱时怎样分配用水
scene: 社区代表与水务人员讨论限制用水的差异影响。
objective: 在资源紧张时比较统一规则与按需安排。
grammar: while 引出对照或让步：While equal limits seem simple, households have different needs. 注意与表示同时发生的 while 区分。

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The town is considering a uniform water limit, although households differ greatly in size and daily needs.
镇上考虑统一用水上限，但家庭人数与日常需求差异很大。
B
A simple rule is easier to communicate, but equal allowances may not create an equitable distribution in practice.
简单规则容易解释，但相同配额实际未必带来公平分配。
A
A family caring for an older relative might need more water than one person living alone.
照顾年长亲属的家庭可能比独居者需要更多水。
B
Then essential use should be distinguished from optional activities such as filling private pools or washing empty driveways.
那么应区分必要用水与给私人泳池注水、冲洗空车道等可选活动。
A
Could a tiered allowance reflect household size while keeping additional support available for documented care needs?
分级配额能否体现家庭人数，同时为有证明的照护需求保留额外支持？
B
Possibly, though an application process that is too demanding could prevent eligible households from receiving that support.
可以，但申请流程太繁琐，可能使符合条件的家庭无法获得支持。
A
We should also inspect leaks in public pipes, rather than placing the entire burden on individual residents.
还应检查公共管道漏水，不能让居民承担全部负担。
B
Absolutely, infrastructure maintenance and conservation advice address different sources of waste, so both belong in the response.
当然，基础设施维护与节水建议处理不同浪费来源，都应纳入措施。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
While equal limits seem straightforward, fairness requires attention to the different purposes for which water is used.
相同上限看似直接，但公平还需要关注不同用水目的。
B
At the same time, exceptions must have clear criteria so the policy remains understandable and administratively manageable.
同时，例外需要清楚标准，才能让政策容易理解且便于管理。
A
Would publishing anonymized totals help residents see whether restrictions are reducing consumption without exposing private circumstances?
公布匿名汇总数据能否让居民看到限制是否减少用水，又不暴露私人情况？
B
Yes, provided the reports also explain weather changes that might independently influence demand during the comparison period.
可以，前提是报告也解释比较期间可能独立影响需求的天气变化。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Otherwise, a cooler week could make the restrictions appear more effective than they actually were.
否则较凉的一周可能让限制措施显得比实际更有效。
B
That is why we should describe observed changes carefully instead of attributing every reduction directly to the policy.
因此应谨慎描述观察变化，而不是把每次下降都直接归因于政策。
A
I will support restrictions if the plan protects essential needs and addresses preventable losses across the wider system.
如果方案保护必要需求，并处理系统中可避免的流失，我会支持限水。
B
Let us present those conditions alongside the proposed limit so residents can judge the complete package.
把这些条件与拟议上限一起呈现，让居民评价完整方案。

practice.speaking: 在两分钟听证会发言中比较相同配额与按需配额，并提出一个防止申请门槛过高的办法。
practice.writing: 写150–170词政策段落，使用 while 承认简单规则的优点，再提出公平分配的条件。

listening.question: 为什么气温降低会影响对限水政策效果的判断？
listening.answer: 较凉天气本身可能降低用水需求，因此不能把全部下降都归因于限水政策。

practice.review: 指出必要与可选用水各两例，并说明一项独立于政策的需求影响因素。

title: 公寓屋顶的太阳能收益
scene: 租户与物业代表讨论太阳能投资的成本和分配。
objective: 把整体节省与不同主体承担的成本分开分析。
grammar: whether...depends on... 表达条件性结论：Whether tenants benefit depends on how savings are shared. 从句整体作主语时谓语用单数。

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The building owner wants solar panels on the roof, claiming the installation will lower everyone's energy bills.
楼主想在屋顶装太阳能板，声称安装后大家电费都会降低。
B
That depends on how the electricity is allocated and whether installation costs are passed on through higher rent.
这取决于电力如何分配，以及安装费用是否通过涨租转嫁。
A
The proposal mentions savings in shared areas, but it does not explain the effect on individual apartments.
提案提到公共区域节电，却没解释对各住户的影响。
B
Then tenants need a breakdown separating common operating costs from the charges appearing on their own monthly bills.
那么租户需要明细，区分公共运营成本与自己每月账单收费。
A
Could the roof also accommodate a shaded communal space, or would the panels occupy the entire area?
屋顶还能设置有遮阴的共享空间，还是太阳能板会占满？
B
A combined design might be possible, although structural capacity and safe maintenance access would need professional assessment.
组合设计也许可行，但承重能力和安全维护通道需要专业评估。
A
I support renewable energy, yet I worry that environmental benefits are being used to avoid discussing affordability.
我支持可再生能源，但担心环境收益被用来回避可负担性讨论。
B
Those goals should be examined together, since a technically efficient project can still distribute its costs unevenly.
这些目标应一起研究，因为技术上高效的项目仍可能不均等地分配成本。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
Whether tenants benefit depends on how savings are shared, not merely on how much electricity the panels generate.
租户是否受益取决于节省如何分享，而不只取决于发电量。
B
Exactly, and the financial estimate should include maintenance, equipment replacement, and assumptions about future energy prices.
没错，财务估计还应包括维护、设备更换和未来能源价格的假设。
A
If the calculation assumes prices will rise quickly, a slower increase could lengthen the expected payback period.
如果计算假定价格快速上涨，较慢涨幅就可能延长预计回本期。
B
We should request several scenarios so residents can see which conclusions remain reasonable when the assumptions change.
应该要求多种情境，让居民看到假设变化时哪些结论仍合理。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Could the agreement state how verified savings will affect shared service charges before construction begins?
协议能否在开工前写明，经核实的节省将如何影响公共服务费？
B
That would make the promise concrete and give tenants a clear basis for reviewing the project later.
这样承诺更具体，也让租户日后评估项目时有清晰依据。
A
Then our decision can consider emissions, affordability, roof access, and uncertainty within the same discussion.
那么决定就能在同一讨论中考虑排放、可负担性、屋顶使用和不确定性。
B
A balanced proposal should explain those relationships instead of treating one attractive benefit as sufficient justification for everything.
平衡的提案应解释这些关系，而不是用一个吸引人的优点证明所有安排都合理。

practice.speaking: 扮演租户质询太阳能项目，分别追问成本承担、收益分配、屋顶使用和价格假设。
practice.writing: 写150–170词评估备忘录，用 whether...depends on... 提出条件性支持，并说明需补充的两项信息。

listening.question: 为什么发电量提高不自动意味着租户账单降低？
listening.answer: 收益可能只减少公共成本，且安装费用可能通过租金转嫁；要看实际分配。

practice.review: 用两句话明确区分项目总节省与租户净受益，并列出至少两个财务假设。

title: 餐厅的食物浪费账本
scene: 餐厅经理与厨师讨论减少浪费是否影响选择。
objective: 通过分类测量定位问题，再匹配干预方式。
grammar: rather than 加平行结构：Measure waste by category rather than treating it as one total. 两端保持相同语法形式。

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
Our restaurant throws away food every evening, but the total weight does not tell us where waste begins.
餐厅每晚都丢弃食物，但总重量不能说明浪费从哪里开始。
B
We should separate preparation scraps, unsold dishes, and leftovers returned from tables before deciding what to change.
应先分开备餐边角料、未卖菜品和餐桌剩菜，再决定如何改进。
A
Large portions may explain plate waste, whereas inaccurate demand forecasts could account for meals that never leave the kitchen.
大份量可能解释餐盘剩菜，而需求预测不准可能解释未出厨房的餐食。
B
Exactly, different causes require different interventions, so reducing every portion would address only part of the problem.
没错，不同原因需要不同干预，因此缩小所有份量只解决部分问题。
A
Could we offer smaller servings with optional additions instead of assuming every customer wants the same amount?
能否提供小份，并允许加量，而不是假定每位顾客需求相同？
B
That might help, provided the menu explains the sizes clearly and customers do not feel misled about value.
可能有用，前提是菜单清楚说明份量，顾客不会觉得价值被误导。
A
For unsold meals, a reservation cutoff might improve planning, though it could reduce flexibility for last-minute visitors.
对未卖餐食，预约截止时间可能改善计划，但会降低临时顾客的灵活性。
B
We should test it on one predictable service period before applying the restriction across the entire week.
应先在需求可预期的一个营业时段测试，再扩展至整周。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
Rather than treating waste as one total, our log should connect each category with a likely explanation.
浪费记录不应只写总量，而应把每类与可能原因对应。
B
And record the number of meals served, because lower waste during a quiet evening may simply reflect fewer customers.
还要记录供餐数量，因为清淡晚间垃圾少可能只是顾客少。
A
Would waste per meal provide a fairer comparison between busy weekends and quieter weekday evenings?
每份餐食的浪费量是否能更公平地比较繁忙周末与清淡工作日晚上？
B
It would improve the comparison, although the mix of dishes could still affect how much unavoidable preparation waste occurs.
这样能改善比较，但菜品组合仍会影响不可避免的备餐废料量。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
We should avoid counting vegetable peels and untouched cooked meals as if they represented identical opportunities for prevention.
应避免把菜皮与完整未动熟食视为具有相同预防空间。
B
Agreed, and any donation arrangement must follow applicable food handling requirements rather than relying on good intentions alone.
同意，任何捐赠安排还必须遵循适用食品处理要求，不能只靠善意。
A
I will create a simple daily log that staff can complete without interrupting the dinner rush.
我会设计简单每日记录，让员工在晚餐高峰也能填写而不影响工作。
B
After two weeks, we can choose the largest preventable category and test one focused change against the baseline.
两周后选出最大可避免类别，测试针对改动并与基线比较。

practice.speaking: 解释一张假想餐厅浪费分类表，为备餐、未售、餐盘剩余分别提出对应措施。
practice.writing: 写150–170词两周试点方案，说明分类方式、每餐指标和一项会影响公平比较的因素。

listening.question: 为什么比较不同晚上的浪费总重量可能误导？
listening.answer: 供餐人数不同会改变总浪费；菜品组合也会影响不可避免的备餐废料。

practice.review: 提出三个废料类别，并为每类匹配不同措施；计算方案明确以供餐数量为比较依据。

title: 湿地步道该修在哪里
scene: 保护区管理员与居民讨论开放游览路线。
objective: 识别生态、教育和可达性的冲突并提出条件限制。
grammar: provided that 引导条件：Visitors may enter provided that nesting areas remain protected. 它强调许可所依赖的明确条件。

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The proposed boardwalk would let visitors explore the wetland, but part of the route crosses a nesting area.
拟议木栈道能让游客探索湿地，但部分路线穿过筑巢区。
B
Public access can build support for conservation, although disturbance during sensitive periods may undermine the habitat we want to protect.
公众进入有助争取保护支持，但敏感期干扰可能损害目标栖息地。
A
Could a seasonal closure protect breeding birds while allowing people to use the path during the rest of the year?
季节性关闭能否保护繁殖鸟类，同时允许人们在其余时间使用步道？
B
Possibly, but the timing should follow local ecological evidence rather than a convenient date chosen for the visitor calendar.
可能，不过时间应依据本地生态证据，而非游客日历上方便的日期。
A
An alternative alignment stays farther from the reeds, though it adds distance and includes a steeper slope.
替代路线离芦苇更远，但增加距离，也包含更陡坡道。
B
Then we must examine accessibility as well as habitat impact, instead of assuming the longer route solves every concern.
那么必须同时评估无障碍与栖息地影响，不能假设更长路线解决所有顾虑。
A
A viewing platform near the entrance might offer an experience for visitors unable to complete the entire walk.
入口附近的观景台可能为无法走完全程的游客提供体验。
B
That could broaden access, provided it offers meaningful interpretation rather than merely directing some visitors to an inferior corner.
这能扩大参与，前提是提供有意义的解说，而非把部分游客引到较差角落。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
We should also consider how construction noise and materials would affect the wetland before the path even opens.
还应考虑步道开放前，施工噪声和材料会如何影响湿地。
B
Exactly, an environmentally sensitive visitor experience does not guarantee that its construction process has minimal ecological consequences.
没错，对环境敏感的游览体验，不保证其施工过程生态影响很小。
A
Would a smaller initial section allow us to observe disturbance before committing to the entire route?
先建较小路段，能否在承诺建设全线前观察干扰？
B
It could, although the monitoring plan needs clear indicators and thresholds that would trigger a change in operation.
可以，但监测计划需要明确指标，以及触发运营调整的阈值。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
For example, rangers could record repeated disturbance near nesting zones and restrict access when agreed warning signs appear.
例如护林员记录筑巢区附近反复干扰，并在约定预警迹象出现时限行。
B
Those signs should be defined with qualified specialists, since casual observation may miss less visible forms of harm.
这些迹象应与专业人士共同定义，因为随意观察可能漏掉不易察觉的损害。
A
Then the proposal becomes a conditional access plan, supported by monitoring, rather than an unconditional promise to attract more visitors.
那么提案就是由监测支持的条件性开放计划，而不是无条件承诺吸引更多游客。
B
That framing makes the responsibilities clearer for planners, rangers, and visitors who share an interest in protecting the wetland.
这种表述让规划者、护林员和关心湿地的游客都更清楚各自责任。

practice.speaking: 模拟规划会陈述两条湿地路线的取舍，并提出生态监测触发限行的条件。
practice.writing: 写150–170词有条件开放建议，使用 provided that，同时讨论建设期、运营期与无障碍需求。

listening.question: 为什么更长且远离筑巢区的路线也不能自动成为最佳方案？
listening.answer: 它可能有陡坡并增加距离，给行动受限游客带来新的可达性障碍。

practice.review: 检查是否比较三个维度：栖息地、无障碍、施工影响；写出一个需专业人士确定的阈值。

title: 可重复使用杯子的完整账
scene: 咖啡店主与顾客讨论杯具选择的环境影响。
objective: 评估生命周期边界，避免用单一属性判断整体影响。
grammar: the more...the more/less... 表示相关变化：The more often a cup is reused, the less manufacturing impact each use carries. 需说明适用条件。

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
Our café wants to replace disposable cups, but customers keep asking which reusable material is the greenest.
咖啡店想替换一次性杯，但顾客总问哪种可重复用材质最环保。
B
The answer depends on the full life cycle, including production, transport, washing, and how often the cup is actually reused.
答案取决于完整生命周期，包括生产、运输、清洗和实际重复使用次数。
A
A durable cup could have a larger manufacturing footprint while spreading that impact across many more drinks.
耐用杯的制造足迹可能更大，但可以把影响分摊到更多杯饮料。
B
Exactly, so comparing one disposable cup with one new reusable cup would miss the importance of repeated use.
没错，把一个一次性杯与一个新重复用杯直接比较，会漏掉重复使用的重要性。
A
Could a deposit scheme encourage customers to return borrowed cups instead of buying another container each week?
押金制度能否鼓励顾客归还借用杯，而不是每周再买一个容器？
B
It might, although collection logistics and efficient washing would determine whether the system performs well in practice.
可能，但回收物流与高效清洗会决定系统实际表现。
A
We also need a replacement plan for chipped cups, since keeping unsafe items in circulation would be unacceptable.
还需要有缺口杯子的更换方案，因为不能让不安全杯具继续流通。
B
Agreed, and environmental comparisons should not ignore basic hygiene requirements when calculating the benefits of reuse.
同意，计算重复使用收益时，环境比较不能忽略基本卫生要求。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
The more often a suitable cup is reused, the less manufacturing impact each individual use usually carries.
合适杯子使用次数越多，每次使用通常分摊的制造影响就越低。
B
But that relationship does not mean washing has no cost, especially where heating water requires substantial energy.
但这不意味着清洗没有成本，尤其在加热水需要大量能源时。
A
Should our sign claim the scheme eliminates waste, or would that exaggerate what we can reasonably demonstrate?
标牌应该说方案消除了废物吗，还是会夸大我们能合理证明的效果？
B
Say it aims to reduce disposable cup use, and publish the return rate once reliable operating information becomes available.
可以说旨在减少一次性杯使用，并在取得可靠运营数据后公布归还率。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
That would let customers see whether borrowed cups actually come back, rather than assuming every loan leads to repeated use.
这样顾客能看到借出杯是否真正归还，而不是假设每次借出都会反复使用。
B
We could also track losses and washing loads to identify where the scheme needs improvement over time.
还可记录遗失数量和清洗批次，找出方案日后需改善的部分。
A
Then our environmental message would describe an accountable process instead of attaching a vague green label to a product.
那么环保信息描述的就是可追踪责任的流程，而非给产品贴模糊绿色标签。
B
And customers could participate with realistic expectations about both the benefits and the effort required to achieve them.
顾客也能对收益以及实现收益所需努力抱有现实预期。

practice.speaking: 向顾客解释循环杯方案，说明制造、清洗、归还率三个环节，避免绝对环保承诺。
practice.writing: 写150–170词生命周期分析，使用 the more...the less...，同时说明这一关系未计入哪些成本。

listening.question: 为什么需要记录杯子归还率，而不只记录借出数量？
listening.answer: 只有归还后继续使用才可能形成重复利用；借出不代表一定多次使用。

practice.review: 列出生命周期四环节，并把 eliminate waste 改写成可测量、符合现有证据的目标。

title: 一盆植物能证明什么
scene: 学生研究员与导师设计校园植物实验。
objective: 明确变量、对照与重复测量，避免把单次差异视为因果。
grammar: in order to 加动词说明研究目的：We control watering in order to isolate the effect of light. 目的与具体控制措施应对应。

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
My plant grew faster beside the window, so I want to test whether extra light caused the difference.
我的植物在窗边长得更快，所以想测试额外光照是否造成差异。
B
Start by defining the independent variable, while keeping water, soil, and plant variety as consistent as possible.
先定义自变量，并尽量保持水量、土壤和植物品种一致。
A
If I use one plant in each location, would measuring their height every morning provide enough evidence?
如果每处只放一株，每天早晨测高度，证据够吗？
B
Repeated measurements improve observation, but they do not replace having several independent plants in each experimental condition.
重复测量改善观察，但不能替代每种实验条件下有多株独立植物。
A
Some plants might naturally grow more quickly, even when their environment and treatment appear nearly identical.
有些植物即使环境和处理几乎相同，也可能自然生长更快。
B
Exactly, replication helps us distinguish a consistent treatment effect from variation between individual plants in the experiment.
没错，在每组设置多个独立重复样本，有助于区分稳定的处理效应与植物个体差异。
A
Should I assign the plants randomly rather than putting the strongest seedlings together near the brighter window?
是否应随机分配，而不是把最健壮的幼苗一起放在较亮窗边？
B
Yes, random assignment reduces the risk that existing differences systematically favor one condition before the experiment begins.
是的，随机分配能减少实验开始前已有差异系统性偏向某组的风险。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
We will control watering in order to isolate the effect of light as far as this setup allows.
我们控制浇水，以在装置允许范围内尽量分离光照效应。
B
Also monitor temperature, because the sunnier location may be warmer, introducing another plausible explanation for any growth difference.
还要监测温度，因为更晒位置可能更暖，为生长差异提供另一个解释。
A
If temperature differs substantially, I should acknowledge that the setup cannot cleanly separate heat from additional light.
如果温度差很多，我应承认装置无法清楚分离热量和额外光照。
B
Correct, recognizing a design limitation is more informative than presenting an uncertain mechanism as something you have established.
正确，承认设计局限比把不确定机制说成已确立事实更有意义。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
For the outcome, I could record height and leaf count according to a written measurement procedure.
结果指标可以是高度与叶片数，按书面测量流程记录。
B
Choose the primary outcome before examining results, so you are not selecting whichever measure happens to look most impressive.
看结果前先选主要指标，避免事后挑碰巧最显著的指标。
A
Then my report can explain the question, controls, assignment, results, and limits without claiming that one trial settles everything.
那么报告能解释问题、控制、分组、结果和局限，而不声称一次实验解决一切。
B
That structure makes the reasoning inspectable and gives another class enough information to attempt the experiment independently.
这种结构让推理可检查，也给其他班级足够信息独立尝试实验。

practice.speaking: 口述植物实验设计，明确自变量、主要结果指标、三个控制因素和一个仍可能混杂的因素。
practice.writing: 写150–170词实验方案，使用 in order to，解释为什么一株植物每天测量不等于多个独立样本。

listening.question: 为什么窗边植物长得快不能单独证明光照是原因？
listening.answer: 窗边可能也更暖，植物本身也有差异；温度与个体差异都可能影响生长。

practice.review: 用自己的话区分重复测量与独立重复，并在看结果之前指定一个主要指标。

title: 研究结果为何复现不了
scene: 两位研究生比较原实验与复现实验的方法。
objective: 将不一致结果转化为可检验解释，避免直接归咎于造假。
grammar: may be due to 加名词短语表示可能原因：The discrepancy may be due to different instructions. 与 is caused by 的确定程度不同。

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
Our replication did not reproduce the original effect, although we followed the published instructions as closely as possible.
我们的复现没有重现原效应，尽管尽量遵循了发表的说明。
B
That discrepancy deserves investigation, but it does not immediately tell us whether the original finding was wrong.
这个差异值得调查，但不能立即说明原发现是否错误。
A
The participants in our study were older, and the task was completed online rather than in a laboratory.
我们研究的参与者年龄更大，任务也在线上而非实验室完成。
B
Either difference could matter, so we should compare the procedures systematically before choosing one explanation for the outcome.
任一差异都可能重要，因此选择解释前应系统比较流程。
A
The original paper mentions a short practice session without specifying exactly what feedback participants received afterward.
原论文提到简短练习环节，却没明确参与者之后得到了什么反馈。
B
We could request the materials from the authors, since incomplete reporting may conceal details that affect performance.
可以向作者索取材料，因为不完整报告可能隐藏影响表现的细节。
A
Would our smaller sample also mean the estimate is less precise, making direct comparisons harder to interpret?
我们较小样本是否也意味着估计更不精确，使直接比较更难解释？
B
Yes, examine the uncertainty around both estimates instead of comparing only whether each result passed a significance threshold.
是，应查看两个估计各自的不确定性，而不只比较是否通过显著性阈值。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
The discrepancy may be due to different instructions, but that remains a hypothesis until we test it directly.
差异可能源于不同说明，但在直接测试前仍只是一个假设。
B
A follow-up study could hold the setting constant while varying only the type of feedback participants receive.
后续研究可以保持情境不变，仅改变参与者收到的反馈类型。
A
We should document that decision before collecting more data, otherwise our explanation may keep changing to fit the results.
收更多数据前应记录这个决定，否则解释可能不断改变来迎合结果。
B
And report the unsuccessful replication fully, because hidden null results can distort the picture available to other researchers.
还应完整报告未成功复现，因为隐藏无效应结果会扭曲其他研究者看到的全貌。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
I had worried that publishing an unexpected result would make our project seem like a failure.
我原先担心发表意外结果会让项目显得失败。
B
A careful study can contribute by clarifying when an effect appears, even if it challenges an appealing earlier claim.
严谨研究即使挑战先前吸引人的说法，也能通过澄清效应何时出现作出贡献。
A
Then our conclusion should identify the mismatch, list plausible explanations, and avoid accusing anyone without supporting evidence.
那么结论应指出不一致、列出可能解释，避免无证据指责任何人。
B
Exactly, disagreement between studies should motivate better questions and transparent methods rather than immediate judgments about the researchers involved.
没错，研究间分歧应推动更好的问题与透明方法，而非立即评判研究者。

practice.speaking: 就复现失败作两分钟汇报，给出两种可检验解释、一种不应贸然作出的指控和下一步实验。
practice.writing: 写150–170词研究讨论，使用 may be due to，说明设计差异与估计不确定性如何影响解读。

listening.question: 为什么不应只比较两项研究是否达到显著性阈值？
listening.answer: 因为估计精度与不确定范围也重要，仅以通过或未通过划分可能误导对差异的理解。

practice.review: 将差异、假设、验证步骤分成三句；确认没有把未复现直接等同于原研究造假。

title: 有限经费资助哪项研究
scene: 研究委员会成员比较应用项目与基础项目。
objective: 比较即时效益、长期知识价值与不确定性。
grammar: on the grounds that 引出决策理由：We supported the pilot on the grounds that it addresses a documented need. 理由应可检查。

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
We have funding for one small project, and the proposals offer very different kinds of potential value.
我们只有一个小项目的经费，而提案提供的潜在价值类型很不同。
B
One team wants to test a cheaper water sensor, while the other investigates a poorly understood chemical process.
一组想测试较便宜的水传感器，另一组研究了解不充分的化学过程。
A
The sensor has an obvious application, but its proposal assumes that local agencies will adopt the equipment quickly.
传感器应用明显，但提案假定当地机构会迅速采用设备。
B
That assumption needs support, since a successful prototype does not automatically lead to procurement, maintenance, or routine use.
这个假设需要支持，因为成功原型不会自动转为采购、维护或日常使用。
A
The basic research project cannot promise an immediate product, although it may resolve a question relevant to several future technologies.
基础研究无法承诺即时产品，但可能解决与多种未来技术相关的问题。
B
We should avoid penalizing uncertainty twice by demanding both a novel discovery and a guaranteed practical outcome.
不能既要求新发现又要求保证实用结果，从而对不确定性重复施加惩罚。
A
Could the committee compare methodological quality first, then consider how each project fits the fund's stated purpose?
委员会能否先比较方法质量，再考虑项目是否符合基金声明的目的？
B
That would make the decision more coherent than switching criteria whenever a particular proposal becomes difficult to evaluate.
这样比某项提案难评估时就换标准，决策更一致。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
If this fund was established for urgent local needs, the sensor pilot may deserve priority on those grounds.
如果基金为紧急本地需求而设，那么传感器试点可能据此获得优先。
B
Yes, provided the urgency is documented and the team has a credible plan for testing the device outside ideal conditions.
是，前提是紧迫性有记录，且团队有可信计划在非理想条件下测试设备。
A
We could support a limited pilot rather than financing immediate deployment before reliability has been demonstrated.
可以支持有限试点，而不是在可靠性得到证明前资助立即部署。
B
And explain that this choice reflects the fund's purpose, rather than declaring basic research less valuable in general.
同时解释选择体现基金目的，而不是宣称基础研究整体价值更低。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
The unsuccessful team should receive feedback tied to the published criteria, not vague comments about insufficient impact.
落选团队应收到与公布标准对应的反馈，而不是含糊地说影响不足。
B
That transparency would help them identify a more suitable funding source or strengthen a specific weakness in the proposal.
这种透明度有助他们找到更适合的资金来源，或改进提案具体弱点。
A
I will draft a recommendation that states our objective, compares the evidence, and acknowledges the opportunity cost of either choice.
我会拟建议，说明目标、比较证据，并承认两种选择都有机会成本。
B
Then the final decision will show its reasoning without pretending that the rejected project has no scientific merit.
这样最终决定展示推理，同时不假装被拒项目没有科学价值。

practice.speaking: 模拟资助委员会发言，在明确基金目的后推荐一项项目，并公平说明另一项的科学价值。
practice.writing: 写160–180词资助建议，使用 on the grounds that，列出条件、机会成本和对落选者的具体反馈。

listening.question: 为何传感器原型成功不能证明当地机构会迅速采用？
listening.answer: 后续仍需采购、维护安排和实际条件验证，原型成功不等于落地采用。

practice.review: 推荐理由必须对应公布目的；列出所选方案的一项风险和未选方案的一项真实优势。

title: 把初步发现讲给公众
scene: 科学传播者与研究员准备公众讲座。
objective: 准确表达研究阶段、证据强度和下一步验证。
grammar: suggest 与 demonstrate 的证据力度不同：These observations suggest a link; they do not demonstrate a mechanism. 动词选择匹配证据。

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
Your laboratory results look promising, but the public lecture invitation describes them as a breakthrough ready for everyday use.
实验室结果很有希望，但公开讲座邀请把它描述成可日常使用的突破。
B
That description goes beyond our evidence, since we have tested the material only under tightly controlled experimental conditions.
那个描述超出证据，因为只在严格控制条件下测试过材料。
A
How can we explain the finding clearly without making the audience feel that every statement is surrounded by qualifications?
怎样才能清楚解释发现，又不让听众觉得每句话都被限定语包围？
B
Begin with the question and the observed result, then explain the single most important limitation in ordinary language.
先说问题和观察结果，再用普通语言解释最重要的限制。
A
For example, the coating resisted damage in our test, but we do not yet know how it performs outdoors.
例如涂层在测试中耐受损伤，但还不知道户外表现如何。
B
That distinction communicates progress while showing why weather exposure and longer testing remain necessary before wider application.
这个区别既传达进展，也说明推广前为何还需要天气暴露和长期测试。
A
Would an analogy help if I compare the laboratory trial with checking a raincoat briefly under a kitchen faucet?
把实验室试验比作在厨房水龙头下短暂测试雨衣，这个类比有帮助吗？
B
It could clarify the gap, provided you explain where the analogy stops matching the actual research process.
它能说明差距，前提是解释类比在哪些地方不再符合实际研究。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
Our observations suggest that the coating may protect the surface, but they do not demonstrate performance in every environment.
观察提示涂层可能保护表面，但没有证明在所有环境中的表现。
B
Exactly, and replace phrases such as scientists have proved with language that reflects the specific evidence available at this stage.
没错，把科学家已证明之类词语换成体现现阶段具体证据的表达。
A
People may ask when they can buy the product, although development could reveal problems we have not anticipated.
人们可能问何时能买，但开发过程可能发现尚未预料的问题。
B
Give the next research milestone rather than inventing a release date that the current project cannot responsibly support.
给出下个研究里程碑，而不是编造当前项目无法负责支持的上市日期。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
We plan to compare performance after repeated temperature changes and exposure to moisture over a longer period.
我们计划比较反复温度变化和较长时间潮湿暴露后的表现。
B
That is concrete enough to show direction without implying that success in the next stage has already been secured.
这足够具体地展示方向，又不暗示下一阶段成功已获保证。
A
I will also distinguish the team's interpretation from the measurements that the audience can inspect in our published report.
我也会区分团队解释与听众能在报告中查验的测量结果。
B
Then the talk can be engaging because the reasoning is clear, rather than because uncertainty has been edited out.
这样讲座吸引人是因为推理清晰，而不是因为不确定性被删掉。

practice.speaking: 用两分钟向非专业听众讲解假想涂层研究，含一个类比、类比边界和下个研究里程碑。
practice.writing: 写160–180词科学传播稿，区分 observed、suggest 与 demonstrate，并避免编造上市时间。

listening.question: 讲座中为何应给出下个研究里程碑，而不是购买日期？
listening.answer: 目前证据不足以支持上市时间；后续开发仍可能出现未预料的问题。

practice.review: 找出一项测量、一项解释和一项未知；确认每个动词的确定性与证据强度相符。

title: 市民观鸟数据能做什么
scene: 公园志愿者与研究员讨论公众记录的用途。
objective: 识别观察努力和检测机会对记录数据的影响。
grammar: unless 与 can be misleading 搭配限定数据解读：Counts can be misleading unless observation effort is recorded. 指出缺失条件造成的偏差。

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
Our volunteer group recorded more birds this spring, and several members think the local population must be recovering.
志愿组今春记录更多鸟，一些成员认为本地种群一定正在恢复。
B
That is possible, but we also recruited more observers and spent longer periods in the park this year.
有可能，但今年也招募了更多观察者，在公园停留更久。
A
So the increase could reflect greater observation effort rather than a genuine change in the number of birds.
因此增长可能反映观察投入增加，而不是鸟类数量真实变化。
B
Exactly, raw counts can be misleading unless we record how long people watched and which locations they visited.
没错，如果不记录观察时长和地点，原始数量可能误导。
A
Some experienced volunteers recognize calls that beginners miss, which might also affect the probability of detecting a species.
有些老志愿者能认出新手错过的鸣声，也会影响发现物种的概率。
B
We can provide training and record observer experience, while acknowledging that detection will never be perfectly equal across visits.
可以培训并记录观察经验，同时承认不同访问中的检测机会不会完全相同。
A
Would photographs help confirm unusual sightings without discouraging people who do not own expensive camera equipment?
照片能否确认罕见观察，同时又不打击没有昂贵相机的人？
B
Offer several verification methods, including detailed field notes and review by a knowledgeable local coordinator when necessary.
提供多种核实方式，包括详细野外笔记，以及必要时由熟悉情况的协调员审查。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
We should also avoid publishing precise nest locations if that information could attract visitors to vulnerable breeding sites.
如果信息会把游客引向脆弱繁殖点，也应避免公开精确巢穴位置。
B
Agreed, useful open data still require judgment about details that could cause harm when shared without appropriate safeguards.
同意，有用开放数据仍需判断哪些细节在缺乏保护时分享可能造成伤害。
A
Could we select fixed routes and encourage observations at similar times to make future comparisons more consistent?
能否选固定路线，鼓励相似时段观察，让未来比较更一致？
B
That would improve comparability, although weather and seasonal timing should still be recorded because they influence what observers encounter.
能改善可比性，但仍应记录天气和季节时间，因为它们影响观察者遇到什么。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
For this year's report, I will describe an increase in recorded sightings rather than claiming proven population recovery.
今年报告我会描述记录目击增加，而不是声称已证明种群恢复。
B
Then explain what additional monitoring would help distinguish increased reporting from an actual ecological trend over several years.
再解释需要什么额外监测，才能区分报告增加与多年生态趋势。
A
The volunteers may appreciate knowing that careful notes make their observations more useful even when the conclusion remains uncertain.
即使结论仍不确定，志愿者也会愿意知道认真笔记让观察更有价值。
B
Yes, participation becomes more meaningful when people understand both the contribution they make and the limits of the evidence.
是的，当人们理解贡献以及证据边界时，参与会更有意义。

practice.speaking: 向志愿者解释记录鸟类增加的两种可能原因，并说明明年如何收集更可比较的数据。
practice.writing: 写160–180词市民科学报告，使用 unless，限定今年发现并提出三项标准化记录要求。

listening.question: 为什么记录到更多鸟不一定代表种群恢复？
listening.answer: 今年观察者更多、停留更久；观察者经验与检测机会的差异也会影响记录，因此记录增加未必来自种群增加。

practice.review: 把实际种群、检测概率、观察投入三者区分，并纠正一个过度确定的报告标题。

title: 古城每天接待多少游客
scene: 居民代表与旅游部门讨论古城预约限流。
objective: 比较旅游收入、生活品质与承载限制。
grammar: to the extent that 表示在某种程度或条件范围内：Tourism helps residents to the extent that its benefits reach them. 用范围限定宽泛判断。

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The old town becomes crowded every weekend, and residents want a daily visitor cap before the summer season.
古城每周末都拥挤，居民希望夏季前设定每日游客上限。
B
A cap could reduce pressure on narrow streets, but small businesses worry about losing customers they depend on.
上限可减轻窄街压力，但小商户担心失去赖以经营的顾客。
A
Would timed reservations spread arrivals more evenly without necessarily reducing the total number of visitors across the whole day?
分时预约能否让到访更均匀，而不一定减少全天总游客数？
B
Perhaps, although managing arrivals alone would not address noise from late-night tours or overcrowding inside residential courtyards.
也许，但只管理到访时间无法解决深夜游噪声或居民院内拥挤。
A
Then the policy should distinguish visitor volume from visitor behavior, since those problems may require different responses.
那么政策应区分游客数量与行为，因为两类问题可能需要不同措施。
B
Exactly, and residents should help identify the specific pressures instead of being treated as one group with identical preferences.
没错，应由居民帮助指出具体压力，而不是假设他们偏好完全一致。
A
A café owner may favor longer opening hours, while a neighbor above the café may value quiet evenings more.
咖啡店主可能赞成延长营业，而楼上邻居更重视安静夜晚。
B
Those competing interests make transparent rules important, especially when the economic benefits and daily inconvenience fall on different people.
收益与日常不便落在不同人身上时，利益冲突使透明规则更重要。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
Tourism benefits residents to the extent that income supports local livelihoods and the neighborhood remains a workable place to live.
旅游能在多大程度上惠及居民，取决于收入能否支持本地生计、社区能否保持适宜居住。
B
That suggests measuring local outcomes, rather than assuming that a higher visitor count is always the best sign of success.
这意味着应测量本地结果，而非假定更高游客数总是最佳成功标志。
A
Could the pilot track street congestion, resident complaints, and the share of spending reaching locally owned businesses?
试点能否跟踪街道拥堵、居民投诉与流向本地商户的消费比例？
B
Yes, while being clear that complaints alone may underrepresent people who find the reporting process difficult or ineffective.
可以，同时要说明投诉可能低估不便举报或觉得举报无用者的情况。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
We should also offer an offline reservation option so the new system does not exclude visitors with limited digital access.
还应提供线下预约，避免新系统排除数字接入有限的游客。
B
And retain clear access for residents, deliveries, and emergency services when visitor queues form near the main entrance.
主入口形成游客队伍时，还应保留居民、配送和应急服务的畅通通道。
A
I will propose a limited trial with published review dates rather than presenting one permanent number as unquestionably correct.
我会提议有限试行并公布复评日期，而非把一个永久人数说成绝对正确。
B
That allows the town to adjust its approach as evidence emerges about where pressure actually remains.
这样小镇能根据实际压力仍在哪里的证据调整做法。

practice.speaking: 以居民代表发言两分钟，区分游客数量和行为问题，并公平呈现店主与楼上住户的不同诉求。
practice.writing: 写160–180词古城试点建议，用 to the extent that 限定旅游收益，列出三项评价指标。

listening.question: 为什么分时预约不能解决古城的所有压力？
listening.answer: 它主要调整到访时间，不能直接处理深夜噪声或居民庭院内过度拥挤等行为问题。

practice.review: 检查发言是否提出数量措施和行为措施各一项，并解释谁获益、谁承担不便。

title: 博物馆文物说明由谁写
scene: 策展人与来源社区代表讨论展签和解释权。
objective: 区分实物保管、历史叙述与共同决定权。
grammar: whose 引导所属关系从句：Invite communities whose histories are represented. 用它明确谁的经验被展示。
