sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The museum wants to rewrite its labels, but our community has only been invited to check a few names.
博物馆想重写展签，但只邀请我们社区核对几个名字。
B
That sounds like consultation with a narrow scope, rather than shared influence over how the collection is interpreted.
这听起来是范围狭窄的咨询，而不是共同影响藏品如何被解释。
A
Some objects were described mainly as decorative, although they had ceremonial roles that matter to their original communities.
有些物件主要被描述为装饰品，但其仪式功能对原社区很重要。
B
Then the interpretation should include that context, with permission from people authorized to share knowledge that may be sensitive.
那么解说应包含背景，同时获得有权分享敏感知识者的许可。
A
We also disagree about acquisition history, because the archive records a sale without explaining the conditions surrounding it.
我们也对获得历史有异议，因为档案记了出售，却没说明当时条件。
B
A transaction record is evidence, but it may not settle questions about coercion, unequal power, or competing accounts of ownership.
交易记录是证据，却未必解决胁迫、权力不平等或所有权叙述冲突。
A
Could the label acknowledge those gaps instead of presenting the museum's existing documentation as a complete and neutral history?
展签能否承认空白，而不是把馆方文件当作完整中立的历史？
B
Yes, and conflicting accounts can be described respectfully without pretending that every uncertainty has already been resolved.
可以，也能尊重地呈现不同叙述，而不假装所有不确定性都已解决。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
Communities whose histories are represented should have meaningful opportunities to shape both the wording and the questions being asked.
其历史被展示的社区，应有实质机会影响措辞和所提出的问题。
B
That requires agreeing on decision rights, compensation for contributors, and a process for reviewing material before publication.
这需要就决定权、贡献者报酬和发布前审阅流程达成一致。
A
Would including a community quotation be enough if the museum still controls the rest of the narrative?
如果博物馆仍控制其余叙述，只加入一句社区引语就足够吗？
B
It may add a voice, but meaningful participation depends on whether that contribution can actually change the overall interpretation.
可能增加声音，但有意义参与取决于贡献能否真正改变整体解释。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
We should also distinguish the label revision from unresolved requests about the future location or ownership of the objects.
还应区分展签修改与尚未解决的物件未来所在地或所有权诉求。
B
Agreed, improving public explanation should not be presented as automatically settling every concern about possession and responsibility.
同意，改善公开解释不能被说成自动解决占有和责任的一切争议。
A
Our first meeting could identify which knowledge may be shared, where records conflict, and who needs to participate further.
第一次会议可以确定哪些知识可分享、记录何处冲突、还需谁参与。
B
Then the resulting exhibit would show an accountable interpretive process rather than simply adding new wording to an unchanged arrangement.
这样展览展示的是有责任的解释过程，而不只是给未变安排添加新措辞。

practice.speaking: 模拟策展协商，提出社区在展签编写中的三项具体权利，并承认现有档案的一项限制。
practice.writing: 写160–180词展览解说方案，使用 whose，区分加入引语、共同决策与物件所有权问题。

listening.question: 为什么一张交易记录不足以完整解释物件入藏历史？
listening.answer: 它可能未交代胁迫、不平等权力关系和不同所有权叙述等背景。

practice.review: 核对方案有决定权、报酬、审阅三项安排，并避免把文案修改说成解决所有归属争议。

title: 传统节庆要不要商业化
scene: 节庆组织者与年轻表演者协商赞助条件。
objective: 分析资金支持与文化自主之间的关系。
grammar: as...as possible 表达约束内最大化：Keep the program as accessible as possible. 同时说明限制与实际措施。

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
A beverage company has offered to sponsor the festival, provided its branding appears beside the main ceremonial performance.
饮料公司愿意赞助节庆，条件是品牌出现在主要仪式表演旁。
B
The funding would help cover equipment and travel, but some elders consider that placement inappropriate for the occasion.
资金能支付设备和交通，但一些长者认为那个位置不合场合。
A
Could we move the commercial signs to the food stalls while keeping the ceremony itself free from advertising?
能否把商业标志移到餐饮摊位，同时让仪式本身没有广告？
B
That compromise may be acceptable, although the sponsor would need to agree before we commit money we do not yet have.
这个折中也许可接受，但未获赞助方同意前，不能先承诺支出。
A
Younger performers also want a contemporary music segment, which some organizers dismiss as a departure from authentic tradition.
年轻表演者还想加当代音乐环节，一些组织者认为这背离正宗传统。
B
We should ask how the festival has changed over time, rather than assuming that authenticity requires every detail to remain fixed.
应询问节庆历来如何变化，而不是假设真实传统要求每个细节固定。
A
At the same time, innovation should involve the people who maintain the tradition, not simply follow whatever attracts online attention.
同时，创新应让维护传统的人参与，而不是只追逐网络关注。
B
Agreed, a separate performance space might allow experimentation while preserving the sequence and meaning of the central ceremony.
同意，独立表演空间可能允许尝试，同时保留核心仪式的顺序与意义。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
We want to keep the program as accessible as possible without treating cultural participation as merely another product to sell.
我们希望尽量扩大参与，同时不把文化参与仅仅当作销售产品。
B
That means discussing ticket prices, transport, and opportunities for local families whose budgets may be limited.
这意味着要讨论票价、交通，以及预算有限本地家庭的参与机会。
A
If sponsorship allows free entry, residents might support it more strongly, but they still deserve a voice in the conditions.
如果赞助带来免费入场，居民可能更支持，但仍有权参与决定条件。
B
Exactly, financial support does not remove the need for transparent decisions about representation, respect, and control over the program.
没错，资金支持不能取消在呈现、尊重和节目控制上透明决策的必要。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
We could publish the proposed agreement and invite specific feedback on branding locations before signing the final version.
签最终版前可以公布拟议协议，征询品牌位置的具体反馈。
B
And explain which expenses the sponsorship would cover, so people can evaluate the actual benefit alongside their concerns.
还要说明赞助支付哪些费用，让人们把实际收益与担忧一起评估。
A
Then the decision will reflect a negotiated balance rather than a simple choice between preserving culture and accepting all commercial terms.
那么决定体现的是协商平衡，而不是保留文化与接受所有商业条款的二选一。
B
A festival can evolve while retaining meaning when the community has a substantive role in deciding how change happens.
只要社区能实质决定变化方式，节庆就能在演变中保留意义。

practice.speaking: 分别代表赞助方、长者和年轻表演者陈述诉求，再提出包含品牌位置与节目空间的折中。
practice.writing: 写160–180词节庆赞助评估，使用 as...as possible，明确资金收益、文化边界和居民参与机制。

listening.question: 对话为何不把传统理解成所有细节永远不变？
listening.answer: 传统本身可能随时间变化；关键是维护传统的社区能实质参与决定变化方式。

practice.review: 口头总结三个参与方的利益，确保没有把任一方描述为只爱钱或只反对变化。

title: 导览中的地方语言
scene: 导游与语言教师设计双语文化步行路线。
objective: 比较游客理解、社区语言可见度与翻译细节。
grammar: so that 加完整从句表达目的：Keep the original name so that visitors recognize its local meaning. 不与 so...that 的结果结构混淆。

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The tourism office wants English names on every sign, but several local place names carry meanings that translation may obscure.
旅游办公室希望所有标志用英文名称，但一些地方名含义可能被翻译掩盖。
B
We could keep the original names and add concise explanations, rather than replacing them with simpler labels designed only for visitors.
可以保留原名加简短解释，而不是换成只为游客设计的简单标签。
A
Some guides avoid the local language because they worry that unfamiliar pronunciation will confuse people on a short tour.
有些导游避开本地语言，因为担心短途导览中的陌生发音让游客困惑。
B
A brief pronunciation guide could make the names approachable while showing that the language remains part of everyday community life.
简短发音指南能让名称更易掌握，也体现这种语言仍属于日常社区生活。
A
Would inviting a local speaker to record the names provide a better model than asking software to approximate them?
邀请本地使用者录音，会不会比让软件近似发音更合适？
B
Yes, with permission and appropriate compensation, especially if the recordings will be reused commercially across multiple tours and platforms.
是的，要获得许可并给予适当报酬，尤其录音会在多个路线和平台商业使用时。
A
We should also acknowledge variation, since neighboring families sometimes pronounce the same name differently without either version being incorrect.
还应承认变体，因为邻近家庭有时发音不同，却不代表某一版本错误。
B
That would prevent the guide from presenting one selected recording as the only legitimate form of the language.
这能避免导览把选定的一段录音当作语言唯一正当形式。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
Keep the original name so that visitors encounter the place as residents describe it, with translation available to support understanding.
保留原名，让游客接触居民所说的地方名称，同时以翻译辅助理解。
B
And explain cultural references selectively, because an overloaded sign can become difficult to read even when every detail is accurate.
文化背景也应有所选择，因为内容过载的标志即使准确也难读。
A
Could the sign offer a short explanation while an optional audio guide provides a fuller story for interested visitors?
标志能否给简短解释，再用可选音频为感兴趣游客提供完整故事？
B
That layered approach gives people different entry points, provided the essential information remains accessible without downloading an app.
分层做法提供不同入口，前提是基本信息无需下载应用也能获取。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
The community should review the stories before publication, particularly where personal memories or sensitive historical experiences are included.
发布前应让社区审查故事，尤其含个人回忆或敏感历史经历时。
B
Agreed, collecting a story does not automatically mean we have permission to use it in every future setting.
同意，收集到故事不代表自动获得在未来任何场景使用的许可。
A
I will design one sample stop with the original name, a translation, pronunciation support, and a clearly credited local account.
我会设计一个示例站点，包含原名、翻译、发音帮助及注明来源的本地叙述。
B
Then residents and visitors can test whether the material supports understanding while respecting the people whose language and experiences it presents.
之后居民和游客可测试材料是否促进理解，同时尊重被呈现语言与经历的人。

practice.speaking: 介绍一处假想双语导览站，说明原名、翻译、发音和社区署名分别发挥什么作用。
practice.writing: 写160–180词导览设计说明，使用 so that，处理发音变体、使用许可与无需应用的访问需求。

listening.question: 为什么不能把选定录音描述为唯一正确发音？
listening.answer: 语言存在合法的地方或家庭发音变体，一个录音不能代表唯一正确形式。

practice.review: 检查展示中是否保留原名，并说明录音者报酬、许可范围和发布前社区审阅。

title: 旅游工作是不是稳定机会
scene: 酒店员工与地方发展顾问讨论旅游就业质量。
objective: 区分职位数量、岗位质量和经济韧性。
grammar: despite 加名词或动名词表达让步：Despite rising visitor numbers, employment remains seasonal. 后面不能直接接完整主谓句。

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The new resort promises more jobs, but many existing workers receive contracts that end when the tourist season finishes.
新度假村承诺更多工作，但现有许多员工合同在旅游季结束就终止。
B
Job creation matters, although the number of positions alone tells us little about pay, stability, or opportunities for advancement.
创造岗位很重要，但职位数量本身几乎不能说明工资、稳定性或晋升机会。
A
Despite rising visitor numbers, some employees still need a second job to cover expenses during the quieter months.
尽管游客增加，一些员工仍需第二份工作支付淡季开支。
B
Then the development plan should examine annual livelihoods rather than evaluating success only during the busiest weeks of the year.
那么发展计划应评估全年生计，而不是只看一年最忙几周。
A
Could training help workers move into maintenance, accounting, or other roles that remain necessary after the main season ends?
培训能否帮助员工转到维护、会计等旺季后仍需要的岗位？
B
It could broaden options, provided training is accessible to current workers and connected to positions that genuinely exist locally.
能扩大选择，前提是现有员工可参与，且培训对应本地确实存在的岗位。
A
The proposal also assumes suppliers will be local, but large hotel chains sometimes purchase through national contracts.
提案还假设供应商是本地的，但大型连锁酒店有时通过全国合同采购。
B
We should request a concrete procurement plan before counting all projected spending as income that stays within the community.
在把全部预计支出算作留在社区的收入前，应要求具体采购计划。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
Would encouraging several types of business make the town less vulnerable if tourism demand suddenly falls for external reasons?
鼓励多种企业发展，是否能降低小镇面对外部原因导致旅游骤降时的脆弱性？
B
Diversification can improve resilience, although limited resources mean the town must choose realistic opportunities rather than supporting every imaginable industry.
多元化可增强韧性，但资源有限，必须选择现实机会，而不是扶持所有想象中的行业。
A
A year-round training center might serve residents and visiting groups, while sharing facilities that otherwise stand empty off-season.
全年培训中心可能服务居民和访客，并利用淡季原本闲置的设施。
B
That is worth exploring if demand is demonstrated and the activities do not simply displace existing local providers.
如果需求得到证明，而且不会只是挤走既有本地提供者，就值得探索。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
For the resort agreement, I would prioritize predictable schedules, transparent promotion routes, and commitments that can be checked after opening.
度假村协议中，我会优先要求可预期排班、透明晋升路径和开业后可核查承诺。
B
Those conditions connect public support to job quality instead of relying entirely on an impressive headline about the number of hires.
这些条件把公共支持与岗位质量联系起来，而不是完全依赖亮眼招聘数字。
A
We should ask workers directly which changes would make their income and family arrangements more secure throughout the year.
应直接问员工，哪些变化能让全年收入和家庭安排更有保障。
B
Then the assessment can recognize economic growth while examining who benefits, when they benefit, and how dependable those gains really are.
这样评估既认可增长，也审视谁获益、何时获益以及收益是否可靠。

practice.speaking: 评价假想度假村的就业承诺，比较招聘人数与全年生计，提出三条开业后可核验条件。
practice.writing: 写160–180词发展评估，使用 despite，讨论季节性、当地采购和经济多元化的关系。

listening.question: 为什么不能把度假村全部预计采购额都算作社区收益？
listening.answer: 它可能通过全国合同采购，并非所有支出都流向本地供应商或留在社区。

practice.review: 提出工资、稳定性、晋升各一个评价问题，并说明一个外部旅游需求变化的风险。

title: 新住房建在谁的街区
scene: 居民与城市规划员讨论增加住房密度。
objective: 连接住房供给、配套承载与分配影响。
grammar: not necessarily 表示否定必然关系：More construction does not necessarily reduce each household’s rent. 既不否认可能作用，也不保证结果。

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The council proposes apartments near the station, but neighbors worry that schools and clinics are already operating close to capacity.
市议会提议在车站附近建公寓，但邻居担心学校和诊所已接近满负荷。
B
Additional housing could improve access to transit, although supporting services need to be considered alongside the number of new units.
新增住房可能改善公共交通可达性，但配套服务需与新住房数量一起考虑。
A
Some campaigners say any construction will immediately make rents affordable, which seems stronger than the evidence we have discussed.
一些倡议者说任何建设都会立刻让租金可负担，这比已有证据支持的说法更强。
B
More supply can influence market conditions, but the timing and distribution of benefits depend on several local factors.
更多供应能影响市场，但收益的时间和分配取决于多个本地因素。
A
Could the plan include homes at different price levels, rather than assuming every household can afford the same type of apartment?
计划能否包含不同价格住房，而不是假设每户都能负担同一类公寓？
B
That would address a broader range of needs, provided the affordability commitments remain clear and enforceable after the buildings are occupied.
这能满足更多需求，前提是入住后可负担性承诺仍清楚且能执行。
A
Existing renters also fear displacement if nearby redevelopment raises costs before any promised benefits reach their households.
现有租户也担心，如果周边改造先推高成本、后带来收益，就会被迫搬离。
B
Then the policy should examine transition risks, including whether residents can remain in the area while changes take place.
那么政策应研究过渡风险，包括变化期间居民能否继续留在当地。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
More construction does not necessarily reduce every household's rent, so the proposal should avoid presenting a single outcome as guaranteed.
更多建设不一定降低每户租金，因此提案应避免保证单一结果。
B
At the same time, uncertainty is not a reason to ignore the real costs of having too few available homes.
同时，不确定性也不是忽略住房不足真实成本的理由。
A
We need to compare the proposed development with a realistic alternative, including what happens if no additional housing is built.
需要与现实替代方案比较，包括完全不增建住房会怎样。
B
Exactly, evaluating change against an imagined world without any problems can make every practical option appear unacceptable.
没错，把改变与毫无问题的想象世界比较，会让所有实际选项显得不可接受。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Could the review publish expected service demand, the funding plan for expansion, and measures protecting tenants during the transition?
评估能否公布预期服务需求、扩容资金计划，以及过渡期租户保护措施？
B
Those details would help residents debate the actual design instead of relying on general slogans for or against development.
这些细节能让居民讨论实际设计，而不是依赖赞成或反对开发的口号。
A
I could support additional homes if the agreement addresses infrastructure and does not treat current residents as an afterthought.
如果协议处理基础设施，也不把现有居民当作事后考虑，我可以支持增建。
B
That conditional position identifies improvements planners can examine while recognizing both the benefits and the risks of the proposal.
这种有条件立场提出可研究的改进，同时承认提案的收益与风险。

practice.speaking: 在两分钟住房听证会中提出有条件支持，回应住房供给、配套服务和现有租户三方面的关切。
practice.writing: 写160–180词住房政策分析，使用 not necessarily，并把增建与现实的不增建情境作比较。

listening.question: 为什么评估新住房不能只列出开发带来的问题？
listening.answer: 还要比较不增建住房的真实成本，否则会把方案与不存在的无问题世界比较。

practice.review: 将观点中的保证性词语改为有条件表达，并明确两项可以改变你判断的证据。

title: 学校午餐是普惠还是定向
scene: 校长与家长代表讨论补助覆盖范围。
objective: 比较资格筛选、行政成本、参与率与尊严。
grammar: even though 引出已知让步事实：Even though support is available, some eligible families do not apply. 与假设性的 even if 区分。

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The school can expand its lunch program, but the board is divided between universal meals and support based on household income.
学校可以扩大午餐计划，但董事会对普惠与按收入补助意见不一。
B
Targeted support directs funds toward greater need, although checking eligibility adds administrative work and can miss families whose circumstances change.
定向支持把资金导向更大需求，但资格审核增加行政工作，也可能漏掉情况变化家庭。
A
Some parents avoid applying because they worry their children will be identified publicly as receiving financial assistance.
有些家长不申请，因为担心孩子被公开识别为接受经济援助者。
B
Then uptake depends partly on the application process and the way meals are provided, not simply on whether assistance exists.
那么参与率部分取决于申请和供餐方式，而不只是有没有援助。
A
A universal program could reduce stigma, but it would also spend limited funds on families who could pay comfortably.
普惠可能减少污名，但也会把有限资金用于完全付得起的家庭。
B
That is a genuine tradeoff, so we should compare total costs, including verification, staffing, and the consequences of low participation.
这是真实取舍，因此应比较总成本，包括审核、人手和低参与的后果。
A
Could automatic enrollment help eligible students without requiring parents to complete another complicated form every school term?
自动加入能否帮助符合条件学生，而不要求家长每学期再填复杂表格？
B
Possibly, provided information is used appropriately and families receive clear explanations about how eligibility is determined and corrected.
可能，前提是恰当使用信息，并向家庭清楚说明资格如何判定和更正。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
Even though support is available, some eligible families do not apply, so expenditure alone cannot show whether needs are being met.
即使有支持，一些符合家庭也不申请，因此仅看支出不能显示需求是否满足。
B
We should examine missed meals and participation barriers while avoiding questions that unnecessarily expose individual children to embarrassment.
应检查未就餐与参与障碍，同时避免不必要地让孩子尴尬的问题。
A
The board also needs to consider meal quality, since a free lunch that students rarely eat will not achieve the intended benefit.
董事会还需考虑餐品质量，因为学生很少吃的免费午餐无法实现预期收益。
B
Exactly, affordability and acceptability are related but distinct dimensions, and both affect whether the service works in daily practice.
没错，可负担性与可接受性相关却不同，两者都影响服务日常效果。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Could students help test menu options and explain practical issues such as queues, portion sizes, and time available to eat?
学生能否参与试菜单，解释排队、份量和用餐时间等实际问题？
B
Their input would complement the financial analysis, particularly if we include students whose experiences are usually missing from formal meetings.
其意见能补充财务分析，尤其应纳入经验通常缺席正式会议的学生。
A
I will present two clearly costed options, with assumptions about participation stated explicitly rather than hidden inside the budget.
我会呈现两个成本明确方案，把参与率假设说清，而不藏在预算中。
B
Then the board can debate which tradeoffs it accepts while remaining accountable for the children the program is intended to serve.
这样董事会能讨论接受哪些取舍，同时对计划服务的孩子负责。

practice.speaking: 比较普惠午餐与定向补助，分别说明一项优势和一项代价，再提出改善参与率的具体措施。
practice.writing: 写160–180词董事会建议，使用 even though，区分预算投入、覆盖资格和实际就餐情况。

listening.question: 为什么免费午餐的预算支出不能独自证明项目成功？
listening.answer: 符合条件者可能未申请，学生也可能因质量或排队等问题不吃，需要看实际参与与需求。

practice.review: 检查比较包含审核成本、污名、餐品接受度三项，且没有把符合资格等同于实际受益。

title: 拥堵收费收入花到哪里
scene: 通勤者与交通政策员讨论市中心道路收费。
objective: 区分行为激励与缺少替代方式者承担的负担。
grammar: unless 替代条件与 would 表达后果：Charges would burden some workers unless reliable alternatives were available. 注意假设条件中的时态一致。

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
Charging vehicles to enter downtown might reduce congestion, but night-shift workers often travel when public transit is unavailable.
车辆入市中心收费可能减堵，但夜班员工常在公共交通停运时出行。
B
That concern suggests the policy should examine alternatives by time and location, rather than assuming every driver has the same choices.
这个担忧说明应按时段和地点评估替代方式，而非假设所有司机选择相同。
A
A flat fee could be a small inconvenience for one commuter and a substantial share of another person's daily pay.
固定费用对一个人可能只是小不便，对另一个人却占当天收入很大部分。
B
True, although exemptions can weaken the traffic reduction goal if they become so broad that most vehicles remain unaffected.
确实，但豁免太广、让多数车辆不受影响，也会削弱减流目标。
A
Could the revenue fund earlier buses and safer connections before the charge reaches its full proposed level?
收入能否在收费达到拟议全额前，用于更早公交和更安全接驳？
B
A phased introduction could connect the new cost with visible improvements, provided the spending commitment is specific and verifiable.
分阶段实施能把新增成本与可见改善连接，前提是支出承诺具体可核实。
A
People may distrust the scheme if the money simply disappears into a general budget without a clear public explanation.
如果钱只是进入总预算而无清楚说明，人们可能不信任方案。
B
Then regular reporting should show revenue, operating costs, and the transport services financed, while acknowledging any shortfall against the original plan.
那么定期报告应列收入、运营成本、资助服务，并承认与原计划的差距。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
Charges would burden some workers unless reliable alternatives were available, especially where employers cannot offer flexible starting times.
如果没有可靠替代，收费会加重部分员工负担，尤其在雇主无法灵活开工时。
B
We should assess that distribution carefully while also recognizing that congestion imposes costs on bus riders and nearby residents today.
应仔细评估分配，同时承认现在拥堵也给公交乘客和附近居民造成成本。
A
Otherwise, the debate may count the new fee but ignore delays and pollution that already affect people with fewer resources.
否则讨论可能只算新收费，却忽略已影响资源较少者的延误与污染。
B
Exactly, the relevant comparison includes both the burdens introduced by the policy and the burdens it could potentially reduce.
没错，相关比较应包括政策新增负担与可能减少的既有负担。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Could the pilot examine boundary streets to see whether drivers divert into residential neighborhoods instead of reducing unnecessary journeys?
试点能否检查边界街道，看司机是否改走住宅区，而非减少不必要行程？
B
Yes, displacement of traffic is a plausible side effect, so monitoring only the charging zone would give an incomplete picture.
可以，交通转移是可能副作用，只监测收费区会导致图景不完整。
A
I would support a trial that publishes distributional results and links any expansion to improvements in practical travel options.
我支持公布分配影响结果，并把扩大实施与实际出行选择改善关联的试点。
B
That makes the proposal assessable through outcomes, rather than asking residents to accept broad promises about a better city.
这样提案可通过结果评估，而不是要求居民接受更好城市的宽泛承诺。

practice.speaking: 模拟拥堵收费辩论，回应夜班工人、公交通勤者和边界居民三方观点，并解释收费收入用途。
practice.writing: 写160–180词条件性支持声明，使用 unless，比较新增费用与已有拥堵成本，并提出一项副作用监测。

listening.question: 为什么只监测收费区内部车流不够？
listening.answer: 司机可能绕行住宅区，把交通负担转移到边界街道，而不是减少行程。

practice.review: 对比中同时计入政策新增和减少的成本，并写出收入用途的两项可核验信息。

title: 宽带覆盖不等于人人能上网
scene: 社区组织者与服务商评估公共宽带项目。
objective: 区分基础覆盖、费用、设备与使用能力。
grammar: having access to 与 being able to use 区分条件：Having access to a network does not ensure usable service. 动名词短语作主语。

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The broadband project reports complete coverage, yet several families still cannot reliably attend online appointments or submit school assignments.
宽带项目报告全面覆盖，但一些家庭仍无法可靠参加线上预约或提交作业。
B
Coverage usually describes where a connection can be supplied, whereas meaningful access also depends on price, equipment, and usable speeds.
覆盖通常指哪里可提供连接，而有效接入还取决于价格、设备和可用速度。
A
The cheapest plan slows considerably during busy evenings, which is exactly when children need to complete their homework.
最便宜套餐在繁忙晚间明显变慢，而孩子正要那时完成作业。
B
Then advertised maximum speed may be a poor indicator of the service households actually experience at the times that matter.
那么广告最高速度可能无法体现家庭在关键时段的实际服务。
A
Could the project measure reliability during typical use instead of relying entirely on whether a cable reaches each street?
项目能否测量典型使用时可靠性，而不完全依赖电缆是否通到每条街？
B
Yes, and affordability should include installation fees and device costs rather than looking only at the monthly subscription price.
可以，可负担性还应包括安装与设备费，而不只看月费。
A
Some residents also need assistance setting up accounts, although they hesitate to share passwords with volunteers they barely know.
一些居民需要协助设置账户，但不愿把密码交给不熟悉志愿者。
B
Support should teach people to manage their own credentials, with clear boundaries that protect privacy and avoid unnecessary access to personal information.
支持应教会管理自己的凭证，以清楚边界保护隐私并避免不必要接触个人信息。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
Having access to a network does not ensure usable service if the household cannot afford a device or maintain a stable connection.
如果家庭负担不起设备或无法维持稳定连接，有网络接入也不保证可用服务。
B
That distinction helps us identify where the remaining barrier lies, rather than declaring the project finished after infrastructure installation.
这个区别帮助找到剩余障碍，而非基础设施安装后就宣布项目完成。
A
Would a loan program solve the equipment problem, or might short borrowing periods interrupt schoolwork and ongoing job applications?
借用计划能解决设备问题吗，还是过短借期会打断学习和持续求职？
B
The design should follow the duration of real needs, with clear renewal arrangements and support when a borrowed device stops working.
设计应遵循真实需求时长，提供明确续借安排以及设备故障支持。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
We should ask residents to complete common tasks during evaluation, such as joining a call or uploading a document.
评估时应让居民完成常见任务，例如加入通话或上传文件。
B
Those practical tests can reveal obstacles that a map of network availability would never show on its own.
实际测试能揭示网络可用地图单独无法呈现的障碍。
A
I will propose a dashboard separating physical coverage, affordable subscriptions, reliable performance, and independent use of essential online services.
我会提议看板，分别呈现物理覆盖、可负担订阅、可靠性能和独立使用必要服务。
B
Then progress can be reported honestly, with completed infrastructure recognized alongside the work still required for effective digital participation.
这样既认可建成基础设施，也如实报告实现有效数字参与还需做什么。

practice.speaking: 解释一个全面覆盖却仍有数字排斥的社区案例，为费用、设备、性能和技能各提一项检查。
practice.writing: 写160–180词项目评估，用动名词短语作主语，说明为何基础建设完成不等于居民能完成线上事务。

listening.question: 为什么仅公布最高网速不足以评价家庭使用体验？
listening.answer: 家庭在关键晚间可能遇到明显降速，最高值无法代表实际时段的稳定表现。

practice.review: 为覆盖、费用、性能、独立使用四个层次分别定义一个可观察指标。

title: 居民预算会由谁发声
scene: 市政人员与社区协调员改进参与式预算。
objective: 评估公开参与是否真正覆盖受影响群体。
grammar: whose voices are missing 用间接疑问嵌入句子：We must ask whose voices are missing. 从句采用陈述语序。

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The participatory budget meeting was open to everyone, but most attendees belonged to the same neighborhood association.
参与式预算会议向所有人开放，但多数参加者来自同一个社区协会。
B
An open invitation is a useful starting point, although it does not guarantee that different groups can participate on equal terms.
公开邀请是好起点，但不保证不同群体能同等参与。
A
The meeting began during the evening shift at nearby workplaces, and no childcare or remote contribution option was available.
会议在附近单位晚班期间开始，也没有儿童照护或远程提交选项。
B
Those practical barriers may explain part of the imbalance, so we should ask whose voices are missing before interpreting the vote.
这些实际障碍可能解释部分失衡，因此解读投票前应问哪些声音缺席。
A
Some residents also said the budget documents were difficult to understand, especially the distinction between construction costs and ongoing maintenance.
一些居民说预算文件难懂，尤其不清楚建设成本与持续维护的区别。
B
Accessible summaries could help, provided they retain the important tradeoffs instead of simplifying every proposal into an attractive slogan.
易懂摘要会有帮助，前提是保留重要取舍，而非把每项提案简化成漂亮口号。
A
Could small discussion groups allow quieter participants to develop questions before speaking in front of the entire room?
小组讨论能否让较少发言的人在面对全场前先组织问题？
B
Yes, and facilitators should prevent a few confident speakers from dominating, while avoiding the assumption that silence automatically means agreement.
可以，主持人还应防止少数自信者垄断，并避免把沉默自动当作同意。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
We also need to explain which decisions residents can actually influence, because consultation without meaningful authority can create false expectations.
还要说明居民究竟能影响哪些决定，因为无实权咨询会造成错误期待。
B
Exactly, if legal or technical constraints rule out an option, state those boundaries early and explain the reasons in understandable terms.
没错，如果法律或技术约束排除某选项，应早说明边界并清楚解释理由。
A
Would allowing comments across several days improve access for people who cannot attend a single scheduled meeting?
允许连续几天提交意见，是否能改善无法参加单次定时会议者的参与？
B
It could, although online and in-person contributions need comparable consideration so one channel does not become merely symbolic.
可能，但线上与线下意见应获得相称考虑，避免某渠道只具象征性。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
After the vote, the council should publish how the selected project will be delivered and how progress can be checked.
投票后议会应公布所选项目如何实施，以及如何检查进度。
B
And explain what happened to the other proposals, particularly where useful ideas might be incorporated into later work.
也要解释其他提案去向，尤其说明哪些有用想法可能纳入后续工作。
A
That follow-up would show participants that their time contributed to a visible process rather than disappearing into an unexplained decision.
这种跟进能让参与者看到自己的时间贡献于可见流程，而非消失在不明决定中。
B
Fair participation requires attention to entry, discussion, influence, and accountability, with evidence collected at each stage instead of counting attendance alone.
公平参与需要关注进入、讨论、影响和问责，各阶段都收集证据，而非只数到场人数。

practice.speaking: 主持一段预算讨论开场，说明实际决定权、三种参与渠道，以及如何保障不爱发言者的意见。
practice.writing: 写160–180词参与流程改进建议，嵌入 whose voices are missing，并给出投票后问责安排。

listening.question: 公开邀请为什么不能证明参与已经公平？
listening.answer: 工作时段、照护、资料难度和发言机会等障碍可能让部分群体无法有效参加。

practice.review: 按进入、讨论、影响、反馈四阶段各提出一项措施，不能只用出席人数作为成功标准。

title: 咖啡消费与学习时长
scene: 研究小组讨论校园商店数据中的相关性。
objective: 识别相关、反向因果与第三变量，并提出验证设计。
grammar: the fact that...does not mean... 反驳跳跃推论：The fact that two measures move together does not mean one causes the other. 主语从句与谓语衔接清晰。

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
Our hypothetical campus dataset shows that students buying more coffee also tend to report longer study hours during exam week.
假想校园数据中，买更多咖啡的学生在考试周也往往报告更长学习时间。
B
That association does not establish whether coffee increases studying, whether studying increases coffee purchases, or whether another factor influences both.
这种关联不能确定是咖啡增加学习、学习增加购咖啡，还是另一因素同时影响两者。
A
Exam pressure could be a confounder because students facing harder schedules may both study longer and buy more drinks.
考试压力可能是混杂因素，因为课业更难的学生可能既学更久又买更多饮品。
B
Exactly, and self-reported study hours may contain measurement error if students estimate their time differently or include frequent breaks.
没错，自报时长也可能有测量误差，因为估时方式不同，或把频繁休息也算进去。
A
Would comparing students within the same course help reduce differences caused by exam difficulty and assignment deadlines?
在同一课程内比较学生，能否减少考试难度和作业期限带来的差异？
B
It could improve comparability, but motivation, sleep, and access to quiet study space might still differ between those students.
能改善可比性，但动机、睡眠和安静学习空间仍可能不同。
A
So controlling for one variable would not automatically remove every alternative explanation for the relationship in the data.
因此控制一个变量不会自动排除数据关系的所有其他解释。
B
Correct, a statistical adjustment is only as useful as the assumptions, measurements, and relevant factors included in the analysis.
正确，统计调整是否有用取决于分析中的假设、测量和相关因素。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
The fact that two measures move together does not mean one causes the other, even when the pattern looks strong.
两个指标同步变化不意味着一者导致另一者，即使模式看起来很强。
B
We should also avoid assuming that longer study time means better learning, since efficiency and comprehension are separate outcomes.
还应避免认为学习更久就是学得更好，因为效率与理解是不同结果。
A
Could a diary study record timing, sleep, and study activities to clarify which changes tend to occur first?
日记研究能否记录时间、睡眠和学习活动，澄清哪些变化通常先发生？
B
That would add useful detail, although temporal order alone still would not eliminate confounding or establish a complete causal explanation.
能增加细节，但仅有时间顺序仍无法排除混杂或确立完整因果解释。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Then our report should describe the observed association and explain what additional evidence would strengthen or weaken competing explanations.
那么报告应描述观察关联，并解释哪些额外证据会加强或削弱竞争解释。
B
Yes, and resist turning a convenient pattern into advice that students should simply drink more coffee before examinations.
是，还要避免把方便的模式变成建议学生考试前多喝咖啡。
A
I will draw a diagram with arrows representing the possible directions, labeling each one as a hypothesis rather than a confirmed mechanism.
我会画箭头图表示可能方向，并把每条标为假设而非已确认机制。
B
That makes the reasoning explicit and helps readers see why a careful conclusion can be informative without claiming causation.
这样推理更明确，读者也能看到谨慎结论即使不声称因果仍有信息价值。

practice.speaking: 围绕假想咖啡与学习数据口述三种可能的因果解释（咖啡影响学习、学习影响购咖啡、第三因素同时影响两者），并解释为何更长时长不是学习效果的完整指标。
practice.writing: 写160–180词数据解读，使用 the fact that...does not mean...，提出一种后续研究并承认其限制。

listening.question: 即使先喝咖啡后学习更久，为什么仍不足以证明因果？
listening.answer: 考试压力等第三因素可能先影响两者，时间先后本身不能排除混杂。

practice.review: 画出咖啡、学习、考试压力三个节点的可能箭头，并逐个说明哪些只是待验证假设。

title: 平均等待时间隐藏了谁
scene: 服务中心经理与分析员解读等待时间报表。
objective: 比较均值、中位数与分组分布，识别总体改善下的局部恶化。
grammar: whereas 连接可比群体：Online requests became faster, whereas walk-in cases took longer. 同一指标同一时间范围才能公平对照。

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The service center's average waiting time fell in our sample report, yet several residents say the new system feels slower.
示例报告中服务中心平均等待下降，但一些居民说新系统感觉更慢。
B
Both statements could be true if quick online requests improved while complex walk-in cases experienced longer delays.
如果简单线上申请加快，复杂现场事务更慢，两种说法都可能真实。
A
Then the overall average might conceal differences between groups instead of showing that every visitor received better service.
那么总体平均可能隐藏群体差异，而不是显示每位访客服务都改善。
B
Exactly, and a change in the mix of requests could lower the average even without faster handling within any category.
没错，即使每类处理都没加快，申请类型比例变化也可能拉低平均。
A
Would the median be more informative because a few extremely long waits can pull the mean upward?
中位数是否更有参考性，因为少数极长等待会拉高均值？
B
It adds another perspective, but replacing one summary with another still leaves important information about the distribution unexamined.
它增加视角，但以一个摘要替代另一个，仍遗漏分布的重要信息。
A
We could show typical waiting time alongside the proportion of cases exceeding a clearly defined service standard.
可以同时展示典型等待时间，以及超出明确定义服务标准的案件比例。
B
And break those measures down by channel and case complexity, while keeping categories consistent across the periods being compared.
并按渠道与复杂程度拆分，同时保证不同期间的类别一致。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
Online requests became faster, whereas walk-in cases took longer, so the overall improvement should be described with that qualification.
线上申请变快，现场事务变慢，因此总体改善应带上这个限定。
B
We should also inspect whether abandoned visits are excluded, because people who leave before being served may have waited especially long.
还应检查是否排除中途离开者，因为未办成就离开的人可能等得特别久。
A
If those visitors disappear from the dataset, the reported waiting time could look better while the experience becomes worse.
若他们从数据中消失，报告等待可能更好看，而体验却更差。
B
That possibility makes the definition of a completed case essential when interpreting trends or comparing performance across service centers.
因此解释趋势或跨中心比较时，完成案件的定义至关重要。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Could we publish a small set of complementary indicators instead of rewarding staff for reducing a single average?
能否公布几个互补指标，而不是只因降低一个平均值就奖励员工？
B
Yes, provided the set remains understandable and each measure connects to a practical aspect of the service people actually need.
可以，只要指标组易懂，每项都对应人们实际需要的服务方面。
A
I will revise the dashboard to include group differences, unusually long waits, and the number of visits ending without service.
我会修改看板，加入群体差异、异常长等待和未获服务就离开的访问数。
B
Then the improvement claim can reflect the full experience more honestly, including the residents whose difficulties an overall average previously hid.
这样改善说法能更如实反映完整体验，包括此前被平均掩盖的居民困难。

practice.speaking: 向服务中心主管解释总体等待改善与居民抱怨可以并存，至少提供两种数据机制。
practice.writing: 写160–180词看板修订方案，使用 whereas，并同时考虑分组差异、长尾等待与中途放弃者。

listening.question: 为什么排除没等到服务就离开的人，会让等待指标产生偏差？
listening.answer: 这些人可能等待很久；排除后平均值看起来更好，却漏掉严重体验问题。

practice.review: 用自己的话区分均值、中位数和超时比例，并为每项说明能看见与看不见什么。

title: 预警系统的误报账
scene: 运营分析员与经理用假想设备预警演示基础概率。
objective: 利用自然频数理解基础发生率、误报与警报可信度。
grammar: out of 加总数表达自然频数：Eight out of eighteen alerts correspond to failures. 分母必须说明是全部设备还是全部警报。

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
Suppose we monitor a thousand machines, and only ten would actually fail during the period covered by our hypothetical example.
假设监测一千台机器，例子涵盖期间实际只有十台会故障。
B
If the warning system identifies eight of those ten failures, it misses two machines that still need attention.
若预警识别十次故障中的八次，就漏掉两台仍需关注的机器。
A
Now suppose ten healthy machines also trigger alerts, even though none of them will fail during that same period.
再假设十台健康机器也报警，虽然它们在同一期间都不会故障。
B
Then eighteen alerts are issued altogether, but only eight correspond to genuine failures in this deliberately simplified scenario.
那么共发十八次警报，但在这个刻意简化情境中，只有八次对应真实故障。
A
That means fewer than half the alerts identify actual failures, despite the system detecting most of the failures that occur.
这意味着不到一半警报指向真实故障，尽管系统检测出大多数实际故障。
B
Exactly, the base rate matters because even a modest number of false alarms can dominate when the event is uncommon.
没错，基础发生率很重要，因为事件少见时，即使误报不多也可能占多数。
A
I had confused the proportion of failures detected with the probability of failure after receiving an alert.
我把检测到的故障比例，与收到警报后发生故障的概率混淆了。
B
Those are different conditional questions, and using natural frequencies helps reveal which group belongs in each denominator.
这是不同条件问题，用自然频数能看清各分母该用哪个群体。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
Eight out of eighteen alerts correspond to failures, whereas eight out of ten failures generate alerts in this example.
例子里十八个警报中八个对应故障，而十个故障中八个会产生警报。
B
Neither measure alone determines whether the system is useful, since inspection costs and the consequences of missed failures also matter.
任何单一指标都不能决定系统是否有用，因为检查成本与漏检后果也重要。
A
If inspecting a machine is cheap but an undetected failure is costly, accepting some false alarms may be reasonable.
如果检查便宜而漏掉故障代价高，接受一些误报可能合理。
B
Yes, although too many unnecessary inspections can still consume staff time and delay responses to the most urgent problems.
是，不过过多不必要检查仍会消耗人手，并延误最紧急问题的处理。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Could we prioritize alerts using additional information rather than treating every warning as an equally certain prediction of failure?
能否用额外信息安排警报优先级，而不是把每次预警都当成同样确定的故障预测？
B
Potentially, but the revised process should be evaluated on new examples so it does not merely fit the cases already examined.
可以考虑，但修订流程应在新例子上评估，避免只是适配看过的案例。
A
I will present a simple count table showing actual condition and alert status, with the hypothetical assumptions stated beside it.
我会展示实际状态与警报状态的计数表，并在旁边注明假想条件。
B
That will make the tradeoff understandable without allowing an impressive detection rate to stand in for a complete assessment.
这样能让取舍易懂，避免用亮眼检测率代替完整评估。

practice.speaking: 不用公式，用一千台机器、十次故障、八次真警报、十次误报解释两个不同条件概率。
practice.writing: 写160–180词运营备忘录，使用 out of 表达自然频数，明确8/10与8/18各回答什么问题，并讨论检查成本与漏检代价。

listening.question: 这个假想例子一共有多少警报，其中多少对应真实故障？
listening.answer: 共有18个警报，其中8个对应真实故障；另外10个是健康机器误报。

practice.review: 独立画出2×2计数表：真阳性8、假阴性2、假阳性10、真阴性980，并检查总数1000。

title: 页面实验真的改善学习了吗
scene: 学习网站产品经理与研究员审查随机实验。
objective: 比较代理指标与最终目标，识别随机实验的适用边界。
grammar: even when 表示在已发生或反复条件下的让步：Even when clicks increase, comprehension may remain unchanged. 避免将中间行为直接当作目标成果。

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
Our learning site randomly assigned visitors to two lesson pages, and the redesigned version received more clicks on the practice button.
学习网站随机将访客分到两个课程页，新设计的练习按钮获得更多点击。
B
That suggests the layout influenced clicking, but our main objective is whether learners understand and retain the material more effectively.
这提示布局影响点击，但主要目标是学习者是否更有效理解并记住材料。
A
The button was brighter and moved above the introduction, so some clicks may have happened before users understood the task.
按钮更亮并移到介绍上方，因此有些点击可能发生在用户理解任务前。
B
Then click-through rate is a proxy metric, and we need evidence that it reflects the educational outcome we actually care about.
那么点击率是代理指标，需要证据说明它反映真正关心的教育结果。
A
Could we compare completion quality and a short delayed recall task, rather than declaring success from the first interaction alone?
能否比较完成质量和简短延迟回忆，而不是仅凭首次互动宣布成功？
B
Yes, while specifying those outcomes before examining more results so the team does not keep searching for favorable differences.
可以，但应在查看更多结果前明确指标，避免团队不断寻找有利差异。
A
We also stopped the test as soon as the chart looked positive, although the original plan called for a longer observation period.
我们在图表看起来积极时就停止测试，尽管原计划要求更长观察。
B
That stopping decision can complicate interpretation, so the report should disclose it and avoid presenting the estimate as more settled than it is.
停止决定会使解释复杂化，因此报告应披露，避免把估计表现得过于确定。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
Even when clicks increase, comprehension may remain unchanged, especially if the design encourages rapid movement without thoughtful engagement.
即使点击增加，理解也可能不变，尤其设计鼓励快速跳转而不认真参与时。
B
We should examine that possibility with meaningful learning measures instead of assuming more activity automatically represents more progress.
应以有意义学习指标检查这种可能，而非假定更多活动自动代表更多进步。
A
Would random assignment mean the results apply equally to experienced learners, beginners, and people studying on small mobile screens?
随机分组是否意味着结果同样适用于熟练者、初学者和小屏手机学习者？
B
It supports comparison within the experiment, but generalization still depends on who participated and the conditions under which they used the pages.
它支持实验内部比较，但推广仍取决于谁参与，以及他们使用页面的条件。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Then we should check important user groups without inventing a new success story from every small subgroup difference.
那么应检查重要用户群体，但不能从每个小组差异中编出新的成功故事。
B
Exactly, exploratory findings can guide future tests, provided they are labeled clearly and not confused with conclusions specified in advance.
没错，探索发现可指导后续测试，前提是清楚标注，不与预先指定结论混淆。
A
I will recommend another planned test with comprehension as the main outcome and accessibility checks built into the evaluation.
我会建议再次计划性测试，以理解为主要指标，并把无障碍检查纳入评估。
B
That connects the design decision to the purpose of the product while preserving what the initial experiment actually taught us.
这样既把设计决定与产品目的连接，也保留初次实验实际提供的认识。

practice.speaking: 向产品团队做两分钟实验复盘，区分点击与理解，解释提前停止和推广到其他用户的限制。
practice.writing: 写160–180词后续实验建议，使用 even when，定义一个主要学习指标和两个解释边界。

listening.question: 随机分组为什么不能保证结论适用于所有学习者？
listening.answer: 它帮助实验内部比较，但外部适用性仍取决于参与者构成和实际使用条件。

practice.review: 将点击、完成质量、延迟记忆分成不同层次，并写出查看新结果前就应确定的研究决定。

title: 预测区间与决策门槛
scene: 社区活动组织者与分析员讨论天气相关需求预测。
objective: 区分点预测、区间、情境与决策代价。
grammar: would rather 加动词原形表达风险偏好：We would rather rent spare chairs than turn visitors away. 说明偏好背后的成本比较。

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The forecast estimates attendance at our outdoor event, but the planning team wants one precise number for chairs and refreshments.
预测估计户外活动人数，但筹划团队想要一个精确数字来安排椅子与茶点。
B
A single estimate is convenient, yet uncertainty about weather and competing events means actual attendance could differ substantially.
单个估计方便，但天气和其他活动的不确定性可能让实际人数差很多。
A
Could we present a central estimate with a plausible range, making clear what assumptions produce the lower and upper scenarios?
能否给中心估计和合理范围，说明哪些假设产生较低与较高情境？
B
Yes, though a scenario range and a statistical prediction interval are not interchangeable, so we should label the method accurately.
可以，但情境范围与统计预测区间不能互换，因此应准确标注方法。
A
Our current model uses only previous events at this venue, which may not reflect the effect of the new bus service.
当前模型只用同场地往期活动，可能无法反映新公交服务影响。
B
That change could make historical patterns less reliable, especially if easier transport attracts visitors who rarely attended before.
这个改变可能降低历史规律可靠性，尤其交通便利吸引了以前很少来的游客。
A
Should we add a fixed percentage simply because the bus now stops beside the entrance?
是否可以仅因公交停在入口旁，就直接增加一个固定百分比？
B
Only if there is a defensible basis; otherwise, present that possibility as a separate assumption and examine how it changes the decision.
只有有依据才行；否则应单列为假设，检查它如何改变决定。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
We would rather rent some spare chairs than turn visitors away, because the consequences of underestimating attendance seem more disruptive.
我们宁愿多租一些椅子，也不愿拒绝游客，因为低估人数的后果似乎更麻烦。
B
That preference belongs in the decision rule, while the forecast itself should remain an honest estimate rather than being inflated to feel safer.
这种偏好应进入决策规则，预测本身仍应诚实估计，而不是为了安心而抬高。
A
For perishable refreshments, the tradeoff may differ because unused supplies create waste and cannot necessarily be returned afterward.
易腐茶点的取舍可能不同，因为剩余会浪费，事后也未必能退。
B
Exactly, the same attendance forecast can support different purchasing decisions when shortages and leftovers carry different costs for each item.
没错，同一个人数预测，在缺货与剩余成本不同时，可以支持不同采购决定。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Could a flexible supplier agreement let us adjust quantities after checking registrations and the weather closer to the event?
灵活供应协议能否让我们在临近活动核查报名和天气后调整数量？
B
That would reduce exposure to uncertainty, provided the adjustment deadline and any additional charges are agreed before we rely on that flexibility.
能降低不确定性风险，前提是事先约定调整截止时间与额外收费。
A
Afterward, we should compare the forecast with attendance and record which assumptions failed, rather than judging accuracy from one event alone.
事后应比较预测与人数，记录哪些假设失效，而非仅以一次活动评价准确性。
B
Over repeated events, that record can improve calibration and help the team choose sensible safeguards without demanding impossible certainty.
经过多次活动，记录能改善校准，帮助团队采取合理保障，而不要求不可能的确定性。

practice.speaking: 为户外活动说明人数预测与椅子、茶点采购的不同决策，明确两种缺货或剩余成本。
practice.writing: 写160–180词筹备备忘录，使用 would rather，区分预测、风险偏好和灵活供应安排。

listening.question: 为什么不应为让团队更安心而直接抬高人数预测？
listening.answer: 预测应诚实反映预期；宁可多备椅子的风险偏好应体现在采购规则，而非篡改预测。

practice.review: 用三句话分别写预测、假设、决策规则；准确解释情境范围不必等同于统计预测区间。

title: 招聘算法中的公平
scene: 招聘经理与数据分析员评估自动筛选工具
objective: 区分效率与公平，提出可执行的审查条件
grammar: 让步从句 although / even if；被动语态限定责任

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The screening tool reduced our workload, but several qualified applicants were rejected because their resumes contained gaps in employment.
筛选工具减轻了工作量，但几名合格申请者因简历有就业空档被淘汰。
B
Those gaps could reflect caregiving responsibilities, so treating them as evidence of low commitment may introduce an unfair bias.
空档可能来自照护责任，把它当作投入不足的证据会引入不公平的偏见。
A
The vendor claims its model is objective because it never receives information about an applicant's gender or family circumstances.
供应商声称模型客观，因为它不接收申请者性别或家庭情况。
B
Excluding those fields does not guarantee fairness if other variables act as a proxy for the information we removed.
若其他变量成为被删信息的替代指标，去除字段也无法保证公平。
A
Would an audit of rejected applications reveal whether particular groups are disproportionately affected, even without knowing the model's internal logic?
即使不知道模型内部逻辑，审查被拒申请能否发现某些群体受到不成比例的影响？
B
It would reveal patterns worth investigating, although we would need a clear benchmark before deciding which differences require intervention.
它能揭示值得调查的模式，不过判断哪些差异需要干预之前要有明确基准。
A
Then we should retain human oversight and let applicants request a review, especially when an unusual career path triggers rejection.
那我们应保留人工监督，让申请者要求复核，尤其是非典型履历导致拒绝时。
B
Agreed, provided that reviewers can actually reverse decisions and are given enough time to examine the evidence independently of the model's recommendation.
同意，前提是复核人员确实能推翻决定，且有足够时间不依赖模型建议独立检查证据。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
Efficiency is a legitimate objective, but it should not outweigh our obligation to explain consequential decisions to the people affected.
效率是合理目标，但不应超过我们向受影响者解释重大决定的义务。
B
In other words, the issue is not whether automation makes mistakes, but whether its mistakes can be identified and challenged.
换言之，问题在于自动化的错误能否被发现并受到质疑。
A
If every rejected candidate received the same generic explanation, our appeal process would exist on paper without offering meaningful accountability.
若每位被拒者都收到同样的笼统解释，申诉流程只会停留在纸面，无法提供真正问责。
B
We could begin with a limited pilot and publish the criteria used to decide whether the system should remain in service.
我们可以先小规模试行，并公布决定系统是否继续使用的标准。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Suppose the tool performs well overall but consistently overlooks older applicants; what additional evidence would justify suspending its use immediately?
假设工具总体表现良好，却持续忽略年长申请者，什么补充证据足以支持立即停用？
B
I would compare similarly qualified candidates and examine whether the gap persists after relevant experience and job requirements are considered.
我会比较资历相近的候选人，检查考虑相关经验和岗位要求后差距是否仍存在。
A
A temporary suspension would be proportionate if the pattern were substantial and the company could continue recruitment through an alternative process.
若差异明显且公司能通过其他流程继续招聘，暂时停用就是相称措施。
B
The final recommendation should acknowledge uncertainty while specifying who investigates complaints, what records are kept, and when the policy is reviewed.
最终建议应承认不确定性，同时说明谁调查投诉、保存哪些记录以及何时复查政策。

practice.speaking: 用两分钟向招聘总监提出是否继续试用算法的建议，包含风险、证据门槛、申诉流程和一项反方观点。
practice.writing: 写 250 词议论文：企业是否应该被要求解释由自动系统作出的招聘决定？明确立场，讨论效率代价并提出边界。

listening.question: B 为什么认为删除性别字段仍不能保证公平？
listening.answer: 其他变量可能间接代表性别或家庭情况，因此模型仍可能产生偏见。

practice.review: 录音中说清至少两种公平保障；检查是否把模型客观这一供应商主张误写成已证事实。

title: 健康应用的同意边界
scene: 产品设计师与用户代表讨论健康数据授权
objective: 区分形式同意与知情同意，提出分层授权方案
grammar: 条件从句 unless / as long as；名词从句说明范围

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
Our wellness app asks users to accept a single agreement covering exercise records, sleep patterns, and optional location tracking.
健康应用让用户一次接受涵盖运动、睡眠和可选位置追踪的协议。
B
Bundling those permissions makes consent convenient for the company, but users may not understand what they are actually agreeing to.
捆绑权限让公司更方便，但用户未必明白究竟同意了什么。
A
We already provide a privacy policy, although the document is long and most people continue without opening it at all.
我们已经提供隐私政策，不过文件很长，多数人根本不打开就继续操作。
B
Disclosure alone is insufficient if the design discourages careful reading or makes refusal considerably harder than acceptance for ordinary users.
如果设计妨碍细读，或让拒绝明显比接受更难，仅仅披露并不够。
A
Would separate permission screens solve the problem, or would they simply overwhelm people with decisions before they can try the app?
分开授权页面能解决问题吗，还是会让人尚未体验应用就被决策压垮？
B
A layered explanation could help: describe the immediate purpose briefly, then offer more detail whenever a user requests it.
分层说明可能有帮助：简述当前用途，用户需要时再提供细节。
A
We also need a retention limit, because storing sensitive records indefinitely creates risks even when their original collection was justified.
我们还需要保存期限，因为即使最初收集合情合理，无限保存敏感记录也会带来风险。
B
And withdrawal should be straightforward; people must be able to revoke optional access without losing features that do not require it.
撤回应简单直接；用户应能取消可选授权，同时保留无需该授权的功能。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
There is a distinction between data that improves the core service and data collected primarily for commercial partnerships with advertisers.
改善核心服务的数据与主要为广告商业合作收集的数据有所区别。
B
That distinction should be visible at the moment of choice, rather than buried in language about enhancing the user experience.
这种区别应在选择当下清楚呈现，不能藏在所谓改善用户体验的表述里。
A
Even if personalized recommendations are useful, their value does not automatically justify sharing identifiable records with unrelated businesses without separate permission.
即使个性化建议有用，其价值也不能自动证明未经单独许可向无关企业分享可识别记录合理。
B
We can evaluate the revised design by asking users to explain each permission in their own words before making a decision.
我们可让用户在决定前用自己的话解释各项授权，以评估新版设计。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Imagine a teenager shares a phone with a parent; how might notification previews expose information that the account settings technically protect?
假设青少年与家长共用手机，通知预览如何暴露账户设置在技术上保护的信息？
B
The device context matters, so privacy defaults should account for shared screens instead of assuming every phone belongs to one person.
设备使用情境很重要，隐私默认设置应考虑共享屏幕，不能假设每部手机只供一人使用。
A
I would disable sensitive previews initially and explain how to enable them, while keeping ordinary reminders available to every user.
我会默认关闭敏感预览并说明开启方法，同时让所有人继续使用普通提醒。
B
Our success measure should include comprehension and control, because a higher acceptance rate may merely indicate that refusal has become less obvious.
成功指标应包括理解和控制权，因为更高接受率可能只说明拒绝选项更难找到。

practice.speaking: 扮演设计师，用 90 秒介绍一套健康应用授权流程，解释首次使用、撤回权限和共享设备三种情境。
practice.writing: 写 180 词产品备忘录，提出三个隐私设计改动；每项写出用户收益和可能增加的操作成本。

listening.question: 为什么接受率提高不一定代表授权设计更好？
listening.answer: 它可能由更隐蔽的拒绝选项造成，并不意味着用户理解更多或获得更多控制。

practice.review: 独立解释 consent、disclosure、control 的区别；备忘录每项建议均需有具体用户操作。

title: 创作工具与署名
scene: 编辑与插画师讨论生成式工具的使用说明
objective: 在创作效率、贡献归属和透明度之间作出限定判断
grammar: 过去完成时追溯来源；what 从句突出争点

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The magazine wants a cover by Friday, and the art director suggested using a generated image as the starting point.
杂志周五前要封面，美术总监建议以生成图片作为起点。
B
I could refine the composition, but we should establish provenance before presenting the finished illustration as entirely original human artwork.
我可以完善构图，但在将成品称为完全原创的人类作品前，应确定其来源。
A
The deadline is tight, and the editor worries that a detailed disclosure would distract readers from the article's environmental message.
时间紧，编辑担心详细披露会分散读者对文章环境主题的注意力。
B
Transparency need not dominate the cover; a concise production note could explain which elements were generated and which I created.
透明说明无需占据封面；简短制作说明可解释哪些部分是生成的，哪些由我创作。
A
What concerns me more is attribution, especially if the proposed image closely resembles a living artist's recognizable visual language.
我更担心署名问题，尤其当图片非常像某位在世艺术家有辨识度的视觉风格时。
B
Then we should revise the brief around specific visual qualities, such as muted colors and geometric forms, rather than naming an artist.
那应围绕低饱和色彩和几何形状等具体视觉特点改写要求，而不是点名艺术家。
A
Could we document the revisions so that the final credit reflects your contribution without implying that every pixel was drawn manually?
我们能否记录修改过程，让最终署名体现你的贡献，又不暗示每个像素都由手绘完成？
B
Yes, and I would prefer an agreement that defines permitted reuse, because a cover commission should not automatically authorize unlimited adaptations.
可以，我也希望协议界定允许的再利用范围，因为封面委托不应自动授权无限改编。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
The ethical question extends beyond whether a particular workflow is efficient; it also concerns the expectations created by the published credit.
伦理问题不只关乎流程效率，还涉及公开署名让读者产生的预期。
B
Readers might reasonably infer that an illustrator controlled the whole process, unless the publication clarifies the role of automated assistance.
除非出版物说明自动辅助的作用，读者可能合理推断插画师控制了整个过程。
A
Had we discussed the workflow before accepting the commission, we could have avoided the current uncertainty about payment and ownership.
如果接受委托前讨论过流程，就能避免如今关于报酬和归属的不确定。
B
For future projects, the contract should distinguish creative direction, technical execution, and licensing, since those contributions may belong to different parties.
今后的合同应区分创意指导、技术执行和授权，因为这些贡献可能属于不同参与方。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Consider a museum that labels a restored painting without mentioning extensive digital reconstruction; what would visitors be likely to misunderstand?
假设博物馆给修复画作标注时不提大量数字重建，参观者可能误解什么？
B
They might confuse a plausible reconstruction with surviving historical evidence, especially where the original material had been damaged beyond recognition.
他们可能把合理重建误认为保存下来的历史证据，尤其是原材料已损毁到无法辨认的地方。
A
A useful label would identify the uncertain areas while allowing visitors to appreciate the restoration as an interpretation informed by evidence.
有用的标签应标出不确定区域，同时让参观者把修复看作基于证据的诠释。
B
That approach preserves the audience's ability to judge the work, which is a stronger justification for disclosure than simply avoiding criticism.
这种做法保留观众判断作品的能力，比单纯避免批评更能支持披露。

practice.speaking: 讨论创作者使用自动工具时应如何署名。用杂志和博物馆两个不同例子说明透明度的作用，并承认一个实际困难。
practice.writing: 写 250 词议论文：使用生成工具制作的公共艺术作品是否都应附制作说明？区分必要披露和过度细节。

listening.question: 插画师为什么要求记录修改过程？
listening.answer: 为了准确体现其贡献，并避免署名错误暗示全部画面由人工绘制。

practice.review: 用一句话分别表达来源、贡献和使用权；检查是否把伦理判断误写为已确认的法律规定。

title: 校园刷脸的比例原则
scene: 校方与学生代表评估食堂识别系统
objective: 比较安全收益与侵入程度，用替代方案检验必要性
grammar: 比较结构 no more than；条件倒装与限定性关系从句

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The school proposes facial recognition at cafeteria entrances after several students used borrowed meal cards during the previous semester here.
上学期有人借饭卡用餐后，学校提议在食堂入口使用人脸识别。
B
Preventing misuse is reasonable, but collecting biometric information seems disproportionate when the problem involves a relatively small number of meals.
防止滥用合理，但面对少量餐费问题，收集生物识别信息似乎不成比例。
A
Administrators argue that the system would shorten lines as well, so they see security and convenience as mutually reinforcing benefits.
管理者认为系统还能缩短排队，因此把安全和便利视为互相加强的收益。
B
We should test that assumption against a less intrusive alternative, such as faster card readers combined with occasional identity checks.
我们应以侵入程度更低的方案检验该假设，例如更快的读卡器配合偶尔身份检查。
A
If participation were voluntary, would that address your concern, or could students still feel pressured to enroll with their classmates?
如果自愿参加，能解决你的担忧吗，还是学生仍会因同学参加而感到压力？
B
A meaningful alternative should require no more waiting time than the biometric option, so students who choose to opt out are not effectively penalized.
真正的替代方案不应比生物识别方案需要更长的等待时间，避免选择退出的学生受到实际惩罚。
A
We have not yet discussed access controls or whether the stored templates could be repurposed for tracking attendance elsewhere on campus.
我们尚未讨论访问控制，以及保存的模板会否被改用于追踪校园其他地方的出勤。
B
That possibility is precisely why the purpose should be narrowly defined before any collection begins, with independent review of proposed changes.
正因此，应在收集开始前严格界定用途，并独立审查任何用途变更。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
A technology can function reliably and still be unsuitable if its social costs exceed the value of the problem it solves.
即使技术可靠运作，若社会成本超过它所解决问题的价值，它仍可能不合适。
B
The relevant comparison is therefore between realistic options, rather than between a flawless new system and an exaggerated description of current failures.
相关比较应发生在现实可行的选项之间，不能一边假设新系统完美，一边夸大现有缺陷。
A
Should the school proceed with a trial, it ought to establish a deletion schedule and a clear threshold for ending the experiment.
如果学校试行，应制定删除时间表和明确的终止门槛。
B
Those safeguards would improve the proposal, although they would not settle the prior question of whether biometric collection is necessary at all.
这些保障能改进方案，但仍不能解决生物信息收集是否必要这一前提问题。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Imagine the same technology at a laboratory containing dangerous materials; which features of that setting might change your assessment of proportionality?
设想同一技术用于存放危险材料的实验室，那里的哪些特点会改变你的比例原则判断？
B
The potential harm of unauthorized entry is greater, so stricter identification may be justified if simpler controls cannot adequately reduce that risk.
未经授权进入的潜在危害更大，因此简单措施无法充分降险时，更严格识别可能合理。
A
However, a stronger security need does not remove the obligation to limit access to records or investigate mistakes affecting legitimate users.
不过更强的安全需求并不免除限制记录访问或调查误伤合法用户的责任。
B
My recommendation would depend on demonstrated necessity, the availability of alternatives, and whether affected people have an effective way to challenge errors.
我的建议取决于已证明的必要性、替代方案可用性以及受影响者能否有效质疑错误。

practice.speaking: 分别评价食堂与危险品实验室是否应使用人脸识别。两分钟内提出统一判断原则，并解释不同结论为何不矛盾。
practice.writing: 写 200 词校务建议书：提出一项替代方案、一项试行退出条件和一项数据保护措施，并解释优先顺序。

listening.question: B 为什么认为自愿参加本身还不够？
listening.answer: 如果退出者只能走明显更慢的队伍，自愿选择就会受到实际惩罚。

practice.review: 不看原文说出必要性、替代方案、比例原则三项判断；录音需包含至少一个限定条件。

title: 推荐系统的公共责任
scene: 平台研究员与社区主持讨论新闻推荐
objective: 分析个人选择与平台激励之间的关系
grammar: 因果链表达；while 引入并行且相反的结果

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
Our discussion forum recommends posts that generate long comment threads, but moderators say the most divisive topics now dominate the homepage.
论坛推荐评论串长的帖子，但管理员说最具分裂性的主题如今占据首页。
B
Engagement is easy to measure, whereas constructive participation is harder to quantify, so the ranking system may reward the wrong behavior.
互动量容易测量，而建设性参与更难量化，所以排序系统可能奖励了错误行为。
A
Some users enjoy heated debates, and removing controversial subjects altogether would make the forum less relevant to issues they care about.
有些用户喜欢激烈辩论，完全移除争议话题会让论坛脱离他们关心的问题。
B
I am not proposing censorship; I am asking whether the system amplifies hostility because hostility happens to keep people clicking.
我并非主张审查，而是问系统是否因为敌意让人持续点击而放大敌意。
A
Could we diversify recommendations by including posts that receive thoughtful replies, even when those discussions attract fewer participants overall that week?
我们能否加入获得认真回复的帖子来丰富推荐，即使那些讨论一周内的参与总数较少？
B
Possibly, but we would need transparent criteria, since labeling one style of disagreement thoughtful can privilege the communication habits of certain groups.
可以，但标准应透明，因为把某种争论风格定义为认真，可能偏向某些群体的沟通习惯。
A
Then a user-controlled setting might help people choose between recent posts, popular discussions, and a broader selection of community perspectives.
那么用户设置可以让人选择最新帖子、热门讨论或范围更广的社区观点。
B
Choice would help, provided the default also receives scrutiny; many people never change settings and may mistake ranking for neutral selection.
选择有帮助，但默认设置也应受审查，因为很多人从不改设置，可能将排序误认作中立选择。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
The platform shapes attention even when it does not create the content, because visibility influences which arguments receive responses and gain momentum.
即使平台不创作内容，它也通过可见度影响哪些论点得到回应并形成势头，从而塑造注意力。
B
That influence creates a responsibility to examine foreseeable consequences without assuming that every unpleasant interaction can or should be prevented online.
这种影响带来审视可预见后果的责任，但不意味着网络上每次不愉快互动都能或都应被阻止。
A
A useful experiment would compare discussion quality across several ranking methods while checking whether minority viewpoints become less visible under each method.
有用的实验会比较几种排序方式的讨论质量，同时检查少数观点是否在各方式下变得更隐蔽。
B
We should publish both improvements and trade-offs, because reporting only a reduction in complaints could conceal a decline in participation.
我们应公布改善和代价，因为只报告投诉减少可能掩盖参与度下降。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Suppose a chronological feed reduces conflict but makes urgent local warnings harder to find; how would you redesign the recommendation policy?
假设按时间排序减少冲突，却让紧急本地预警更难找到，你会如何重设推荐政策？
B
I would separate verified emergency notices from ordinary discussion, using a limited category whose criteria and expiration rules are publicly explained.
我会将核实的紧急通知与普通讨论分开，使用范围有限且公开说明标准和到期规则的类别。
A
That solution introduces editorial judgment, so an appeal mechanism would be necessary when users dispute whether a notice deserves special prominence.
这一方案引入编辑判断，所以用户质疑某通知是否应突出展示时，需要申诉机制。
B
A defensible policy would explain its priorities openly and revise them when evidence reveals harms that the original design failed to anticipate.
可辩护的政策应公开解释优先事项，并在证据揭示原设计未预见的伤害时修订。

practice.speaking: 做三分钟本周伦理总结：任选招聘、隐私或推荐系统，用同一原则比较两项技术决策，明确原则的适用边界。
practice.writing: 写 250 词议论文：社交平台是否应优先推荐能促进建设性讨论的内容，而不是互动量最高的内容？讨论衡量困难。

listening.question: 为什么单看投诉减少可能误导平台？
listening.answer: 投诉减少也可能由用户不再参与造成，不能单独证明讨论质量提升。

practice.review: 选本周八个词口头造句；完成一段包含主张、理由、具体反例和限定结论的录音。

title: 免费公交的机会成本
scene: 市民预算听证会讨论公交补贴
objective: 比较政策受益者，解释预算机会成本
grammar: 假设条件句；比较受益群体的数量词

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The city is considering free buses, but the proposal would use most of the transport budget currently reserved for improving service frequency.
城市考虑公交免费，但方案会用掉当前大部分用于提高班次的交通预算。
B
For residents who already live near frequent routes, removing fares could help; for others, an unreliable service would remain largely unusable.
对住在班次密集线路附近的人，免票有帮助；但对其他人，不可靠的服务仍基本无法使用。
A
Supporters argue that universal access avoids complicated eligibility checks and encourages drivers to reconsider using their cars for short urban trips.
支持者认为普遍享有能避免复杂资格审查，也鼓励驾车者重新考虑城市短途出行方式。
B
That is plausible, although the opportunity cost matters if the same funding could connect neighborhoods that currently have no evening service.
有道理，不过若同样资金能让目前夜间无车的社区通车，机会成本就很重要。
A
Would a targeted discount for low-income passengers preserve enough revenue to expand routes while addressing the strongest affordability concerns first?
给低收入乘客定向优惠，能否在先解决最迫切负担问题的同时，保留足够收入扩展线路？
B
It might, provided the application process is simple and does not exclude eligible residents who lack stable addresses or internet access.
可能可以，前提是申请简单，不排除没有固定地址或上网条件的合格居民。
A
We should also consider drivers and maintenance staff, since promising additional service without funding labor would make the budget internally inconsistent.
也应考虑司机和维修人员，因为承诺增加服务却不支付人工，会让预算自相矛盾。
B
A phased approach could test reduced fares on underserved routes while tracking reliability, ridership, and the proportion of trips replacing car journeys.
分阶段方法可在服务不足线路试行降价，同时追踪可靠性、客流和替代汽车出行的比例。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
The distribution of benefits is as important as the total number of journeys, particularly when public money is intended to reduce exclusion.
收益如何分配与出行总量同样重要，尤其公共资金旨在减少排斥时。
B
A policy described as universal can still benefit central neighborhoods disproportionately if the underlying network remains concentrated around existing commercial districts.
若基础网络仍集中于现有商业区，被称为普惠的政策仍可能让中心社区不成比例地受益。
A
Were funding unlimited, we could improve frequency and eliminate fares simultaneously, but the actual decision requires choosing which constraint to address first.
若资金无限，我们可同时提高班次和免票，但现实决策要求先选出要解决的约束。
B
That choice should follow evidence about missed appointments, rejected job offers, and other consequences of poor access, rather than ridership figures alone.
选择应依据交通不便导致的错过预约、放弃工作机会等后果，而不只依据客流数字。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Imagine a rural district where buses run twice daily; would a free fare change commuting behavior as much as an earlier departure?
假设乡村地区每天只有两班公交，免票对通勤行为的影响能与提前发车一样大吗？
B
Probably not for workers whose shifts begin before the first bus, although lower fares could still matter for occasional nonwork journeys.
对第一班车之前就上班的人大概不会，但低票价对偶尔的非工作出行仍可能重要。
A
I would therefore segment the problem by journey purpose and time of day before deciding whether price or availability is the binding constraint.
因此，我会先按出行目的和时段细分问题，再判断价格还是可用性是主要约束。
B
The recommendation should identify who gains immediately, who remains excluded, and what evidence would justify changing the funding priorities next year.
建议应指出谁立即受益、谁仍被排除，以及什么证据足以支持来年调整资金重点。

practice.speaking: 用两分钟为公交预算排序：免票、增加班次、延长夜间服务三选二，明确谁受益与谁仍被遗漏。
practice.writing: 写 250 词议论文：城市应把有限交通预算优先用于免费公交还是扩大服务范围？论证你的选择并讨论另一方案适用的情境。

listening.question: 为什么城市中心居民可能从普惠免费政策中受益更多？
listening.answer: 现有网络集中于中心地区，郊外居民即使票价为零，也未必有可用线路。

practice.review: 用自己的例子解释机会成本；不得把乘车次数直接等同于政策公平。

title: 旅游增长与居民生活
scene: 海边小镇商户与社区规划员讨论旅游限额
objective: 分析外部成本和地方收益，提出可执行限制
grammar: while / whereas 对比；过去与未来时间框架

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
Weekend visitors have revived several shops on the harbor, yet residents say short-term rentals are making year-round housing increasingly difficult to find.
周末游客让港口商铺复苏，但居民说短租使全年住房越来越难找。
B
The extra spending is valuable, although tourism can generate external costs that never appear in a restaurant's sales figures or booking records.
新增消费有价值，不过旅游也会产生餐厅销售或预订记录中看不到的外部成本。
A
Some business owners oppose any visitor cap because they invested in larger premises when the town actively promoted itself as a destination.
有些商户反对游客上限，因为小镇主动推广旅游时，他们曾投资扩大经营场所。
B
Their expectations deserve consideration, but past promotion does not oblige the community to accept unlimited congestion or the loss of essential workers.
其预期值得考虑，但过去的推广不意味着社区必须接受无限拥堵或基本服务员工流失。
A
Could a visitor levy fund public restrooms and late buses, so tourists contribute to the infrastructure their presence places under pressure?
游客附加费能否资助公共厕所和晚间公交，让游客为其使用所加重负担的基础设施出资？
B
That would address some costs, but housing pressure requires a different instrument, such as registration and limits on entire-home holiday rentals.
这能处理部分成本，但住房压力需要不同工具，例如整套度假短租的登记和限额。
A
We should avoid treating all accommodation alike, since renting a spare bedroom has different consequences from converting an apartment building into tourist units.
应避免将所有住宿一概而论，因为出租空卧室与将整栋公寓改为游客住房后果不同。
B
Agreed, and seasonal data would help us distinguish peak-weekend problems from difficulties that affect residents throughout the entire year without relief.
同意，季节性数据也能帮助区分高峰周末问题和全年持续影响居民的问题。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
The objective should be a viable local economy that remains livable, rather than maximizing arrivals without considering what each additional visit contributes.
目标应是保持宜居且可持续经营的地方经济，而非不问新增游客贡献多少就最大化到访人数。
B
A smaller number of longer stays might support businesses more consistently, although that claim would need evidence about local spending and employment.
少量更长停留可能更稳定地支持商户，不过需有本地消费与就业证据支持这一主张。
A
If the town introduces restrictions abruptly, smaller operators may struggle to adapt, so a transition period could reduce avoidable hardship without abandoning reform.
若小镇突然限制，小商家可能难以适应，因此过渡期能在不放弃改革的情况下减少可避免的困难。
B
The policy should also specify how revenue is allocated, allowing residents to see whether tourism income actually improves the services they use.
政策还应明确收入如何分配，让居民看见旅游收入是否确实改善其使用的服务。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Suppose a mountain village faces trail erosion rather than housing shortages; which part of our proposal would transfer, and which would change?
假设山村面对的是步道侵蚀而非住房短缺，方案中哪些部分适用，哪些应改变？
B
Charging visitors to support maintenance could transfer, whereas rental restrictions would be difficult to justify unless accommodation created a separate documented problem.
向游客收费支持维护可沿用，而除非住宿造成另一个有记录的问题，短租限制就难以证明合理。
A
Timed entry might spread foot traffic more evenly, but it should preserve reasonable access for residents and people unable to book far ahead.
分时入场可能均衡客流，但应让居民及无法提前很久预订的人仍可合理进入。
B
A credible evaluation would measure environmental recovery and local livelihoods together, because success on one dimension can conceal deterioration on another.
可信评估应同时测量环境恢复与地方生计，因为一个维度成功可能掩盖另一个维度恶化。

practice.speaking: 向小镇会议提出两项旅游管理措施。解释为何每项对应不同问题，并回应商户关于既有投资的反对意见。
practice.writing: 写 200 词政策简报，使用本课假设小镇的住房、拥堵和就业问题，提出分阶段改革及三项评估指标，不添加虚构统计。

listening.question: B 为什么不认为游客附加费能单独解决全部问题？
listening.answer: 收费可支付部分公共设施成本，但住房被转为短租需要登记或租赁限制等针对性工具。

practice.review: 准确区分外部成本与商户成本；能将同一原则应用于海边和山村但不照搬所有措施。

title: 自动化后的再培训
scene: 仓储经理与员工代表讨论岗位转型
objective: 区分短期转型成本与长期生产率收益
grammar: 完成进行时描述转变；not all 限定概括

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The warehouse has been testing automated sorting, and management expects some routine tasks to disappear when the equipment becomes fully operational.
仓库一直试验自动分拣，管理层预计设备全面运行后一些常规任务会消失。
B
Higher productivity could strengthen the business, but employees need to know whether the gains will translate into better jobs or fewer available hours.
更高生产率能增强企业，但员工需知道收益会转为更好岗位还是更少工时。
A
We plan to offer technical training, although only a limited number of maintenance positions will become available during the first year.
我们计划提供技术培训，不过第一年只有少数维修职位可供申请。
B
Then retraining cannot be the entire response, particularly for workers whose schedules or previous education make the proposed course difficult to complete.
那么再培训不能是全部回应，尤其一些员工因时间或教育背景难以完成课程。
A
Would paid study time improve access, together with introductory modules for people who have not used technical manuals in their current roles?
带薪学习时间加上面向目前未使用技术手册员工的入门模块，能否改善参与条件？
B
Yes, provided selection is transparent and employees are not required to compete for training after their existing hours have already been reduced.
可以，前提是选拔透明，员工不必在原工时已缩减后再争夺培训名额。
A
We could also negotiate redeployment across nearby facilities, though longer commutes would impose additional costs on some households with caregiving responsibilities.
也可协商调岗到附近设施，不过更长通勤会给承担照护责任的家庭增加成本。
B
Those costs should appear in the transition plan instead of being treated as private difficulties unrelated to the company's investment decision.
这些成本应列入转型计划，而不应被当作与公司投资决策无关的私人困难。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
The relevant question is how the benefits and risks are shared, since technological progress does not determine that distribution by itself.
关键是收益和风险如何分担，因为技术进步本身不会决定这种分配。
B
Not all workers will benefit equally from the same course, so an effective program should offer several pathways rather than one standardized qualification.
并非所有员工都同等受益于同一课程，因此有效方案应提供多条路径，而非单一标准资格。
A
A wage guarantee during the adjustment period could make participation more realistic, but its duration would need to reflect the firm's financial capacity.
调整期的工资保障可让参与更现实，但持续时间需反映企业财务能力。
B
We should assess outcomes through sustained employment and earnings, not merely count certificates that may have little value outside the training provider's program.
应以持续就业和收入评估结果，不能只数可能在培训机构外价值有限的证书。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Imagine a cashier choosing between digital bookkeeping and customer-support training; what information would help that person make an informed decision today?
设想收银员在数字记账和客服培训间选择，哪些信息能帮助其今天作出知情决定？
B
They would need realistic entry requirements, completion costs, local vacancies, and evidence that employers recognize the qualification when making hiring decisions.
需要了解现实入学要求、完成成本、本地空缺及雇主招聘时认可资格的证据。
A
Personal preferences matter too, because a technically promising occupation may be unsuitable for someone whose health or responsibilities require a predictable schedule.
个人偏好也重要，因为技术上有前景的职业可能不适合健康或家庭责任要求固定时间的人。
B
Our final proposal should make adaptation possible without implying that every worker who struggles has failed to embrace change or learn new skills.
最终方案应让适应变得可行，不能暗示每位遇到困难的员工都拒绝改变或学习新技能。

practice.speaking: 作为员工代表提出一个三阶段转型方案：转换前、培训中、就业后分别有什么保障？解释预算不足时最优先保留哪项。
practice.writing: 写 250 词议论文：企业引入自动化后，应承担多少员工再培训责任？讨论个人责任及政府可能承担的角色。

listening.question: 为什么统计培训证书数量不足以评价项目成功？
listening.answer: 证书未必获得雇主认可；持续就业和收入更能体现培训是否产生实际价值。

practice.review: 回答中须区分生产率、收入和就业三个指标，并准确使用 not all 表达有限概括。

title: 发展项目中的本地采购
scene: 援助项目负责人讨论学校餐食采购
objective: 分析供应链韧性与短期价格权衡
grammar: 条件限制 provided that；情态完成式表达可避免结果

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The school-meal program can buy imported grain at a lower price, but local farmers want a chance to supply the kitchens.
学校供餐计划可以较低价格买进口粮，但本地农民希望获得供应机会。
B
Local procurement might keep more spending in the district, although we should not assume every nearby supplier can meet the required quality standards.
本地采购可能让更多支出留在当地，但不能假设每个附近供应商都能达到质量标准。
A
Several small farms could deliver vegetables reliably if the program offered contracts early enough for them to plan the next planting season.
如果项目够早提供合同，让农场规划下一种植季，几家小农场就能稳定供应蔬菜。
B
Predictable demand would reduce uncertainty, but depending on a single growing region could make meals vulnerable to the same drought or crop disease.
可预测需求能减少不确定性，但依赖单一种植区可能让供餐同时受干旱或作物病害影响。
A
So a diversified supply chain may be more resilient than either complete reliance on imports or an absolute requirement to purchase everything locally.
所以多元供应链可能比完全依赖进口或绝对要求全部本地采购更有韧性。
B
Exactly, and the contract should allow substitutions that preserve nutritional value when a particular vegetable becomes unavailable or unusually expensive during the season.
正是如此，合同应允许在某种蔬菜缺货或异常涨价时，以保持营养价值为前提替换。
A
Would cooperative purchasing help smaller farms participate, given that individual growers may lack the vehicles needed to deliver to several schools efficiently?
考虑到农户可能缺乏高效配送多校的车辆，合作采购能否帮助小农场参与？
B
A shared distribution hub could help, provided its operating costs are included and farmers receive payments promptly enough to cover their expenses.
共享配送中心可能有帮助，前提是计入运行成本，且及时付款让农民覆盖开支。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
The cheapest bid may not offer the best long-term value if delays, spoilage, or dependence on one supplier create substantial hidden costs.
若延误、腐损或依赖单一供应商带来大量隐性成本，最低报价未必提供最佳长期价值。
B
However, local economic benefits should be demonstrated rather than asserted, particularly when the program serves children whose meal quality cannot be compromised.
不过本地经济收益应有证据而非口头断言，尤其项目服务的儿童餐食质量不能妥协。
A
Had the pilot recorded delivery failures consistently, we could have compared the reliability of different suppliers before expanding the procurement policy this year.
如果试点持续记录配送失败，今年扩大采购政策前就能比较不同供应商的可靠性。
B
The next phase should track price, nutritional quality, payment delays, and farm participation, with separate attention to smaller producers and new entrants.
下一阶段应追踪价格、营养、付款延迟和农场参与，并特别关注小生产者与新进入者。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Suppose a hospital applies the same local-purchasing principle to medical equipment; which additional consideration would become central to the decision-making process?
假设医院将相同本地采购原则用于医疗设备，哪项额外考量会成为决策核心？
B
Safety certification and dependable maintenance would carry greater weight, because supporting local firms cannot justify using equipment that fails essential clinical requirements.
安全认证和可靠维护权重会更大，因为支持本地企业不能证明使用不满足基本医疗要求的设备合理。
A
The principle transfers only if we preserve the service's primary purpose, then compare broader benefits among suppliers that meet those nonnegotiable requirements.
只有先维护服务首要目标，再比较满足不可妥协要求的供应商所提供的额外收益，原则才适用。
B
That ordering makes the recommendation more credible by showing exactly where economic development objectives end and essential service obligations take precedence.
这种排序准确显示经济发展目标的边界以及基本服务义务何时优先，从而让建议更可信。

practice.speaking: 论证学校供餐是否应偏向本地采购，明确三个评价指标和一个不可牺牲的底线，再将原则迁移到医院采购。
practice.writing: 写 180 词采购方案。虚拟预算每餐 4 美元；进口方案 3.20 美元、本地 3.80 美元、混合 3.60 美元；三者均达营养标准。比较价格并讨论供给风险，勿假定未提供的表现数据。

listening.question: B 为什么建议多元供应而非全部本地采购？
listening.answer: 单一区域可能同时遭受干旱或病害，多元来源可降低集中供应风险。

practice.review: 能解释低报价与长期价值的区别；写作使用给定价格且不虚构质量差异。

title: 增长以外的进步指标
scene: 城市研究员讨论年度发展报告
objective: 综合指标优缺点，避免平均数掩盖分配
grammar: 名词化组织论证；even when 表达反常结果

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The annual report celebrates rising average incomes, but neighborhood groups argue that the figures do not reflect their experience of economic progress.
年报庆祝平均收入上升，但社区团体认为数字未反映他们的经济进步体验。
B
An average can increase even when most households see little improvement, especially if a small number of high earners receive substantial gains.
即使大多数家庭改善不多，平均数仍可能增长，尤其少量高收入者收益大幅增加时。
A
Would reporting median income solve that problem, or should the report also examine housing costs and the stability of people's working hours?
报告收入中位数能解决问题吗，还是也应审视住房成本及人们工时的稳定性？
B
The median would improve the picture, but discretionary income after essential expenses may better capture whether households can actually maintain their living standards.
中位数能改善呈现，但扣除必要开支后的可自由支配收入可能更能反映家庭能否维持生活水平。
A
We also lack information about unpaid care, even though some residents have reduced paid work to support relatives with substantial daily needs.
我们也缺乏无偿照护信息，虽然一些居民减少有偿工作来照顾日常需求很大的亲属。
B
That omission matters because recorded output can fall while valuable activity continues, making a narrow economic measure an incomplete account of social welfare.
这种遗漏很重要，因为有价值活动继续时，记录的产出可能下降，因此狭义经济指标无法完整描述社会福祉。
A
A broader dashboard could include health, access to services, environmental quality, and people's own assessment of whether their lives are improving overall.
更广的指标板可涵盖健康、服务可及性、环境质量和人们对生活是否改善的自我评价。
B
It should remain interpretable, though; combining dozens of indicators into one score might conceal trade-offs and obscure the value judgments behind the weighting.
不过仍应易于理解；将几十项指标合为一个分数可能掩盖取舍和权重背后的价值判断。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
No indicator is neutral in its selection, so the report should explain which dimensions it prioritizes and what information remains unavailable or uncertain.
指标选择并不中立，因此报告应解释优先考虑哪些维度，以及哪些信息仍缺失或不确定。
B
Comparisons over time also require consistent definitions, because an apparent improvement could arise from a revised survey rather than a genuine change in conditions.
跨时间比较也要求定义一致，因为表面改善可能来自调查修订，而不是真实条件变化。
A
We could publish a compact set of headline measures alongside distributional breakdowns, allowing readers to examine who benefits from the city's overall performance.
我们可发布简明核心指标及分布细分，让读者查看谁受益于城市总体表现。
B
That would make disagreement more productive by separating disputes about the evidence from disagreements about which outcomes deserve the greatest political priority.
这能区分证据争议与结果优先级之争，从而让分歧讨论更有成效。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Consider a city where incomes rise but commute times double; how would you explain the tension without claiming that all residents are worse off?
设想城市收入上涨但通勤时间翻倍，你如何说明矛盾，同时不声称所有居民境况恶化？
B
I would describe the aggregate changes, then distinguish residents who gained access to better jobs from those who experienced longer journeys without higher earnings.
我会先描述总体变化，再区分获得更好工作的人和通勤更长却没有加薪的人。
A
Additional evidence about housing choices and transport access would help assess whether longer commutes represent voluntary trade-offs or a lack of feasible alternatives.
住房选择与交通可及性的额外证据能帮助判断长通勤是自愿取舍，还是缺少可行替代。
B
A balanced conclusion would recognize material gains while asking whether the distribution and quality of those gains match the community's stated development goals.
平衡结论应承认物质收益，同时追问收益的分配和质量是否符合社区宣称的发展目标。

vocab.zh: 必要支出后可自由支配收入

practice.speaking: 用三分钟完成本周综合陈述：选择三个评价城市发展的指标，解释各自补充了什么，并说明至少一项可能被平均值隐藏的差异。
practice.writing: 写 250 词议论文：衡量社会进步时，经济增长应在多大程度上被其他指标补充？使用自拟情境，明确标为假设。

listening.question: 为什么把更多指标合成一个总分仍可能误导？
listening.answer: 总分可能掩盖不同维度的取舍，以及指标权重中包含的价值判断。

practice.review: 检查能否分别定义平均数、中位数和分布；复述不得把群体总体变化套到所有个体。

title: 问卷里的沉默者
scene: 学生研究者检查图书馆满意度调查
objective: 识别样本偏差，提出改善数据收集的方案
grammar: 限定性语言 may / tend to；关系从句界定总体

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
Our library survey received enthusiastic responses, so the director wants to describe the new opening hours as popular across campus.
图书馆问卷反响热烈，所以馆长想称新开放时间受到全校欢迎。
B
Before making that claim, we should examine the sampling method and determine whose opinions were unlikely to enter the dataset.
作出该主张前，我们应检查抽样方法，判断哪些人的意见不太可能进入数据。
A
