The questionnaire was displayed beside the checkout desk, which means nearly everyone who responded had visited during the current opening hours.
问卷放在借书台旁，意味着几乎所有回答者都在现有开放时间到访过。
B
Then the sample may systematically exclude people who cannot visit at those times, precisely the group most affected by limited access.
那么样本可能系统排除无法在这些时间到访的人，而他们正是最受时间限制影响的群体。
A
We could circulate another survey by email, although students who rarely check university messages might still be underrepresented in the responses.
我们可通过邮件再发调查，不过很少查看学校消息的学生可能仍代表不足。
B
Using several recruitment channels would help, especially if we compare response patterns across students living on campus, commuters, and part-time learners.
使用多种招募渠道会有帮助，尤其比较住校生、通勤生和非全日制学生的回答模式时。
A
Should we weight the results to match enrollment figures, or would that create an appearance of accuracy beyond what our small sample supports?
应按在校人数加权结果吗，还是会制造超出小样本支撑能力的准确假象？
B
Weighting can address known imbalances, but it cannot recover the views of a missing group whose preferences were never observed at all.
加权能处理已知失衡，但无法恢复一个从未被观察到偏好的缺失群体的意见。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
The findings support a claim about respondents, while a broader conclusion requires evidence that those respondents adequately represent the population of interest.
结果支持关于回答者的主张，而更广结论需要证据表明回答者充分代表目标总体。
B
We should therefore report the response rate and recruitment process alongside the satisfaction figures, allowing readers to judge the limits of generalization.
因此应同时报告回应率、招募过程和满意度，让读者判断推广结论的边界。
A
A follow-up interview could explain why evening access matters, but a few compelling stories would not establish how widespread that need is.
追访可解释晚间开放为何重要，但几段有说服力的故事不能确定这种需求有多普遍。
B
Quantitative patterns and detailed accounts serve different purposes, so combining them works best when we remain explicit about what each source can establish.
数量模式和详细叙述用途不同，结合时应明确每种来源能证明什么。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Imagine an online poll about digital services that excludes residents without internet access; how would you redesign recruitment to reduce that blind spot?
设想关于数字服务的网络投票排除了无法上网居民，你如何重新招募以减少该盲区？
B
I would include telephone and in-person options, while checking whether the questions retain the same meaning when delivered through different channels.
我会加入电话和面访，同时检查问题通过不同渠道提出时是否保留相同含义。
A
The final report should distinguish a corrected limitation from an unresolved one, rather than suggesting that a larger response count automatically eliminates bias.
最终报告应区分已修正和未解决的局限，不能暗示更多回答就自动消除偏差。
B
If the missing voices could plausibly reverse our conclusion, the responsible next step would be further investigation before making a permanent service change.
若缺失意见有可能推翻结论，负责任的下一步应是在永久调整服务前继续调查。

practice.speaking: 解释一份高满意度问卷为何仍可能不可靠；提出两项招募改进，并说明增加样本量不能解决什么。
practice.writing: 写 180 词研究方法评议：某健身房只向周一上午到店者调查晚间开放需求。评价其结论，并设计可执行的补充收集方案。

listening.question: 为什么 B 认为加权也无法完全解决问题？
listening.answer: 加权只能调整已知失衡，不能凭空补出从未调查到的群体偏好。

practice.review: 准确说出目标总体、实际回答者和缺失群体；使用至少三种限定表达避免过度概括。

title: 相关不等于因果
scene: 团队讨论四天工作制试点数据
objective: 解释混杂因素，构建合理比较组
grammar: 过去完成时与因果顺序；反事实条件句

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
After our team switched to a four-day schedule, output increased, and several colleagues concluded that shorter weeks had directly improved productivity.
团队改成四天工作后产出增加，几名同事便断定短工作周直接提高了生产率。
B
That interpretation is possible, but the software upgrade introduced at the same time is a potential confounder we should investigate.
这种解释可能成立，不过同时引入的软件升级是值得调查的潜在混杂因素。
A
We had also hired two experienced coordinators before the trial, so the team may have become more efficient for several overlapping reasons.
试点前还招了两名资深协调员，因此团队可能因几个重叠原因变高效。
B
Exactly; observing a correlation between the schedule change and higher output does not isolate the effect of the schedule itself.
正是如此；观察到时间安排变化与产出增加相关，并未分离时间安排本身的作用。
A
Would comparing our results with another department help, assuming that department kept its schedule while receiving the same software upgrade this quarter?
假设另一部门保持时间安排但本季度也升级相同软件，比较两个部门结果会有帮助吗？
B
It would strengthen the comparison if their tasks and previous trends were similar, although differences in staffing could still complicate the interpretation.
如果任务和先前趋势相近，会增强比较，但人员差异仍可能让解释变复杂。
A
We should measure quality as well as volume, because completing more cases means little if errors create extra work for customers later.
除了数量也应测质量，因为若错误之后给顾客增加工作，处理更多案件意义不大。
B
And a longer follow-up would show whether the improvement persists after the initial enthusiasm fades and employees encounter the busiest part of the year.
更长追踪还能显示最初热情消退、员工遇到全年最忙阶段后，改善是否持续。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
The strongest defensible conclusion is that output rose during the pilot, while the contribution of each simultaneous change remains uncertain at this stage.
目前最稳妥的结论是试点期间产出提高，而每项同时发生的变化贡献多少仍不确定。
B
That wording may sound cautious, but it protects us from recommending an intervention for reasons that the available evidence cannot actually support.
这种措辞可能谨慎，却能防止我们用现有证据无法支持的理由推荐干预措施。
A
If productivity had risen equally in teams that retained a five-day week, our original explanation would become substantially less convincing than it seemed.
如果保持五天工作的团队生产率也同样增长，我们最初的解释会远没有看上去那么可信。
B
Conversely, a consistent difference across comparable teams would strengthen the case, especially if we could rule out major changes in workload or staffing.
反之，可比团队间持续存在差异会增强论证，尤其能排除工作量或人员重大变化时。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Consider a school where test scores improved after new lighting was installed; identify two alternative explanations before proposing a way to investigate them.
设想学校装新灯后考试分数提高，先指出两种其他解释，再提出调查方法。
B
Changes in teaching and the difficulty of the examination could both matter, so I would compare consistent assessments across classes with different installation dates.
教学变化和考试难度都可能重要，因此我会比较安装时间不同班级在一致测评上的表现。
A
No single comparison will remove every uncertainty, but a clearly specified design can make competing explanations harder to maintain without additional supporting evidence.
单次比较不能消除所有不确定性，但明确设计能让其他解释在缺少额外证据时更难成立。
B
Our presentation should separate what happened from why it happened, then identify which additional observations would most effectively distinguish between the plausible explanations.
报告应区分发生了什么和为何发生，再指出哪些额外观察最能区分合理解释。

practice.speaking: 用两分钟向非研究人员解释混杂因素，使用本课四天工作制例子，再举一个与你生活相关的原创例子。
practice.writing: 写 200 词评议：某公司宣称换咖啡品牌使销售增长。已知同时降价、增员、进入旺季。写出有限结论和进一步验证设计。

listening.question: 为什么两个部门都装相同软件仍未必能证明工作周的作用？
listening.answer: 部门人员、任务和既有趋势可能不同，仍需要检查这些可比性条件。

practice.review: 口头区分观察、因果推断和替代解释；不得把前后变化单独当成因果证明。

title: 小样本与不确定区间
scene: 研究助理向项目主管解释学习实验
objective: 解释估计值和精确度，避免把不确定写成无效
grammar: 程度副词；whether 从句组织尚未解决的问题

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
Our vocabulary pilot suggests that spaced review helped participants remember more words, but only twelve learners completed both assessments last month.
词汇试点显示间隔复习帮助参与者记住更多词，不过上月只有十二人完成两次测评。
B
That estimate may be useful for planning, yet the small sample means we should expect considerable uncertainty about the size of the benefit.
估计可用于规划，但小样本意味着效果大小有很大不确定性。
A
The report gives a single average improvement, which looks precise even though the individual results vary widely across participants in the study.
报告只给一个平均改善值，看起来精确，尽管研究中个体结果差异很大。
B
Presenting an uncertainty interval would make that limitation clearer and discourage readers from treating the observed average as an exact prediction.
呈现不确定区间能更清楚展示局限，避免读者把观察到的平均值当作精确预测。
A
Some participants started with much stronger English, so perhaps the method works differently depending on their existing knowledge and learning habits.
一些参与者英语基础强得多，所以方法可能因原有知识和学习习惯而有不同效果。
B
That is a reasonable hypothesis, but dividing twelve people into smaller subgroups would make the resulting estimates even less stable and harder to interpret.
这是合理假设，但把十二人继续细分会让估计更不稳定、更难解释。
A
Could we use the pilot to improve the procedure instead, checking whether the instructions are clear and the assessment measures meaningful retention?
我们能否用试点改进流程，检查指示是否清楚、测评是否衡量有意义的记忆保持？
B
Yes; feasibility is a legitimate outcome, and documenting practical problems now could prevent avoidable weaknesses in a larger study conducted next semester.
可以；可行性是合理结果，现在记录实际问题能避免下学期大研究出现可避免的缺陷。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
An inconclusive result does not establish that the method has no effect; it means the available evidence does not resolve the question sufficiently.
结果不确定不证明方法无效，而是现有证据未充分解决问题。
B
Likewise, an encouraging average does not guarantee a useful benefit for every learner, particularly when study conditions differ from independent practice at home.
同样，平均结果良好不保证每个学习者都有实用收益，尤其研究条件不同于居家独立练习时。
A
We should decide in advance what improvement would matter educationally, rather than celebrating any numerical difference simply because it favors the proposed method.
应事先决定多大改善具有教育意义，而不能只因数字差异有利于所提方法就庆祝。
B
A larger sample could narrow the uncertainty, but better measurement and lower dropout would also improve the credibility of the next investigation.
更大样本可缩小不确定性，但更好测量与更低退出率也能提高下次调查可信度。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Imagine two tutoring programs with similar average gains but very different variation; what would you ask before recommending either one to a school?
设想两种辅导项目平均提升相近但差异程度不同，推荐给学校前你会问什么？
B
I would ask which students improved, whether the assessments were comparable, and whether missing results could be related to difficulty with the program.
我会问哪些学生提升、测评是否可比，以及缺失结果是否与项目难度相关。
A
Costs and accessibility would also matter, since a slightly larger average gain may not justify an approach that many learners cannot realistically sustain.
成本和可及性也重要，因为略高平均提升未必足以支持多数学习者无法持续的方法。
B
The final decision can be provisional, with explicit criteria for gathering more evidence and revising the recommendation after another cycle of implementation.
最终决定可暂定，并明确进一步收集证据和在下一轮实施后修订建议的标准。

practice.speaking: 说明十二人试点能告诉我们什么、不能告诉什么。用一个生活例子解释为何平均效果不保证个人效果。
practice.writing: 写 180 词给项目主管的备忘录：建议是否扩大试点。已知十二人完成、四人中途退出、缺乏对照组；承认未知效果，不编造统计显著性。

listening.question: B 为什么不建议立即把十二人分成很多水平组？
listening.answer: 组内人数更少，会令各组估计更加不稳定和难以解释。

practice.review: 分别用一句英文解释不确定、无效、不可行；不得将三者混同。

title: 重复研究与开放材料
scene: 研究团队准备公开一项学习实验
objective: 解释可重复性和透明报告，区分探索与预设检验
grammar: 被动结构描述程序；强调句说明关键区别

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
We found an interesting pattern in the memory task, but another laboratory needs more detail before it can attempt an independent replication.
记忆任务出现有趣模式，但另一实验室在独立重复研究前需要更多细节。
B
The published methods mention the word list and timing, yet they omit how we handled participants who misunderstood the practice instructions.
发表的方法提到词表和时间，却遗漏如何处理误解练习指示的参与者。
A
Those exclusions seemed minor at the time, although they may affect the results if misunderstanding was related to participants' language proficiency.
当时这些排除似乎微小，但如果误解与语言水平相关，就可能影响结果。
B
We should release a documented analysis script and explain every exclusion rule, while removing information that could identify individual participants in the dataset.
应发布有说明的分析脚本并解释所有排除规则，同时去除可识别个体的信息。
A
Would preregistration have prevented the ambiguity by recording our planned comparisons before we inspected the final results and noticed the unexpected pattern?
如果先登记计划比较，再查看最终结果和发现意外模式，预注册是否能避免歧义？
B
It would clarify which analyses were planned, but exploratory findings are still valuable when they are labeled honestly and tested with new data.
它会明确哪些分析原先计划过，但如实标注并用新数据检验的探索性发现仍有价值。
A
The other team may use a different age group, so a failure to reproduce our pattern would not automatically mean somebody made an error.
另一团队可能使用不同年龄组，所以无法重复我们的模式不自动意味着有人犯错。
B
Right; differences in context can reveal boundary conditions, provided we investigate them rather than inventing explanations only after an inconvenient result appears.
对；情境差异可揭示适用边界，前提是认真调查，而非在不利结果出现后临时编解释。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
What matters is whether the claim survives transparent scrutiny, not whether the original researchers can defend every decision as the only reasonable choice.
关键在于主张能否经受透明审查，不在于原研究者能否把每个决定辩为唯一合理选择。
B
Open materials allow others to locate disagreements precisely, which can turn a vague dispute about credibility into specific questions about methods and interpretation.
开放材料让别人准确找到分歧，使笼统的可信度争论变成具体方法和解释问题。
A
We should also report analyses that did not support our expectations, because selective reporting can make a fragile result look more consistent than it is.
也应报告不支持预期的分析，因为选择性报告能让脆弱结果看起来比实际更一致。
B
The conclusion can remain interesting while becoming narrower, especially if the effect appears only under conditions that the original paper did not fully describe.
即使结论变窄仍可有趣，特别是效果只在原论文未充分描述的条件下出现时。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Imagine a recipe that produces different results in two kitchens; how would that analogy help explain the value and limitations of replication?
假设同一食谱在两个厨房产生不同结果，该类比如何说明重复研究的价值与局限？
B
It highlights the need to specify ingredients and procedures, while reminding us that equipment or environmental conditions may influence what happens in practice.
它强调明确材料和流程的必要性，也提醒设备或环境条件可能影响实际结果。
A
However, the analogy should not imply that human behavior is as predictable as cooking, since participants interpret instructions and respond to social context.
不过类比不应暗示人类行为与烹饪一样可预测，因为参与者会解释指示并回应社会情境。
B
Our revised report should separate established observations, exploratory interpretations, and questions reserved for future testing, giving readers a clear map of the remaining uncertainty.
修订报告应区分已观察事实、探索解释和留待检验的问题，让读者清楚了解剩余不确定性。

practice.speaking: 用食谱类比解释重复研究，然后主动指出这个类比的一个局限。最后说明探索性发现为什么也值得报告。
practice.writing: 写 200 词研究透明度计划，涵盖预注册、材料共享、排除规则和隐私；解释哪项不能保证研究结论正确。

listening.question: 为什么无法重复原结果不必然说明有人做错？
listening.answer: 研究对象或情境可能不同，这可能揭示效果的适用边界，需要进一步调查。

practice.review: 能区分预先计划与事后探索；准确说出公开材料的两项价值和一项限制。

title: 把科学发现讲给公众
scene: 科学编辑修改一篇夸大结论的报道
objective: 将研究摘要转为准确可懂的新闻表达
grammar: 报道动词与证据强度；限定词避免绝对结论

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The draft headline says a new classroom technique transforms learning, but the underlying study examined one group for only three weeks.
稿件标题称新课堂技术改变学习，但基础研究只观察了一个组，持续三周。
B
That headline overstates both the scope and certainty of the evidence, even if the short-term results are encouraging enough to deserve coverage.
即使短期结果值得报道，标题仍夸大了证据范围和确定性。
A
The author worries that a cautious headline will attract fewer readers, especially when competing stories promise simple solutions to familiar educational problems.
作者担心谨慎标题吸引较少读者，尤其其他报道为熟悉的教育问题承诺简单解决办法时。
B
Accuracy can still be engaging; we could lead with the practical question and explain what this particular experiment adds to the discussion.
准确也能有吸引力；可从实际问题切入，解释这项实验为讨论增加了什么。
A
We also need to distinguish the researchers' interpretation from the findings, because their preferred explanation was not directly tested by the procedure.
也需区分研究者解释和发现，因为实验程序并未直接检验他们偏好的解释。
B
A sentence such as the authors suggest would signal that distinction, provided the next paragraph describes the evidence that supports or limits the suggestion.
像“作者提出”这样的句子可标示区别，前提是下段说明支持或限制该解释的证据。
A
Should we quote an independent specialist, even if that person emphasizes limitations and does not offer the confident verdict the editor initially requested?
即使独立专家强调局限、不给编辑最初要求的确定判断，我们也应引用吗？
B
Yes, but expertise should be relevant to the method, and disagreement should not be manufactured merely to make the article appear balanced.
应当，但专业知识应与方法相关，也不应为显得平衡而人为制造分歧。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
The public needs enough context to judge applicability, including who participated, what comparison was used, and whether outcomes were measured beyond the immediate task.
公众需要足够背景判断适用性，包括参与者、比较方式和是否测量即时任务以外的结果。
B
Leaving out those details can turn a limited finding into an implied recommendation for everyone, which is a stronger claim than the researchers established.
遗漏这些细节会把有限发现变成面向所有人的隐含建议，其主张强于研究已证明内容。
A
We should avoid presenting uncertainty as incompetence; careful qualification often reflects a more rigorous understanding of what the available evidence can actually answer.
应避免把不确定性呈现为无能；审慎限定往往反映更严谨地理解证据究竟能回答什么。
B
The article can end with practical implications that remain proportional to the findings, such as supporting further trials rather than immediate adoption across every school.
文章可用与发现相称的实际意义结尾，例如支持更多试验，而非所有学校立即采用。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Suppose a company press release describes its own product evaluation as a breakthrough; what information would you seek before repeating that label?
假设公司新闻稿称自家产品评估是突破，你在重复这个标签前会查什么？
B
I would examine the comparison group, the chosen outcome, who funded the work, and whether the complete results are available for independent assessment.
我会检查比较组、选定结果、资助方，以及完整结果是否可供独立评估。
A
Commercial involvement does not automatically invalidate evidence, but readers should understand the incentives and examine whether the methods protect against favorable selective interpretation.
商业参与不自动使证据无效，但读者应理解激励，并检查方法是否防范有利的选择性解释。
B
My rewritten headline would state the observed change and relevant setting, leaving broader promises to future evidence rather than inviting readers to infer unsupported certainty.
重写标题应说明观察变化和相关情境，将更广承诺留给未来证据，避免诱导无根据的确定推断。

practice.speaking: 把本课研究情境做成 90 秒新闻音频：开头吸引人，中间说明证据和局限，结尾给出相称的实际意义。
practice.writing: 写 180 词科学新闻。仅使用虚构材料：一校 20 人练习新记忆法三周，前后测有所提高，无对照组、无长期追踪。另写准确标题，不虚构增幅。

listening.question: 独立专家是否只要持反对意见就值得引用？
listening.answer: 不是；其专业知识应与方法相关，不应为了表面平衡人为制造争议。

practice.review: 本周复盘：给主张标记观察、解释、建议三类；新闻不得包含证明有效、人人适用等超出材料的结论。

title: 极端高温中的城市取舍
scene: 城市规划员与社区代表讨论降温投资
objective: 在短期保护与长期适应间分配资源
grammar: 让步与条件复合句；比较时间尺度

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The city can fund either additional cooling centers this summer or a larger tree-planting program whose benefits would emerge over several years.
城市可以资助今夏更多避暑中心，或更大的植树计划，但后者要数年后才见效。
B
That framing creates a false choice if immediate protection and long-term adaptation address different stages of the same growing public problem.
如果即时保护和长期适应针对同一公共问题的不同阶段，这种表述就制造了虚假二选一。
A
The budget is genuinely limited, though, and planting trees requires maintenance that previous proposals underestimated when calculating the initial cost per neighborhood.
但预算确实有限，而且此前方案估算每个社区初始成本时低估了树木养护。
B
Then we should prioritize areas where exposure is greatest and existing shade is weakest, while reserving enough funding for urgent protection.
那应优先考虑暴露最高、现有遮阴最弱的区域，同时为紧急保护保留足够资金。
A
Some residents cannot easily reach a cooling center, especially if the nearest bus stop requires a long walk across an unshaded commercial area.
有些居民难以到达避暑中心，尤其最近公交站也要穿越无遮阴商业区步行很久时。
B
Accessibility therefore includes the whole journey, not just the entrance ramp or the number of hours the building remains open each day.
因此，可及性包括整个行程，不能只看入口坡道或建筑每天开放几小时。
A
Could temporary shade at transit stops provide an interim measure while newly planted trees develop enough canopy to make a meaningful difference?
新种树形成足够树冠之前，公交站临时遮阴能否作为过渡措施？
B
It could, provided we evaluate durability and maintenance, and consult people who use those stops rather than choosing sites solely for visibility.
可以，前提是评估耐久和养护，并咨询实际乘客，而不只为显眼选址。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
A fair allocation should account for vulnerability as well as population size, because equal spending per resident may leave unequal levels of risk untouched.
公平分配应兼顾脆弱性和人口，因为人均等额支出可能无法改变风险的不平等。
B
However, vulnerability should not become a vague label; the criteria must be explicit enough for communities to understand and challenge the resulting priorities.
不过脆弱性不能成为模糊标签；标准须足够明确，让社区理解并质疑由此产生的优先级。
A
The plan would be more credible if it linked immediate actions to a funded maintenance schedule instead of announcing ambitious planting targets without follow-through.
若计划将即时行动与有资金支持的养护时间表相连，会比只宣布宏大植树目标更可信。
B
We should distinguish measures that reduce exposure from those that help people cope, since relying entirely on coping measures could leave underlying conditions unchanged.
应区分减少暴露的措施和帮助应对的措施，因为只依赖应对可能让基础条件不变。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Imagine a school playground that becomes unusable during hot afternoons; propose a response that addresses both this semester and the next five years.
设想学校操场热天下午无法使用，提出同时应对本学期和未来五年的方案。
B
This semester, temporary shade and revised outdoor schedules could help, while a longer plan would redesign surfaces and establish durable natural shade.
本学期可用临时遮阴和调整户外时间，长期则重设地面并建立持久自然遮阴。
A
The school should track actual use and user comfort, because installing equipment is an output, whereas making the playground usable is the intended outcome.
学校应追踪实际使用和舒适度，因为安装设备是产出，让操场可用才是预期结果。
B
A strong recommendation would identify the residual risk, ensuring that visible investment does not create unwarranted confidence that every vulnerable resident is now protected.
好的建议应指出剩余风险，避免显眼投资让人无根据地相信每位脆弱居民都已受保护。

practice.speaking: 用两分钟提出三层城市降温方案：紧急、过渡、长期，并说清你如何判断哪个社区先获得资金。
practice.writing: 写 250 词议论文：城市面对环境压力时应优先短期保护还是长期基础设施？明确资源有限条件，讨论怎样协调。

listening.question: 为什么只看避暑中心入口是否无障碍仍不够？
listening.answer: 居民到达中心的整个行程也可能困难，例如需长途走过无遮阴路段。

practice.review: 口头准确区分产出与结果；建议须包括后续养护和至少一项剩余风险。

title: 跨境河流的合作
scene: 上下游代表谈判枯水季用水安排
objective: 协调冲突利益，设计可验证的互惠机制
grammar: 条件承诺；让步介词 despite / notwithstanding 的自然替代

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
Upstream farmers need water during the planting season, while downstream communities depend on a reliable flow for drinking supplies and small-scale industry.
上游农民种植季需要水，下游社区则依赖稳定流量供饮用和小工业使用。
B
A fixed allocation may appear clear, but it becomes contentious when rainfall falls far below the conditions assumed in the original agreement.
固定配额看似清楚，但降雨远低于原协议假定条件时便会引发争议。
A
The upstream council says it cannot accept limits that threaten harvests, particularly after residents invested in irrigation based on earlier development promises.
上游委员会说不能接受威胁收成的限制，尤其居民曾基于发展承诺投资灌溉设施。
B
Downstream residents face serious consequences too, so negotiations need a shared baseline for essential needs before discussing less critical commercial uses.
下游居民也面对严重后果，因此谈判应先为基本需求建立共同基线，再谈较不关键商业用途。
A
Could the agreement link withdrawals to measured river levels, with stricter limits triggered automatically when the flow falls below an agreed threshold?
协议能否让取水量与实测水位相连，低于约定门槛时自动触发更严格限制？
B
That would require credible monitoring, because a formula will not create trust if either side suspects the underlying measurements are selectively reported.
这需要可信监测，因为若任一方怀疑基础测量被选择性报告，公式也无法创造信任。
A
Joint inspections and public data might help, although communities would also need a process for resolving disputes without interrupting essential supplies.
联合检查和公开数据可能有帮助，不过社区也需不打断基本供应的争议解决流程。
B
We could include reciprocal commitments on water efficiency, so both sides contribute to conservation instead of treating the negotiation as a contest over losses.
可加入双方节水承诺，让双方都参与保护，而非把谈判当成争夺损失分配的比赛。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
The immediate disagreement concerns quantities, but the deeper issue is whether each community believes future sacrifices will be shared fairly under changing conditions.
眼前分歧是数量，更深问题是各社区是否相信环境变化时未来牺牲会被公平分担。
B
An agreement that ignores variability may be easier to sign initially and harder to sustain when the very circumstances it should govern become most demanding.
忽视变化的协议开始可能易签，但当它应管理的情况最严峻时，反而更难维持。
A
If emergency exceptions are necessary, their duration and review process should be specified, preventing temporary measures from quietly becoming permanent advantages for one side.
若需要紧急例外，应明确期限和审查流程，防止临时措施悄然变成一方永久优势。
B
The language should distinguish a minimum guarantee from an aspirational target, since ambiguity on that point could undermine cooperation when supplies are scarce.
措辞应区分最低保障与愿景目标，因为供应稀缺时这一歧义会破坏合作。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Suppose neighboring cities share a reservoir but face different patterns of demand; how could they design rules that remain workable across several seasons?
假设邻城共用水库但需求模式不同，如何设计跨季节仍可执行的规则？
B
They could set essential-use floors, publish seasonal forecasts, and agree in advance how restrictions change as storage rises or falls throughout the year.
可设基本用途最低保障，发布季节预测，并预先约定限制如何随全年蓄水涨落而变。
A
Efficiency investments should receive attention as well, because reducing avoidable losses can expand the room for compromise without pretending that scarcity has disappeared entirely.
效率投资也值得重视，因为减少可避免损失能扩大妥协空间，但不应假装稀缺已完全消失。
B
A successful settlement would combine measurable obligations with a legitimate revision process, making cooperation resilient when future conditions differ from today's forecasts and assumptions.
成功方案应结合可测义务与正当修订流程，使未来情况偏离今日预测时合作仍有韧性。

practice.speaking: 模拟调解员总结双方利益，提出水位触发规则、共同监测和争议处理三项条款，并说明为何固定配额可能不足。
practice.writing: 写 220 词合作备忘录。虚拟两城共用水库，基本需求各 20 单位，正常可用水 100、旱季 60；先保障基本量，再提出剩余量分配规则并说明合理性。

listening.question: 为什么自动公式仍不能单独创造信任？
listening.answer: 双方还必须相信测量与报告可信，否则可能怀疑数据选择性呈现。

practice.review: 能用实际数字检查配额总和不超过供给；区分保障、目标和例外三种承诺强度。

title: 迁移与技能认可
scene: 社区组织与雇主讨论新移民就业
objective: 讨论制度障碍，避免对群体进行过度概括
grammar: 让步转折；分词结构说明资格与经历

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
Several newly arrived engineers have found work outside their professions because employers struggle to interpret qualifications issued by unfamiliar institutions abroad.
几位新到的工程师只能从事其他工作，因为雇主难以理解不熟悉的海外机构颁发的资格。
B
That mismatch wastes potential, although recognizing credentials responsibly requires evidence that applicants possess the skills needed for the roles they seek.
这种错配浪费潜力，不过负责任地认可证书需要证据证明申请者具备目标岗位技能。
A
The current assessment process is expensive and slow, which can force applicants to accept unstable work before they have a chance to complete it.
现有评估昂贵且缓慢，迫使申请者尚未来得及完成就接受不稳定工作。
B
A bridging program could combine practical assessment with targeted instruction, allowing people to demonstrate competence without repeating an entire degree unnecessarily.
衔接项目可结合实践评估与针对教学，让人无需重复整个学位也能展示能力。
A
Employers also mention communication requirements, but that concern sometimes merges legitimate job needs with a preference for accents that sound familiar to interviewers.
雇主也提沟通要求，不过有时把合理岗位需要与面试官偏好熟悉口音混在一起。
B
We should define the actual tasks, such as explaining a safety procedure or coordinating a project, and assess performance against those requirements consistently.
应界定解释安全流程或协调项目等实际任务，再依照这些要求一致评估表现。
A
Would supervised placements help candidates gain local experience while allowing employers to observe their abilities in realistic situations over a defined period?
有监督的岗位实践能否让候选人获得本地经验，同时让雇主在明确期间内观察实际能力？
B
They could, provided participants receive fair compensation and the placements lead to a genuine assessment rather than repeated temporary work without progression.
可以，前提是公平付酬，实践带来真正评估，而非反复临时工作却无发展。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
Integration is a two-way process in this context: individuals learn unfamiliar systems, while institutions examine whether their procedures unnecessarily exclude qualified people from opportunity.
此处融入是双向过程：个人学习陌生制度，机构检查流程是否不必要地排除合格者。
B
That does not mean lowering standards; it means distinguishing essential competence from conventions that are easier for established insiders to satisfy than for newcomers.
这不意味着降低标准，而是区分核心能力与既有成员比新人更容易满足的惯例。
A
The evaluation should track sustained employment at an appropriate skill level, since any job placement may conceal continued underemployment among highly qualified participants.
评估应追踪与技能相称的持续就业，因为任何工作安置数字可能掩盖高资历参与者继续就业不足。
B
We should also avoid describing newcomers as a single uniform group, because previous experience, language needs, and family responsibilities vary considerably across individuals.
也应避免把新来者描述成单一群体，因为经验、语言需求和家庭责任在个人间差异很大。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Imagine an experienced teacher seeking work in a new education system; which requirements are essential, and which could be learned through supported practice?
设想资深教师希望进入新教育系统，哪些要求是必需的，哪些可通过有支持的实践学习？
B
Safeguarding knowledge and subject competence are essential, while familiarity with local reporting software may be developed during induction rather than demanded before hiring.
保护学生的知识和学科能力必需，而本地报告软件可入职时学，不必招聘前就掌握。
A
A transparent pathway would state what evidence counts, how long assessment takes, and what candidates can do if their previous experience is misunderstood.
透明路径应说明承认何种证据、评估耗时及既往经历被误解时如何处理。
B
The broader aim is to make standards accessible and meaningful, preserving public confidence while reducing barriers that do not contribute to competent professional practice.
更广目标是让标准可达且有意义，在维持公众信心的同时减少无助于合格专业实践的障碍。

practice.speaking: 说明技能认可制度应如何兼顾公平与专业标准。以工程师和教师比较，列出应招聘前满足和可入职后学习的要求。
practice.writing: 写 250 词议论文：雇主是否应更重视实际能力而非本地工作经验？讨论安全要求、适应成本及如何设计评估。

listening.question: 为什么就业安置率高不一定意味着项目成功？
listening.answer: 高资历人员可能仍从事与技能不匹配的工作，因此要看持续就业和岗位技能层次。

practice.review: 录音不得将所有新移民概括为相同群体；提出一项可验证的能力评估而非笼统放宽标准。

title: 跨国供应链的责任
scene: 服装买手与供应链审查员讨论低价订单
objective: 把责任追溯到采购激励，提出共同承担的改进
grammar: 因果倒推；让步后修正主张

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The supplier passed last year's inspection, yet workers now report excessive overtime after our company sharply increased the size of its latest order.
供应商通过去年检查，但公司大幅扩大最新订单后，工人报告过度加班。
B
The audit may have captured one moment accurately while missing pressures created by later purchasing decisions, especially the unusually short delivery deadline.
审查可能准确记录某一时点，却漏掉后来采购决策特别是异常短交期造成的压力。
A
Our buyers argue that labor conditions are the supplier's responsibility, since the contract already requires compliance with the standards we publish.
采购人员说劳动条件是供应商责任，因为合同已要求遵守我们公布的标准。
B
Contractual requirements matter, but demanding low prices and sudden production increases can undermine the conditions that make compliance feasible in practice.
合同要求重要，但要求低价和突然增产会破坏现实中让合规可行的条件。
A
Should we cancel the order immediately, or could withdrawal reduce workers' income without correcting the incentives that created the problem in the first place?
应立刻取消订单吗，还是退出可能降低工人收入，却不修正最初造成问题的激励？
B
We need a remedy that addresses the reported harm and our own purchasing practices, rather than simply moving production to a less visible supplier.
需要同时应对已报告伤害和自身采购方式的补救，而非仅把生产移到更隐蔽的供应商。
A
That could include a realistic delivery schedule, verified compensation for unpaid hours, and an independent channel through which workers can raise concerns safely.
可包括现实交期、经核实的欠薪补偿和工人可安全反映问题的独立渠道。
B
Worker participation is essential, because a corrective plan designed entirely by management may overlook retaliation risks or misunderstand which changes employees consider most urgent.
工人参与必需，因为完全由管理层设计的整改可能忽视报复风险，或误解员工最急需的变化。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
Traceability helps identify where production occurs, but knowing the location of a factory does not by itself establish that working conditions are acceptable.
可追溯性有助识别生产地，但知道工厂位置本身不能证明劳动条件可接受。
B
Similarly, a certificate should be treated as one source of evidence, with its scope and limitations understood, rather than a permanent guarantee of responsible conduct.
同样，认证应作为一种证据并理解其范围局限，而非负责经营的永久保证。
A
If the supplier refuses meaningful correction, ending the relationship may become necessary, although the exit should account for foreseeable consequences for affected workers.
如果供应商拒绝实质纠正，可能必须终止关系，不过退出应考虑受影响工人的可预见后果。
B
The company should report progress against specific commitments, including changes to its own order practices, so accountability extends beyond the factory gate to commercial decisions.
公司应按具体承诺报告进展，包括自身下单方式变化，让问责从工厂延伸到商业决策。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Consider a food retailer that demands perfect produce at very short notice; how might its purchasing rules transfer hidden costs onto smaller growers?
考虑一家要求极短通知期内交付完美果蔬的零售商，其采购规则会如何把隐性成本转嫁给小农户？
B
Farmers may absorb rejected stock and unpredictable labor costs, while the retailer presents low shelf prices without accounting for the risks shifted upstream.
农民可能承担退货和不可预测人工成本，零售商却只展示低售价，不计转向上游的风险。
A
More stable forecasts and shared standards for acceptable variation could reduce waste, provided contracts do not simply transfer every unexpected expense back to producers.
更稳定预测和共同界定可接受差异可减浪费，前提是合同不把每笔意外成本都转回生产者。
B
A persuasive argument should connect consumer benefits to the conditions under which they are produced, then propose a fairer allocation of responsibility across the chain.
有说服力的论证应把消费者收益与其产生条件联系起来，再提出更公平的全链条责任分配。

practice.speaking: 模拟采购经理回应工人投诉：承认自身可控制的因素，提出三项整改，再说明何种情况下终止供应关系。
practice.writing: 写 250 词议论文：国际品牌应在多大程度上为海外供应商的劳动条件负责？讨论合同、采购激励与实际控制能力。

listening.question: 为什么立刻转到另一家工厂可能没有解决根本问题？
listening.answer: 原先低价、急单等采购激励仍在，且退出可能伤害工人收入，只是让问题更不显眼。

practice.review: 能用一条完整因果链解释采购规则如何影响劳动条件；避免把证书当永久保证。

title: 合作为何难以启动
scene: 国际研究联盟讨论共享监测网络
objective: 解释集体行动与可信承诺，综合前四天原则
grammar: 让步条件嵌套；抽象名词配具体例证

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
Each participating country would benefit from a shared ocean-monitoring network, but several governments are delaying contributions until others commit their funding first.
每个参加国都受益于共享海洋监测网络，但几国政府等他国先承诺资金才出资。
B
That creates a collective action problem: the common benefit is clear, while each participant has an incentive to let others absorb the initial cost.
这形成集体行动问题：共同收益明确，但各方都有让别人承担初始成本的动机。
A
The proposed equal contribution sounds fair at first, although smaller economies would bear a much heavier burden relative to their available research budgets.
等额出资起初看似公平，但相对可用研究预算，小经济体承担的负担重得多。
B
A contribution formula could consider capacity and expected use, provided its assumptions are transparent and participants can understand why their obligations differ.
出资公式可考虑能力与预期使用，前提是假设透明，参与者理解义务为何不同。
A
Some countries can contribute ships or specialist staff instead of money, but comparing those contributions requires a valuation process that everyone accepts.
有些国家可提供船只或专家而非资金，但比较这些贡献需要各方接受的估值流程。
B
We should also guarantee access to the resulting data, otherwise lower-income participants may help collect information without gaining the resources needed to use it.
也应保证获得结果数据，否则低收入参与者可能帮助收集，却没有使用信息所需资源。
A
Would an initial agreement among a smaller group build momentum, or might it produce rules that later participants have little opportunity to influence?
较小群体先达协议会形成势头，还是可能定下后加入者几乎无机会影响的规则？
B
Both are possible, so early cooperation should include an explicit accession process and a scheduled review of governance once membership becomes more representative.
都有可能，所以早期合作应包含明确加入流程，并在成员更具代表性时安排治理复查。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
The challenge is to make commitments credible without demanding a perfect institutional design before any useful monitoring can begin across the participating regions.
挑战在于让承诺可信，同时不要求制度完美后才开始有用监测。
B
A staged arrangement could tie additional funding to verified milestones, while preserving enough stability for researchers to plan work that extends beyond a single budget cycle.
分阶段安排可将追加资金与核实里程碑相连，同时保留足够稳定性支持跨预算周期研究。
A
However, milestones should reflect scientific and operational progress, because easily counted outputs may encourage activity that looks productive without improving the network's actual coverage.
不过里程碑应反映科研和运行进步，因为易计数产出可能鼓励看似高产却不改善实际覆盖的活动。
B
The agreement also needs a dispute process, since cooperation becomes fragile when disagreements about data quality or contribution levels have no legitimate route to resolution.
协议还需争议流程，因为数据质量或出资水平分歧若无正当解决途径，合作会脆弱。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Imagine several apartment buildings sharing an emergency generator; which features of this international problem would remain relevant at that much smaller local scale?
设想几栋公寓共享应急发电机，这个国际问题的哪些特点在较小本地尺度仍相关？
B
They would still need fair contributions, clear access rules, reliable maintenance, and a way to prevent one participant from benefiting while consistently avoiding agreed responsibilities.
仍需要公平出资、明确使用规则、可靠维护，以及防止某方持续逃避约定义务却享受好处的方法。
A
The example shows that scale changes the complexity of cooperation, but the underlying need for trust, transparency, and workable enforcement can remain surprisingly similar.
此例说明规模改变合作复杂度，但对信任、透明和可行执行的基础需要可能相似。
B
Our proposal should make those principles concrete through decision rules and review dates, allowing cooperation to improve through experience rather than depend on unlimited goodwill.
建议应通过决策规则和复查日期落实原则，使合作可由经验改善，而非依赖无限善意。

practice.speaking: 三分钟综合演讲：用跨境河流和共享监测网络说明合作所需的三个条件，再迁移到一个社区共享项目。
practice.writing: 写 250 词议论文：解决全球问题时，少数愿意行动的国家应先合作，还是等广泛共识？讨论行动速度与代表性。

listening.question: 为什么平等出资不必然意味着公平出资？
listening.answer: 不同经济体的研究预算和支付能力不同，同额款项可能形成很不平等的负担。

practice.review: 不看文本用具体规则解释信任、透明、执行三词；演讲须承认一个方案无法消除的难题。

title: 熟悉话题也要说出差别
scene: 考生练习工作日习惯与居住环境的 Part 1 回答
objective: 用直接回答、原因和细节自然延展，避免背诵段落
grammar: 现在习惯与过去习惯对比；程度副词准确修饰

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
I usually study before breakfast because the apartment is quiet then, and completing one focused task makes the rest of my morning feel manageable.
我通常早餐前学习，因为公寓那时安静，专心完成一件事也让上午更从容。
B
Has that routine always suited you, or did you develop it after a particular change in your work or home life?
这个习惯一直适合你吗，还是工作或家庭发生某种变化后才形成？
A
I used to work late into the evening, but an earlier commute pushed me to move demanding tasks to the beginning of the day.
以前我工作到深夜，但更早的通勤使我把费力任务移到一天开始。
B
Your example makes the change clear; now explain whether you actually enjoy the routine rather than simply describing when it happens.
你的例子清楚说明了变化；现在解释你是否真正喜欢这个习惯，而不仅是它何时发生。
A
I enjoy the sense of control more than the early start itself, although I occasionally miss being able to wake up without an alarm.
相比早起本身，我更喜欢掌控感，不过偶尔怀念不用闹钟自然醒。
B
That distinction sounds natural because it qualifies your preference and gives the listener a more precise picture of your experience.
这种区别很自然，因为它限定偏好，让听者更准确了解你的体验。
A
When you talk about your neighborhood, choose one feature you genuinely notice each week instead of listing every facility nearby.
谈社区时，选择每周确实会注意的一个特点，而不是列出附近所有设施。
B
The narrow grocery store downstairs is probably what I value most, since the owner remembers regular customers and stocks the ingredients I actually use.
楼下狭窄杂货店可能最让我珍惜，因为老板记得熟客，也卖我真正需要的食材。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
I would not describe the area as picturesque, but its everyday convenience makes it feel more welcoming than some visually impressive districts.
我不会说这里风景如画，但日常便利让它比一些外观惊艳的街区更亲切。
B
That comparison is effective; just avoid extending every short answer into a speech, because relevance matters as much as the range of language.
这个比较有效；只是不要把每个短答都延成长演讲，因为相关性与语言丰富程度同样重要。
A
If I cannot recall a particular word, I can describe the feature directly, such as a shop that stays open late and sells everyday essentials.
如果想不起某个词，我可直接描述特点，比如营业很晚且卖日用品的店。
B
Exactly, and a brief reformulation can preserve fluency as long as you continue developing the idea instead of repeatedly searching for impressive vocabulary.
正是，简短换说可维持流畅，前提是继续发展意思，而不是反复寻找华丽词汇。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
For the next answer, explain whether you prefer planning weekends in advance, using a specific recent example and one exception to your usual preference.
下个回答说明你是否喜欢提前规划周末，用最近具体例子和一个常规偏好的例外。
B
I generally keep Saturday morning unplanned, but I book activities with friends early because coordinating several schedules becomes difficult at short notice.
我通常不安排周六上午，但会早约朋友活动，因为临时协调多人时间很困难。
A
Last weekend, leaving the afternoon free meant I could help my sister move, which reminded me why some flexibility is worth preserving.
上周末下午留空，让我能帮姐姐搬家，也提醒我为何值得保留一些灵活性。
B
Your answer now contains a clear preference, a practical reason, and a relevant example, without pretending that the preference applies in every situation.
你的回答现有明确偏好、实际原因和相关例子，也没假装偏好适用于所有情况。

practice.speaking: 完成六道 Part 1 口述，每题 20–30 秒：早晚学习、周末计划、附近商店、通勤、独处、朋友聚会。每题回答角度不同，不复用整句。
practice.writing: 写 150 词个人学习反思，比较过去与现在的两个习惯；每个比较含具体触发事件、好处和一项例外。

listening.question: 为什么教练肯定考生区分掌控感和早起？
listening.answer: 这使偏好更精确、自然，并承认喜欢习惯中的某部分不等于喜欢全部。

practice.review: 录六题后检查：每题先直接回应；至少三题有细节；没有把每题拉成同一模板长答。

title: 两分钟讲清一个地方的变化
scene: 考生讲述废弃停车场改成社区花园的 Part 2 长答
objective: 用空间、时间和意义组织持续叙述
grammar: 过去完成时铺垫；非限定性从句补充具体细节

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The place I would describe is a community garden behind our old train station, where an unused parking lot stood until two years ago.
我想描述旧车站后面的社区花园，两年前那里还是闲置停车场。
B
Before you continue, make the setting easy to picture by mentioning one concrete feature that distinguishes it from other gardens you have visited.
继续前，提一个区别于其他花园的具体特点，让场景容易想象。
A
A row of blue rain barrels runs beside the fence, and each planting bed carries a handwritten sign explaining what local volunteers are growing.
围栏旁一排蓝色雨水桶，每块种植床都有手写牌解释本地志愿者种了什么。
B
That detail works well; now connect the place to a specific occasion so the description develops into an experience rather than a static inventory.
这个细节很好；现在把地方与具体经历相连，让描述发展为体验，而不是静态清单。
A
I first went there after a difficult week at work, when a neighbor invited me to help repair the wooden edge of a planting bed.
工作艰难的一周后，邻居邀我修种植床木边，我第一次去了那里。
B
Had you expected to enjoy the activity, or did something about the afternoon change your initial impression of community volunteering?
你本就期待享受活动吗，还是那个下午改变了你对社区志愿服务的最初看法？
A
I had assumed volunteering would feel like another obligation, but the unhurried conversation made the work surprisingly restorative rather than exhausting.
我原以为志愿活动像另一项义务，但不紧不慢的聊天让劳动意外地恢复精力，而非耗尽精力。
B
Use that contrast to explain the place's significance, and then finish with what has changed in your own behavior since that first visit.
用此对比说明地方的意义，再以首次到访后你行为如何变化作结。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
What impressed me was the shared ownership: people disagreed about planting choices, yet they treated the space as something they were responsible for together.
让我印象深的是共同归属：大家对种植选择有分歧，但把空间看成共同负责的东西。
B
Since the garden is modest in size, claiming that it transformed the entire neighborhood would exaggerate what you actually observed during your visits.
花园规模不大，所以声称它改变了整个社区，会夸大你到访时实际观察到的情况。
A
It did, however, turn several strangers into familiar faces, and I now stop by most Sundays even when I have no particular task to complete.
不过它确实让陌生人变成了熟面孔，如今大多数周日即使没具体任务我也去。
B
You could recommend it to someone who wants a low-pressure way to meet neighbors, especially if organized social events usually feel uncomfortable or overly formal.
你可以把它推荐给希望轻松认识邻居的人，尤其是那些通常觉得有组织的社交活动不自在或过于正式的人。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
For an unfamiliar location prompt, I could organize my notes around the setting, one incident, a change in perception, and why the memory has lasted.
面对陌生的地点题，我可以围绕场景、一次事件、看法变化以及这段记忆为何持久来组织笔记。
B
Those headings can support a coherent answer without forcing every place into the same emotional story or requiring a dramatic turning point.
这些提纲能支持连贯回答，又不必把每个地方塞进相同情感故事或强求戏剧性转折。
A
If I finish the main incident early, I can deepen one detail by explaining what I noticed or why it mattered, instead of adding an unrelated event.
如果主要事件讲完得较早，我可以深入解释一个细节的所见或意义，而不是再添加无关事件。
B
The aim is sustained, relevant speech with clear connections, allowing the listener to follow your experience even if they have never seen the place.
目标是持续、相关且连接清楚的表达，让从未见过该地的听者也能跟上你的经历。

practice.speaking: Part 2：描述一个你亲眼见过变化的地方。说明在哪里、以前怎样、发生了什么变化、对你有何意义。准备一分钟，只记关键词；讲一至两分钟。
practice.writing: 写 180 词叙事短文，描述一个熟悉场所的变化。至少一段用具体细节表现意义，不直接反复说 important 或 beautiful。

listening.question: 为什么考生没有声称花园改变了整个社区？
listening.answer: 那会超出个人到访所观察到的证据；他只确认人际熟悉程度和自己行为的变化。

practice.review: 重听长答：时间线清楚，至少两个可视细节，结尾解释意义；不复制示范中的花园故事。

title: 人物描述中的证据与反思
scene: 考生讲述教会自己维修的人
objective: 通过行为证据刻画人物，保持复杂叙事清晰
grammar: 间接引语；过去习惯 would 与具体事件过去时

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The person who taught me a useful practical skill was my aunt, who repairs small household appliances at a workshop near her home.
教我实用技能的是阿姨，她在家附近工作间修小型家电。
B
Choose a particular lesson she taught you, because describing her personality in general terms will give you less material for a developed answer.
选一次她教你的具体经历，因为笼统描述性格能支持展开回答的材料较少。
A
When my desk lamp stopped working, she asked me to describe the problem carefully before touching anything, which immediately challenged my habit of guessing.
台灯坏时，她让我先仔细描述问题再动手，立刻挑战了我爱猜的习惯。
B
Explain what her approach revealed about her character, while keeping the technical details simple enough for someone unfamiliar with appliance repair to follow.
解释她的方法揭示了什么性格，同时让技术细节足够简单，便于不懂家电维修的人跟上。
A
She was patient without being vague: she would ask one precise question, wait for my answer, and then show me how to test an assumption.
她耐心但不含糊：每次问一个精确问题，等我回答，再教我检验假设。
B
Did the experience change only your ability to repair things, or did you carry some part of that method into other areas of your life?
经历只改变维修能力，还是让你把部分方法带到生活其他领域？
A
It changed how I approach mistakes at work, since I now try to isolate the problem before replacing an entire process that may mostly function well.
它改变我处理工作错误的方法：现在先定位问题，再考虑替换其实大部分运行正常的流程。
B
That is a strong reflection; include a small imperfection too, if it helps portray your aunt as a believable person rather than an idealized role model.
反思很好；若有帮助，也讲个小缺点，让阿姨可信，而非理想化榜样。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
She can be stubborn about keeping old equipment, and we still disagree about when a repair costs more time than the item reasonably deserves.
她对留旧设备有时固执，我们仍会争论何时维修花的时间超过物品合理价值。
B
Yet that disagreement has taught me to distinguish care from attachment, because preserving something is not automatically the wisest choice in every situation.
但分歧教我区分珍惜与执念，因为保存某物不总是每种情况下最明智的选择。
A
If I had to summarize her influence, I would say she made patience feel like an active skill rather than simply the absence of frustration.
若总结她的影响，我会说她让我觉得耐心是主动技能，而不只是没有沮丧。
B
The lamp is still on my desk, but what I remember most clearly is being encouraged to think instead of being given an immediate answer.
灯仍在桌上，但最清楚的记忆是被鼓励思考，而非立刻得到答案。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Now transfer the structure to someone who taught you an intellectual or social skill, selecting evidence that fits that person rather than borrowing the repair story.
现在把结构迁移到教你思考或社交技能的人，选符合此人的证据，不借用修理故事。
B
For example, a colleague who helped me run meetings might be memorable because she noticed quiet participants and invited their contributions without putting them under pressure.
例如教我开会的同事可能令人难忘，因为她注意安静参与者，并不施压地邀请发言。
A
The important link is between observed behavior and its effect on you, so every descriptive adjective should have a concrete example somewhere in the answer.
重要联系是观察行为及其对你的影响，因此回答中每个描述形容词都应有具体例子。
B
A thoughtful ending can acknowledge that influence continues to evolve, especially when you now apply the original lesson more selectively than you did at first.
结尾可承认影响持续演变，尤其如今比最初更有选择地应用所学时。

practice.speaking: Part 2：描述教会你重要技能的人。说明是谁、教了什么、如何教、你如何继续使用。准备一分钟讲两分钟；用行为证明性格。
practice.writing: 写 200 词人物短文，必须包含一个具体事件、一点不完美之处，以及你对其教导的理解如何随时间改变。

listening.question: 阿姨的教学为何被描述为耐心但不含糊？
listening.answer: 她用精确问题引导并等待回答，再教检验假设；耐心体现为具体方法而非空泛鼓励。

practice.review: 划出录音里所有性格形容词，逐一核对是否有行为证据；至少一次自然使用间接引语。

title: 从个人经验走向教育政策
scene: 考生练习 Part 3 的抽象讨论
objective: 以原则、机制、例子和限定发展抽象回答
grammar: 条件假设与让步；比较不同年龄和情境

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
Schools should develop independent thinking, but that does not mean teachers must withdraw guidance before students have enough knowledge to evaluate competing ideas.
学校应培养独立思考，但不意味着学生具备评估不同观点的知识前教师就须撤去指导。
B
How would you explain the relationship between factual knowledge and creativity without treating them as opposite goals that schools must choose between?
你如何解释事实知识与创造力关系，而不把它们当成学校必须二选一的目标？
A
Knowledge gives students material to work with, while creative tasks require them to reorganize that material instead of merely reproducing it in a familiar format.
知识提供素材，创造任务则要求重组素材，而不只按熟悉格式复述。
B
Can you give a concrete classroom example that illustrates the mechanism behind your claim, rather than simply saying both abilities are important?
你能举具体课堂例子说明主张背后的机制，而非只说两者都重要吗？
A
In a history lesson, students might compare conflicting accounts of one event, using contextual knowledge to explain why each witness emphasized different details.
历史课上可比较同一事件的冲突叙述，用背景知识解释每位见证者为何强调不同细节。
B
Would that approach work equally well with younger children, or would the amount of structure need to change according to their experience?
这种方式同样适合年幼儿童吗，还是结构化支持应依经验调整？
A
Younger learners may need shorter sources and more explicit prompts, whereas experienced students can take greater responsibility for identifying which questions deserve investigation.
年幼者可能需要更短材料和更明确提示，成熟学生则可更多负责识别值得调查的问题。
B
Some parents prefer frequent examinations because scores seem objective; how would you respond while taking their concern about accountability seriously rather than dismissing it?
有些家长偏好频繁考试，因为分数看似客观；你如何认真回应其问责关切而非轻视？

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
Examinations provide useful snapshots, but their value depends on what they measure and whether the results lead to better teaching rather than repeated ranking.
考试提供有用快照，但价值取决于测量内容，以及结果是否改善教学，而非反复排名。
B
A broader assessment system could combine tests with extended projects, although projects also require clear criteria to avoid rewarding presentation polish more than understanding.
更广评估可结合考试和长期项目，不过项目也需明确标准，避免重呈现精美而轻理解。
A
So your position is conditional: neither traditional tests nor open-ended tasks are inherently superior unless their design matches the learning purpose and context.
所以你的立场有条件：除非设计符合学习目标和情境，否则传统考试或开放任务都不天然更优。
B
Exactly, and the practical challenge is to gather enough evidence of learning without turning assessment into such a large workload that it displaces instruction.
正是，实际挑战是收集足够学习证据，同时避免评估工作量过大而挤压教学。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Now consider whether universities should prioritize employability; develop one argument in favor, then qualify it by identifying a responsibility that extends beyond immediate job preparation.
现在讨论大学应否优先就业能力；先支持，再指出超出即时职业准备的职责来限定。
B
Preparing graduates for work is legitimate, but universities also equip people to question assumptions and adapt when existing occupations change or disappear over time.
培养就业合理，但大学也让人能质疑假设，并在现有职业变化或消失时适应。
A
A narrowly vocational curriculum may serve today's vacancies efficiently while leaving graduates less prepared for problems that do not fit the procedures they originally learned.
狭窄职业课程能高效满足今日空缺，却可能让毕业生难以应对不符已学流程的问题。
B
I would therefore favor a combination of disciplinary depth, practical application, and critical reflection, with the balance varying according to the field and degree level.
因此我倾向学科深度、实践应用和批判反思相结合，比例依领域和学位层次而变。

practice.speaking: 完成四道 Part 3，每题 45–60 秒：知识与创造力、考试价值、家长参与、大学就业职责。每题至少解释一个机制，不只列观点。
practice.writing: 写 250 词 Task 2：有人认为学校应强调事实知识，另一些人认为应强调创造力。讨论双方并给出你的观点。

listening.question: 考生为什么不接受考试和项目谁天然更优的判断？
listening.answer: 评估价值取决于目标、设计和情境；两者都可能衡量错误内容或产生不合理负担。

practice.review: 四题分别检查立场、机制、例子、限定；允许自然停顿，但不要连续重复同一连接词。

title: 陌生追问下保持连贯
scene: 口语模拟从个人决定延展到公共决策
objective: 应对追问并澄清立场，避免绝对化和机械套句
grammar: 自我修正与精确重述；不同程度的推测

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
One difficult decision I made was turning down a promotion that required constant travel, because the additional salary came with responsibilities I could not realistically sustain.
我做过的困难决定是拒绝频繁出差的晋升，因为额外薪水伴随我无法现实承担的责任。
B
Looking back, do you think people generally make better decisions when they rely on careful analysis, or when they trust their immediate reactions?
回顾来看，你认为人们一般通过仔细分析还是相信即时反应作出更好决定？
A
It depends partly on experience: an immediate judgment can reflect years of practice, but in an unfamiliar situation it may simply reproduce an untested assumption.
部分取决于经验：即时判断可能体现多年实践，但陌生情境下也可能只是重复未经检验的假设。
B
Could excessive analysis become a problem itself, especially when someone postpones a choice because they are waiting for information that may never become available?
过度分析本身会成问题吗，尤其有人等可能永远得不到的信息而推迟选择时？
A
Certainly; I would distinguish useful investigation from avoidance, since gathering one more opinion does not always reduce the uncertainty that actually matters to the decision.
当然；我会区分有用调查与逃避，因为再收一份意见不总能减少真正影响决定的不确定性。
B
How might that distinction apply to governments, whose decisions affect many people and are often difficult to reverse once a policy has been implemented?
这种区别如何适用于政府，其决定影响多人，且政策实施后通常难以逆转？
A
Public authorities need a higher standard of justification, yet they also face deadlines, so a reversible pilot can sometimes be more informative than prolonged abstract debate.
公共机构需更高论证标准，但也有期限，因此可逆试点有时比长期抽象争论更有信息价值。
B
Does your support for pilots imply that governments should experiment with every policy, regardless of the potential consequences for the people involved?
你支持试点是否意味着政府应试验每项政策，不管对参与者有何潜在后果？

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
No, I should qualify that: a pilot is appropriate only when risks are acceptable, safeguards are credible, and participants' interests are properly considered.
不是，我应限定一下：只有风险可接受、保障可信且参与者利益被妥善考虑时，试点才合适。
B
That clarification strengthens your position; you have refined its scope without abandoning the underlying principle or repeating the whole answer from the beginning.
这一澄清加强了立场；你调整了范围，却未放弃基础原则或从头重复整个回答。
A
If I were asked about a field I know little about, I would reason from a clear hypothetical example instead of inventing facts to sound knowledgeable.
如果被问不熟悉领域，我会从明确的假设例子推理，而非编造事实显得懂行。
B
You can also state what would affect your judgment, showing flexibility by identifying relevant conditions rather than treating uncertainty as a reason to stop speaking.
也可说明哪些因素影响判断，通过识别相关条件展示灵活性，而非把不确定当成停止表达的理由。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: B
Try this follow-up: should expert advice carry more weight than public preference when a city chooses how to redesign a crowded central street?
试答追问：城市重设拥挤中心街道时，专家建议是否应比公众偏好更有分量？
A
Experts can assess likely consequences, while residents contribute knowledge about daily use and priorities; neither source alone determines which trade-offs the community should accept.
专家可评估可能后果，居民提供日常使用和优先需求；两者都不能独自决定社区应接受何种取舍。
A
I would give technical evidence substantial weight while keeping value choices open to public discussion, with officials explaining how the final decision incorporates both sources.
我会重视技术证据，同时让价值选择接受公共讨论，由官员解释最终决定如何结合两种来源。
B
The answer remains defensible if challenged because it distinguishes expertise about consequences from authority to decide whose interests should receive priority in a shared public space.
答案经得起追问，因为它区分了判断后果的专业知识和决定公共空间中谁应优先的权力。

practice.speaking: 全程录音完成口语模拟。Part 1：How do you usually plan your day? Do you prefer making plans early or at the last minute? Have your planning habits changed? Part 2：Describe a difficult decision you made. Say what it was, when you made it, what options you considered, and explain why it was difficult. 准备一分钟，讲一至两分钟。Part 3：When should people trust their intuition rather than detailed analysis? Should expert advice carry more weight than public opinion in government decisions? How can governments make decisions when important information is still missing? 每题解释理由并举例，追问时至少一次自然澄清立场。
practice.writing: 写 200 词自评，不自行给雅思分数。按流利连贯、词汇、语法、发音各找一个录音证据，设下一周可验证改进目标。

listening.question: 为什么考生的自我限定没有削弱答案？
listening.answer: 它澄清试点适用条件，保留核心原则，同时回应了过度概括的风险。

practice.review: 核对四项口语维度各一处证据；发音检查清晰重音与语块，不以模仿口音取代可理解度。

title: 趋势概述与预测边界
scene: 写作辅导中分析虚构通勤方式图表
objective: Task 1 先概述主要变化，再分组比较并标明预测
grammar: 趋势动词；过去时与预测表达区分

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The practice chart gives commuting shares for cars, buses, and bicycles in 2010 and 2020, with a projection for the year 2030.
练习图给出 2010、2020 年汽车、公交和自行车通勤占比，以及 2030 年预测。
B
Start by identifying the overall pattern, especially the decline in car use and the corresponding increase in the combined share of the other two modes.
先识别总体模式，尤其汽车占比下降，以及另外两类合计占比相应上升。
A
Cars accounted for sixty percent in 2010 and fifty percent in 2020, while the projected figure for 2030 is forty percent.
汽车 2010 年占六成，2020 年五成，2030 年预测四成。
B
That is a clear sequence, but the final value must remain explicitly projected so readers do not mistake a forecast for an observed result.
顺序清楚，但末值必须明确是预测，避免读者把预测误当已观察结果。
A
Bus use remained at thirty percent between 2010 and 2020, whereas cycling doubled from ten to twenty percent over the same period.
公交 2010 到 2020 年保持三成，同期骑行从一成翻倍为两成。
B
For 2030, buses are expected to reach thirty-five percent and bicycles twenty-five percent, leaving cars as the largest individual category despite their continuing decline.
2030 年预计公交三成五、自行车两成五，因此尽管汽车继续下降，仍是最大单类。
A
Could I say that cycling became dramatically more popular, or would that introduce an interpretation that goes beyond the measured share of commuting trips?
能说骑行变得极受欢迎吗，还是会超出已测通勤行程占比引入解释？
B
It would be safer to describe the share directly, since popularity implies an attitude that the chart does not measure or explain.
直接描述占比更稳妥，因为受欢迎暗示态度，而图表未测量或解释态度。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
The overview should summarize the dominant trends without listing every figure, while the detail paragraphs can group categories that moved differently or shared similar patterns.
概述应总结主要趋势而非列出每个数值；细节段可将变化不同或模式相近的类别分组。
B
I would compare the two observed years first, then handle the projection separately, making the boundary between recorded data and expectations easy to follow.
我会先比较两个实际年份，再单独处理预测，让记录数据和预期的边界清楚。
A
So a fall from sixty to fifty percent is ten percentage points, not a ten-percent decrease relative to the original figure.
所以从百分之六十降到五十是下降十个百分点，而不是相对原值减少百分之十。
B
That distinction prevents an apparently minor wording choice from changing the numerical meaning, which matters more than using an unusual synonym for increase or decrease.
这种区别避免看似微小的措辞改变数字意义，这比用生僻同义词表示增减更重要。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
For a new chart, I should spend a minute checking units, dates, categories, and whether any figures are estimates before deciding how to organize the description.
面对新图，我应先用一分钟检查单位、日期、类别以及是否有估计值，再决定如何组织描述。
B
Then select comparisons that reveal the structure of the data, instead of writing one disconnected sentence for every point on the chart in order.
再选择揭示数据结构的比较，避免按顺序给每个点写互不相连的一句。
A
If no causes are supplied, I should avoid inventing explanations such as fuel prices or environmental awareness, even when those explanations seem plausible in real life.
如果未给原因，就应避免编造油价或环保意识等解释，即使现实中似乎合理。
B
Exactly; an effective Task One response reports the information accurately, highlights key features, and gives the reader a clear overview supported by carefully selected details.
正确；有效 Task 1 要准确报告信息、突出关键特征，并以精选细节支撑清楚概述。

practice.speaking: 不看示范，用 90 秒口头描述三种通勤方式变化。先一句概述，再两组比较，明确 2030 为预测。
practice.writing: Task 1，至少 150 词，20 分钟。虚构图表：通勤占比（%），2010 汽车60/公交30/自行车10；2020 汽车50/公交30/自行车20；2030预测 汽车40/公交35/自行车25。概述主要特征并比较，不解释原因。

listening.question: 为什么不能把骑行占比增长直接表述为更受欢迎？
listening.answer: 占比衡量行程分配，未直接测量人们的态度或喜爱程度。

practice.review: 核对九个数值、单位和预测时态；概述不堆全部数字；区分百分点与百分比变化。

title: 静态表格中的有效比较
scene: 考生描述虚构图书馆分馆数据
objective: 选择跨类别比较，避免逐格翻译或推断效率
grammar: 倍数比较；分别对应 respectively；最高级限定范围

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
This practice table compares three library branches in one year, showing weekly visitors, weekly opening hours, and the number of study desks available.
练习表比较同一年三个图书馆分馆，列每周访客、开放小时和自习桌数量。
B
Because there is no time series, your overview should describe relative size and contrasting features rather than invent a trend across years.
因为没有时间序列，概述应描述相对规模和差异特征，而非编造跨年趋势。
A
Central has fourteen hundred weekly visitors, sixty opening hours, and eighty desks, placing it highest on all three measures in the table.
中央分馆每周一千四百访客、开放六十小时、有八十桌，三项均为表中最高。
B
Riverside records twelve hundred visitors and fifty hours, while Hill has nine hundred visitors and forty hours; their desk totals are sixty and thirty respectively.
河畔分馆访客一千二百、开放五十小时，山丘九百和四十小时；桌数分别六十和三十。
A
So Central's desk count is more than twice Hill's, even though its visitor total is much less than twice as large.
因此中央桌数是山丘两倍多，但访客总数远不到山丘两倍。
B
That is a useful comparison because it connects two measures, although it does not tell us how many desks are occupied at any particular moment.
这个比较连接两个指标，很有用，但无法告诉我们某个时刻有多少桌被占用。
A
Could I describe Hill as overcrowded because it has the fewest desks relative to its weekly visitors, or would that be an unsupported conclusion?
能因山丘相对周访客桌子最少而说它拥挤吗，还是这是无证据结论？
B
The table cannot establish overcrowding without information about visit duration and peak demand, so describe the contrast without turning it into a judgment about service quality.
没有停留时间和高峰需求，表不能证明拥挤，因此描述差异而不转成服务质量判断。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
I could group visitors and opening hours in one paragraph, then compare study capacity in another, keeping the structure organized around meaningful dimensions.
可一段比较访客与开放时间，另一段比较自习容量，围绕有意义维度组织。
B
Yes, and avoid repeating the branch names unnecessarily; clear referencing can help cohesion as long as the reader always knows which location you mean.
可以，也避免不必要重复分馆名；清楚指代有助衔接，前提是读者总知道所指位置。
A
The phrase respectively is efficient only when the order is unmistakable, so I should not use it after introducing several overlapping lists of figures.
只有顺序明确时 respectively 才高效，因此不应在引入几个重叠数字列表后使用它。
B
Accuracy also means preserving the units, since sixty hours per week and sixty visitors per hour describe entirely different quantities despite sharing the same number.
准确也包括保留单位，因为每周六十小时和每小时六十访客即使数字相同，也完全不同。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
For another table, identify the largest and smallest values first, then look for an exception that prevents the overview from becoming a simplistic ranking.
面对另一表，先找最大最小值，再找防止概述变为简单排名的例外。
B
If one branch opens longer but attracts fewer visitors, that contrast may be worth highlighting without assuming the branch is inefficient or poorly managed.
若某分馆开得久但访客少，该反差值得强调，但不能假定其低效或管理差。
A
A concise final check should ask whether every comparison is numerically correct and whether any descriptive word implies information that the source never supplied.
最后简要检查每个比较是否数字正确，任何描述词是否暗示来源未提供的信息。
B
You can demonstrate a wide vocabulary through precise nouns and natural collocations, rather than replacing every ordinary word with a more elaborate expression.
可通过精确名词和自然搭配展示词汇丰富，而非把每个普通词换成更复杂表达。

practice.speaking: 用一分钟描述三个分馆，至少一次倍数比较、一次 respectively，并解释一个不能从表中得出的结论。
practice.writing: Task 1，至少 150 词。虚构单年表：中央分馆每周访客1400、每周开放60小时、自习桌80；河畔1200/50/60；山丘900/40/30。总结主要特征并比较。

listening.question: 为什么山丘桌数相对较少也不能直接说明拥挤？
listening.answer: 缺少停留时长和高峰需求，周访客数不能直接反映同时占用情况。

practice.review: 核对三项单位；所有比较可由表直接验证；删除任何无证据的效率或满意度判断。

title: 把循环流程写清楚
scene: 写作辅导分析虚构纸张回收流程
objective: Task 1 明确起止、分支与循环，合理使用被动语态
grammar: 一般现在时被动；时间从句；关系从句连接步骤

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The diagram outlines a paper-recycling process that begins with collection from designated bins and ends with rolls of newly manufactured paper.
图示纸张回收流程，从指定箱收集开始，到新纸卷结束。
B
Your overview should identify the main transformation and mention that unsuitable material is removed, rather than trying to summarize every machine separately.
概述应指出主要转化并提及去除不合格材料，而非逐台总结机器。
A
After collection, the paper is sorted, and contaminated items are discarded before the remaining material is transported to a processing facility.
收集后纸张分类，受污染物被丢弃，剩余材料再送处理设施。
B
That sentence makes the rejection branch clear; now describe what happens to the accepted paper without implying that discarded material reenters the same process.
这句清楚说明剔除分支；接着描述合格纸张，别暗示丢弃材料重回该流程。
A
At the facility, the paper is mixed with water to produce pulp, which then passes through screens that remove larger pieces of unwanted material.
在工厂，纸与水混合成浆，再过筛去除较大杂质。
B
The next stage removes ink, after which the cleaned pulp is spread onto a moving mesh and pressed to reduce its water content.
下一阶段去墨，清洁浆铺在移动网面上，再压制以减少含水量。
A
Finally, heated rollers dry the sheet, and the resulting paper is wound into large rolls that are ready for use in manufacturing.
最后加热滚筒烘干纸幅，成纸卷成大卷，供制造使用。
B
The diagram also shows recovered water returning to the pulping stage, so include that loop without suggesting that every material is fully recycled.
图还显示回收水返回制浆阶段，因此应写此循环，但别暗示所有材料全部回收。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
A process description usually needs the present simple, with passive forms where the action matters more than an unspecified person operating the equipment.
流程描述通常用一般现在时，动作比未指定操作人员重要时用被动形式。
B
However, passive grammar does not require every sentence to begin identically; a phrase naming the stage can vary the structure while preserving clarity.
不过被动语法不要求每句同样开头；以阶段名短语开头可改变结构且保持清楚。
A
We should avoid adding temperatures or chemical ingredients that are absent from the source, even if we know real factories may use them.
应避免加入来源未提供的温度或化学成分，即使知道真实工厂可能使用。
B
Likewise, the description should not praise the process as environmentally friendly unless the task supplies evidence about its wider impacts rather than just its sequence.
同样，不应称流程环保，除非题目提供更广影响证据，而非只有步骤。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Imagine a diagram showing rainwater collection, filtration, storage, and garden irrigation; what would you check before deciding whether to describe it as a cycle?
设想图示雨水收集、过滤、储存和花园灌溉，称其循环前应检查什么？
B
I would check whether an arrow actually returns material to an earlier stage, because a sequence with repeated use is not automatically a closed loop.
我会检查是否有箭头将材料送回前面阶段，因为重复使用的序列不自动是闭环。
A
The arrows are therefore part of the evidence, and overlooking their direction can produce a grammatically fluent answer that misrepresents the entire process.
因此箭头也是证据，忽视方向可让语法流畅的答案误述整个流程。
B
Before finishing, I would trace one accepted input through every stage and separately verify the discarded-material branch and the recovered-water return path.
结束前会沿所有阶段追踪一个合格输入，并分别核对丢弃材料分支和回收水返回路径。

practice.speaking: 按箭头顺序用 90 秒解释回收流程，突出一次剔除分支和一次水循环，避免朗读现成段落。
practice.writing: Task 1，至少 150 词。虚构流程全部信息：收集废纸→分类（受污染纸剔除）→运到工厂→加水制浆→筛除大杂质→去墨→浆铺移动网面→压制脱水→加热滚筒干燥→卷成纸卷。压出的回收水返回制浆。描述流程，勿添加温度。

listening.question: 为什么描述回收水返回时不能说全部材料都被回收？
listening.answer: 只有水返回箭头被给出；受污染纸和杂质另被剔除，图并未证明全部回收。

practice.review: 流程十个主步骤无遗漏；两条分支方向正确；至少三种句首结构且无自行添加参数。

title: 讨论双方而不丢失立场
scene: 考生构建博物馆收费议论文
objective: Task 2 公平呈现两方并维持清晰限定立场
grammar: 让步段；主张—机制—例证；指代建立衔接

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The essay question asks whether museums should charge admission or remain free, and it requires discussion of both views as well as my opinion.
题目问博物馆应收费还是免费，要求讨论双方并给个人观点。
B
Before drafting, identify the strongest rationale for each position, rather than making one side deliberately weak so your preferred answer seems obvious.
起草前识别双方最强理由，不要故意削弱一方，让偏好答案显得显然。
A
Charging can provide predictable revenue for conservation and exhibitions, especially where public funding is limited or changes substantially from one year to the next.
收费可为保护和展览提供可预测收入，尤其公共资金有限或年度变化大时。
B
Develop that mechanism by explaining what unstable funding prevents a museum from doing, instead of merely asserting that money is important for cultural institutions.
通过解释不稳定资金妨碍博物馆做什么来发展机制，而非只断言钱对文化机构重要。
A
A museum unable to plan maintenance may postpone essential work, allowing preventable damage to accumulate even while its doors remain open to the public.
无法规划维护的博物馆可能推迟必要工作，虽继续开放，却让可避免损伤不断累积。
B
Now give the opposing argument comparable depth, focusing on how admission charges can alter access rather than simply calling free entry fair or generous.
现在同等深入发展反方，重点说收费如何改变可及性，而不只称免费公平或慷慨。
A
For families making repeated educational visits, even modest fees can become a barrier, particularly when transport and other unavoidable expenses are added to the total.
对于反复教育参访的家庭，小额票价也可能成为障碍，尤其加上交通等必要开支后。
B
Your opinion can combine these concerns, but make the governing principle explicit so the conclusion feels reasoned rather than merely a compromise between two opposing slogans.
观点可结合这些关切，但要明确主导原则，让结论有推理，而非两个口号的折中。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
I would favor free access to permanent collections, supported by public funding and optional paid exhibitions, provided the funding arrangement protects essential conservation work.
我支持永久馆藏免费、公共资金和可选收费展览补充，前提是资金安排保障必要保护工作。
B
That position is clear, yet you should acknowledge that it may be harder for small independent museums whose collections attract fewer visitors and donors.
立场清楚，但应承认对于参观者和捐赠者较少的小型独立博物馆可能更难。
A
The exception does not destroy the principle; it suggests that limited charges may be justified when no realistic alternative can preserve the institution's core public function.
例外不推翻原则，而是说明没有现实替代能保留机构核心公共功能时，有限收费可能合理。
B
Keep that qualification proportionate, since an essay can become indecisive if each paragraph retreats from the position instead of clarifying the conditions under which it holds.
限定要适度，因为每段若都退回立场而非明确适用条件，文章会变得犹豫不决。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
For a new discussion prompt, write one sentence expressing each side's best reason, then one sentence stating the criterion you will use to judge between them.
面对新讨论题，先各写一句双方最佳理由，再一句写判断标准。
B
Each body paragraph should explain a causal link and illustrate it with a plausible example, clearly presented as an example rather than an invented research finding.
每个主体段应解释因果并用合理例子说明，明确它是例子，而非编造研究发现。
A
In revision, remove repeated claims that do no argumentative work, and check that pronouns such as this refer to a specific idea the reader can identify.
修改时删去不推进论证的重复主张，并检查 this 等代词所指是否明确。
B
A strong conclusion restates the judgment in light of the reasoning already developed, without introducing a new policy that the essay has not had space to examine.
有力结尾根据已展开推理重申判断，不临时加入正文没空间讨论的新政策。

practice.speaking: 用两分钟做写作前口头论证：各用 30 秒给博物馆收费与免费最强理由，再提出你的标准与例外。
practice.writing: Task 2，至少 250 词，40 分钟：有人认为博物馆应免费开放，另一些人认为应该收取入场费以支持运作。讨论双方并给出你的观点。

listening.question: 为什么考生允许小型独立博物馆有收费例外？
listening.answer: 其替代资金可能不足，限定收费或许是维持核心公共功能的现实必要措施。

practice.review: 逐段标出主张、机制、例子；两方都有实质论证；结论立场与正文一致。

title: 问题与对策必须对应
scene: 考生修订城市独居者孤独问题作文
objective: 识别双问题任务，建立原因与方案的一对一关联
grammar: 因果与目的从句；避免过度名词化；条件性效果

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The prompt asks why some city residents feel socially isolated and what local communities can do, so my response needs to address both parts explicitly.
题目问为何一些城市居民感到社会孤立以及社区能做什么，因此回答须明确覆盖两部分。
B
Your draft lists technology, work, and housing as causes, but none is explained sufficiently to show how it actually reduces meaningful contact.
稿子列出科技、工作和住房，但没充分解释它们如何减少有意义接触。
A
I could focus on unpredictable working hours, which make it difficult to attend recurring activities where acquaintances gradually develop into stronger relationships.
可聚焦不可预测工时，它让人难参加重复活动，而这种活动能让相识逐渐成为稳固关系。
B
That mechanism is specific; now propose a response that addresses the scheduling barrier instead of adding a general recommendation to build more community centers.
机制具体；现在针对时间障碍提出回应，而非泛泛建议多建社区中心。
A
Neighborhood groups could offer the same activity at several times and allow flexible attendance, reducing the penalty for missing a particular weekly session.
社区团体可在多个时段提供相同活动并允许灵活参加，减少错过某周活动的代价。
B
Acknowledge a limitation as well, because flexible attendance may make continuity harder and cannot by itself change the employment conditions that created the problem.
也承认局限，因为灵活参加可能让连续性更难，且无法独自改变造成问题的就业条件。
A
Another cause is residential turnover, which can weaken informal networks when neighbors move away before relationships have time to develop beyond polite recognition.
另一原因是居住者流动，在关系超越礼貌相识前邻居已搬走，会削弱非正式网络。
B
Then a practical measure might connect newcomers with existing local groups, while avoiding the assumption that every person living alone feels lonely or wants organized social contact.
那么实际措施可连接新来者与本地组织，同时避免假定每个独居者都孤独或都想参加组织社交。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
My introduction should distinguish living alone from feeling isolated, since the first describes a household arrangement and the second describes a social experience.
引言应区分独居和感到孤立，因为前者是家庭安排，后者是社会体验。
B
That distinction improves precision and prevents your solutions from targeting a demographic category more broadly than the problem described in the question warrants.
这种区别提高精确性，防止方案对人口类别的针对范围超出题目问题所需。
A
I also need to replace the claim that community events will eliminate loneliness with a more realistic explanation of how they can create opportunities for connection.
也需把社区活动会消除孤独改为更现实地解释它们如何创造联系机会。
B
Exactly; evaluate each proposal through the obstacle it removes, the people it may reach, and the conditions required for participation to become sustained rather than temporary.
正确；按移除什么障碍、触及谁、持续而非短暂参与所需条件评估建议。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
For an unfamiliar causes-and-solutions question, draw two arrows from each cause to its consequence and then from the proposed measure back to the relevant barrier.
面对陌生原因对策题，画因果箭头，再从措施画回对应障碍。
B
If a proposed solution connects to no identified cause, either justify the missing mechanism or remove it, rather than relying on its generally positive reputation.
如果方案未连接已识别原因，就解释缺失机制或删除，而非依赖其普遍好名声。
A
During editing, check whether broad nouns hide unclear reasoning; replacing improvement of interaction with a specific action can make the argument much easier to evaluate.
修改时检查宽泛名词是否掩盖含糊推理；把改善互动换为具体行动能让论证更易评估。
B
The final essay should offer a manageable set of developed ideas, showing why the responses are relevant while acknowledging that community action cannot resolve every structural problem.
最终文章应包含数量适度且展开的想法，说明对策相关性，同时承认社区行动不能解决所有结构问题。

practice.speaking: 用两分钟解释孤立的两个原因及对应社区措施，每项须说清作用机制和一项局限。
practice.writing: Task 2，至少 250 词：尽管城市人口密集，一些居民仍感到社会孤立。原因是什么？社区可以采取什么措施？不要将独居等同于孤独。

listening.question: 为什么教练不满意直接提出多建社区中心？
listening.answer: 前文原因是工时不稳定，单纯增加建筑未必解决无法在固定时段参加的障碍。

practice.review: 完成一篇后核对两项任务均回答；每个对策对应具体原因；删去保证消除等绝对化措辞。

title: 同义改写不能偷换范围
scene: 学习小组核对一段虚构交通报告的摘要
objective: 识别主语、程度、范围和因果在改写中的变化
grammar: 量词限定；情态动词保留证据强度

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The passage states that several suburban routes attracted more passengers after evening service was extended, but it does not discuss the entire transport network.
段落说几条郊区线路延长晚间服务后客流增加，但未讨论整个交通网络。
B
My summary says the policy increased public transport use throughout the city, which sounds similar but expands the scope beyond what the passage actually reports.
我摘要说政策提高全市公交使用，听起来相近，却扩大了原文报告范围。
A
It also turns a sequence of events into a causal claim, since after does not necessarily establish that the timetable change produced the increase.
它还把时间先后变成因果，因为 after 不一定证明时刻表调整造成增长。
B
Then a more faithful paraphrase would preserve the limited set of routes and describe the rise as occurring after the extension, without claiming a proven explanation.
更忠实改写应保留有限线路范围，并描述增长发生于延长之后，不声称已证明原因。
A
The next sentence says that some passengers previously relied on taxis, while others had simply avoided making evening trips when buses were unavailable.
下句说一些乘客此前依赖出租车，另一些在无公交时干脆避免夜间出行。
B
That distinction matters because additional bus journeys may represent both a shift between modes and trips that would not otherwise have taken place.
这一区别重要，因为新增公交出行可能既有方式替代，也有原本不会发生的新行程。
A
So replacing the sentence with everyone abandoned their cars would distort the quantifier, the original travel mode, and the behavior being described.
所以改成所有人放弃汽车会扭曲量词、原出行方式和所描述行为。
B
Exactly, and using more advanced vocabulary would not repair those changes; accurate paraphrase depends on preserving meaning rather than maximizing differences in wording.
正是，更高级词汇不能修复这些改变；准确改写依赖保留意义，而非最大化措辞差异。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
The phrase demand had been suppressed suggests that limited service prevented some desired travel, but it does not reveal how many people were affected.
需求曾被压抑暗示有限服务阻止部分想要的出行，但没有揭示多少人受影响。
B
When answering a reading question, I should locate the evidence for each part of the statement instead of matching only its most distinctive keyword.
阅读答题应找到陈述每部分的证据，而非只匹配最独特关键词。
A
A statement can reuse the passage's nouns and still be inaccurate if its time frame, comparison group, or degree of certainty has quietly changed.
即使复用原文名词，若时间范围、比较组或确定程度悄然变化，陈述仍可不准。
B
For unsupported information, I need to distinguish absence of evidence from a contradiction, because the passage may simply never address the issue the question raises.
面对未支持信息，要区分没有证据与矛盾，因为原文可能根本未谈题目提出的问题。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Try paraphrasing this new sentence: residents with flexible schedules were more likely to attend the workshops, although participation varied considerably between neighborhoods.
试改写新句：时间灵活居民更可能参加工作坊，不过参与在社区间差异明显。
B
Workshop attendance was associated with schedule flexibility, but the pattern was not uniform across local areas, and the sentence does not establish why those differences arose.
工作坊出席与时间灵活相关，但本地各区模式不一致，该句没有说明差异为何出现。
A
That version preserves the relationship and qualification; now explain the idea aloud without looking at either sentence to test whether you understand it independently.
这个版本保留关系和限定；现在不看两句口头解释，检验是否独立理解。
B
I would finish by naming one conclusion the sentence permits and one it does not, making the boundary of the evidence part of the summary itself.
最后说出一句它允许的结论和一句不允许的结论，让证据边界成为摘要的一部分。

practice.speaking: 读前八行后合上文本，用一分钟总结报告发现。必须保留线路范围、时间关系和乘客原出行方式三项信息。
practice.writing: 写 160 词摘要与评议，仅根据本课虚构交通段落。前半客观改写发现，后半列两个尚不能回答的问题，清楚区分资料与推断。

listening.question: 为什么全市公交使用增加不是忠实摘要？
listening.answer: 原文只谈几条郊区线路；该摘要扩大范围，并把发生先后强化成已证明因果。

practice.review: 逐一圈出摘要的数量词、时间词和情态词；与原文核对，至少识别一次未提及而非矛盾的情形。

title: 听出礼貌背后的保留
scene: 听取两位组织者讨论会议场地的真实态度
objective: 依据语气功能与后续理由推断态度，区分承认与赞同
grammar: 委婉表达；条件语气；but 后信息权重

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The rooftop venue certainly has impressive views, and I can see why the committee liked it during the afternoon tour last week.
屋顶场地景观确实好，我理解委员会为何上周下午参观时喜欢它。
B
You sound less convinced than the photographs might suggest; is there something about the practical arrangements that we have not fully considered yet?
听起来你不像照片暗示的那么信服；实际安排有什么我们尚未充分考虑的吗？
A
My concern is the single elevator, particularly because several guests will arrive together and the registration desk is planned for the upper floor.
我担心只有一部电梯，尤其几位嘉宾会同时到达，而登记台计划设在楼上。
B
The manager said queues are usually short, although the previous event she described had fewer attendees and no simultaneous arrival of several large groups.
经理说队通常短，不过她提到的前次活动人数较少，也没有几组人同时抵达。
A
I would be more comfortable proceeding if we saw an arrival plan that addressed that difference rather than relying on the venue's general reassurance.
如果能看到针对这一差异的抵达方案，而非只依赖场地方笼统保证，我会更放心推进。
B
So you are not rejecting the venue outright; your support depends on resolving a specific access issue before we commit to the final booking.
所以你没有完全否定场地；支持取决于最终预订前解决具体进入问题。
A
Exactly, and the alternative hall is less memorable visually, but its ground-level entrance and separate registration area would make the logistics considerably easier.
正是，另一大厅外观不那么难忘，但地面入口和独立登记区会让组织安排容易很多。
B
We should ask both venues for detailed arrival arrangements, then compare the options using the same expected attendance rather than their own preferred examples.
应向两个场地索取详细抵达安排，再按同一预期人数比较，而非各自偏爱的例子。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
In the opening remark, praise functions as an acknowledgment before disagreement, so treating impressive views as proof of enthusiasm would miss the speaker's overall position.
开场称赞是在分歧前作承认，因此把景观好视为热情支持会错过整体立场。
B
The conditional phrase about being more comfortable identifies what would change that position, providing stronger evidence than a single positive adjective near the beginning.
关于更放心的条件句说明什么会改变立场，比开头一个正面形容词证据更强。
A
I also noticed that the speaker never claims the elevator is unsafe; the concern is capacity and the inconvenience of many people arriving at once.
我还注意说话者未称电梯不安全；担心的是容量及多人同时到达的不便。
B
That distinction prevents an inference from becoming an accusation, because a plausible concern must still remain within the limits of what the conversation actually supports.
这可防止推断变为指控，因为合理担忧仍须限于对话实际支持范围。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Now imagine a colleague says a proposal is ambitious, then asks whether the team has enough staff; what attitude would you tentatively infer from that sequence?
设想同事称方案有雄心，然后问团队人员是否足够，你会从这顺序暂作何态度推断？
B
I would infer cautious interest with reservations about feasibility, while listening for later comments that might show whether the concern is minor or decisive.
我会推断谨慎感兴趣但保留可行性疑虑，同时继续听以判断疑虑是轻微还是决定性。
A
A useful listening note would record both the positive feature and the unresolved condition, rather than reducing the person's view to a simple yes or no.
有用笔记会同时记录优点和未解决条件，而非把观点简化为赞成或反对。
B
After listening, justify your interpretation with two specific cues and explain one stronger conclusion that those cues would not reasonably support without further evidence.
听后用两个具体线索证明解释，并说明缺少进一步证据时这些线索无法支持的更强结论。

practice.speaking: 先只听前八行两遍，给出 A 的立场、改变立场的条件及两处证据；然后讨论你会选择哪个场地。
practice.writing: 写 180 词内部会议摘要，区分场地优点、实际担忧、未获证明的风险和下一步行动，避免把委婉保留写成坚决否决。

listening.question: A 的主要态度是热情赞同、完全反对还是有条件支持？为什么？
listening.answer: 有条件支持；承认景观好，但要求先看到解决集中抵达和电梯容量问题的方案。
