practice.review: 核对推断有两处语言证据；不得把容量顾虑升级成安全问题；关掉文本后仍能说出条件。

title: 两篇文章的分歧究竟在哪
scene: 读者比较关于城市图书馆的两份虚构评论
objective: 识别作者价值排序与证据差异，综合而不抹平分歧
grammar: 对比衔接；报道动词 argues / concedes / questions

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The first commentary argues that libraries should prioritize quiet study because students without suitable space at home depend on them for concentrated work.
第一篇评论认为图书馆应优先安静自习，因为家中无合适空间的学生依赖那里专注工作。
B
The second emphasizes community events and digital assistance, claiming that libraries remain relevant by serving people whose needs extend beyond borrowing books or studying alone.
第二篇强调社区活动和数字帮助，认为图书馆通过服务借书或独学之外的需求保持相关性。
A
At first they seem to disagree about whether libraries matter, but both actually assume that these institutions provide a valuable public service.
初看似乎争图书馆是否重要，但两者实际上都假定机构提供有价值公共服务。
B
Their disagreement concerns which functions should receive priority when space and staff are limited, so the conflict is partly about values and resource allocation.
分歧在空间和人员有限时哪些功能优先，所以冲突部分关乎价值和资源分配。
A
The first author concedes that events can attract new users, yet worries that noisy programming displaces people who have few alternative places to study.
第一作者承认活动吸引新用户，却担心嘈杂活动挤走没有其他自习空间的人。
B
The second acknowledges the need for quiet zones but questions whether an institution should organize its entire identity around one group of existing users.
第二作者承认安静区必要，但质疑机构是否应围绕某一既有用户群定义全部身份。
A
So neither position is absolute, and quoting only the opening claim would hide concessions that make the arguments more nuanced than the headlines suggest.
所以双方都非绝对立场，只引开篇主张会隐藏让论证比标题更细致的让步。
B
A synthesis should preserve that nuance while identifying a practical question: can design and scheduling reduce the conflict without assuming that every demand can be satisfied simultaneously?
综合应保留细致差别，并提出实际问题：设计与排期能否减冲突，同时不假定所有需求可同时满足？

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
We could distinguish disputes about consequences from disputes about priorities, because evidence about noise may inform the first without settling the second on its own.
可区分后果争议与优先级争议，因为噪音证据能帮助前者，却无法独自解决后者。
B
If soundproof rooms are unaffordable, the remaining choice still requires a judgment about whose needs are most urgent and what alternatives those users can realistically access.
若隔音房负担不起，仍需判断谁需求最急及各用户现实中可获得什么替代。
A
The writers' examples should also be examined for representativeness, since a successful flagship library may offer little guidance to a small branch with one shared room.
也应检查作者例子的代表性，因为成功旗舰馆未必能指导只有一间共享室的小分馆。
B
That does not make the example useless; it means its relevance depends on whether the features that enabled success are present in the setting being discussed.
这不使例子无用，而是说明相关性取决于促成成功的特征是否也存在于讨论情境。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Now compare two arguments about public parks: one prioritizes sports facilities, while the other emphasizes wildlife habitat and undisturbed space for ecological recovery.
现在比较公园两论：一方优先运动设施，另一方强调野生栖息地和不受干扰的生态恢复空间。
B
I would identify shared commitments first, then examine competing uses, the evidence for their benefits, and any compromise whose costs are distributed unevenly across different groups.
我会先找共同承诺，再检查竞争用途、收益证据以及成本分配不均的妥协。
A
A fair summary should make each position recognizable to its author, even when my final judgment favors one approach under the specific constraints given.
公平摘要应让各作者认得自己的立场，即使我在给定约束下最终偏向某一方法。
B
The strongest integration may therefore retain a genuine disagreement, explaining why it persists rather than forcing different priorities into an artificially harmonious conclusion.
因此最强综合可能保留真实分歧，解释其为何持续，而非将不同优先事项强塞进人为和谐结论。

practice.speaking: 分别用 40 秒准确呈现两位作者最强观点，再用一分钟说明真正分歧及一个需要补充的数据。
practice.writing: 写 220 词综合评议，只依据本课两篇虚构评论的摘要。包括共同点、两方让步、核心冲突和你的有条件判断。

listening.question: 为什么测量噪音仍不能自动决定图书馆该优先什么？
listening.answer: 噪音数据能说明后果，但资源有限时谁应优先仍包含价值判断和替代条件。

practice.review: 摘要双方均有准确让步；明确区分经验性问题与价值排序；不得强行声称双方已一致。

title: 听力里的数字修正与任务限制
scene: 学生听实验室参观的行程变更
objective: 追踪修正后的最终信息，区分原因与安排
grammar: 自我修正标记；时间与数量单位；间接转述

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The laboratory visit was originally scheduled for Thursday morning, but maintenance has moved our session to Friday afternoon, starting at two fifteen.
实验室参观原定周四上午，但维护使场次移到周五下午两点十五。
B
I had written down two thirty from the earlier email; should everyone arrive at two fifteen, or is that when the actual demonstration begins?
我从之前邮件记成两点半；所有人两点十五到，还是那时演示开始？
A
The demonstration begins at two fifteen, so participants should check in by two o'clock at the east entrance beside the bicycle racks.
演示两点十五开始，所以参与者应两点前在自行车架旁东入口签到。
B
That differs from the visitor center mentioned previously; I will make the entrance change prominent so nobody waits at the wrong building.
这与此前游客中心不同；我会突出入口变更，免得有人在错误建筑等候。
A
We have space for eighteen students, although the room technically holds twenty-four; the smaller limit ensures everyone can see the equipment without crowding the workstations.
学生名额十八，虽然房间技术上容纳二十四；小限额确保人人看清设备而不挤工作台。
B
Does the booking include transport, or should students arrange their own journey and keep the receipt if they expect reimbursement afterward?
预订含交通吗，还是学生自行安排，想报销就保存票据？
A
They should travel independently, and reimbursement covers local bus fares only; taxi costs are excluded unless special arrangements have been approved beforehand.
须自行前往，报销仅限本地公交；出租车除非事先特批，否则不报。
B
I will summarize the final arrangements in separate fields for date, check-in time, entrance, capacity, and transport, keeping superseded details out of the confirmation.
我会按日期、签到时间、入口、容量和交通分栏总结，把已被替代细节从确认信息删去。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
The key listening challenge is not remembering every number but connecting each one to its function and noticing which information the speaker corrects or limits.
听力关键不是记住每个数字，而是联系其用途，并注意说话者修正或限定哪些信息。
B
For instance, twenty-four describes the room's physical capacity, whereas eighteen is the actual participant limit, so choosing the larger number would ignore the task's wording.
例如二十四是房间物理容量，十八是实际参与限额，选大数字就忽视题目用词。
A
Similarly, two o'clock and two fifteen are both valid times, but they answer different questions about arrival and the beginning of the demonstration.
同样两点和两点十五都有效，但分别回答到达和演示开始的不同问题。
B
I should therefore predict the type of information required before listening, then verify the exact relationship rather than copying the first matching number I hear.
因此听前应预测所需信息类型，再核对确切关系，而非抄第一个匹配数字。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
For a new recording, imagine a tour costing twelve dollars for adults but eight for enrolled students, with equipment rental charged separately at three dollars.
设想新录音中成人游览十二美元，在读学生八美元，设备租赁另收三美元。
B
If the question asks what a student pays including equipment, the answer is eleven dollars, provided the recording gives no additional discount or mandatory charge.
若问含设备的学生总价，答案十一美元，前提是录音无额外折扣或强制费用。
A
After answering, I would check spelling, plural forms, and any word or number limit stated in the instructions, because accurate listening can still produce an invalid response.
答后检查拼写、复数和题目字数数字限制，因为听懂仍可能写出无效答案。
B
Finally, I would retell the arrangements aloud in my own words, which tests whether my notes represent an integrated plan rather than disconnected fragments of information.
最后用自己的话口述安排，检验笔记是否呈现完整计划，而非零散信息。

practice.speaking: 隐藏文本听前八行，记录最终日期、签到时间、开始时间、入口、名额和报销范围，再用 60 秒给同学转述。
practice.writing: 写 150 词参观通知，仅采用最终有效信息。说明旧邮件已变更的两点、学生该做什么，以及交通报销限制。

listening.question: 为什么十八与二十四都出现，但通知中的学生名额应写十八？
listening.answer: 二十四是房间物理容量；为看清设备与避免拥挤，实际学生限额为十八。

practice.review: 六项信息全部正确，且没有混淆签到和开始时间；自己设置一次听写题并明确字数限制。

title: 从材料到独立判断
scene: 综合两份虚构远程办公材料形成建议
objective: 整合不同证据而不强行合并指标，进行有依据的迁移
grammar: 来源标记；比较限定；总结中保留不确定性

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The employee survey reports greater satisfaction with remote work, while the manager interviews describe difficulties mentoring new recruits who rarely meet experienced colleagues in person.
员工调查报告远程工作满意度更高，经理访谈则描述新员工很少见资深同事时指导困难。
B
Those findings are not necessarily contradictory because they address different outcomes and may reflect the experiences of different groups within the same organization.
这些发现不必矛盾，因为涉及不同结果，也可能反映同组织不同群体体验。
A
The survey includes established staff who chose remote schedules, whereas the interviews focus mainly on teams that hired several people during the previous year.
调查包括自选远程时间的老员工，而访谈主要聚焦去年招过几人的团队。
B
Then selection and experience could explain part of the difference, so a simple average across the two sources would not produce a meaningful overall verdict.
那么选择和经验可能解释部分差异，所以把两个来源简单平均不会产生有意义总判断。
A
A useful recommendation might preserve flexibility for independent tasks while creating predictable opportunities for feedback, observation, and informal questions among newer colleagues.
有用建议可保留独立任务灵活性，同时给新人建立可预测的反馈、观察与非正式提问机会。
B
It should not assume that physical presence automatically creates good mentoring; an office full of unavailable supervisors could reproduce the same problem in a different location.
不能假定在场自动带来好指导；办公室全是没空的主管，也可在另一地点复制相同问题。
A
We could propose scheduled collaboration days with specific mentoring activities, then compare new employees' progress with their experience under the previous arrangement.
可提议固定协作日加具体指导活动，再比较新员工进步与此前安排下的体验。
B
And we should monitor commuting costs and concentration time, so an improvement in support does not hide burdens that fall disproportionately on certain employees.
也应监测通勤成本与专注时间，避免支持改善掩盖某些员工承担的不成比例负担。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
The synthesis therefore leads to a conditional recommendation, whose strength depends on the quality of evidence and whose details respond to the mechanism identified in both sources.
综合因此导向有条件建议：力度取决于证据质量，细节回应两来源所识别机制。
B
When presenting it orally, name the source before the claim if confusion is likely, allowing listeners to distinguish reported findings from your own interpretation or proposal.
口头呈现若可能混淆，应先说来源再说主张，让听者区分报告发现与你的解释或提案。
A
For example, the interviews suggest a mentoring gap is more accurate than remote work prevents learning, because the latter converts a limited observation into a universal causal statement.
例如访谈暗示指导缺口比远程妨碍学习更准，因为后者把有限观察变成普遍因果陈述。
B
The final paragraph should state what additional evidence could alter the recommendation, demonstrating that the judgment remains responsive rather than fixed regardless of future outcomes.
末段应说明哪些额外证据可改变建议，表明判断随证据回应，而非无论未来结果都不变。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Now apply this method to a school considering recorded lectures, where one source emphasizes flexible access and another reports lower participation in live discussion sessions.
现在用于考虑录播课的学校：一个来源强调灵活访问，另一个报告现场讨论参与降低。
B
I would ask whether the same students appear in both sources, how participation is measured, and whether flexible access benefits learners whose circumstances prevent regular attendance.
我会问两个来源是否同批学生、如何测参与，以及灵活访问是否帮助无法规律出席的学生。
A
The proposal might combine recordings with purposeful discussion tasks, but its success would need evaluation through learning and inclusion rather than the popularity of either format alone.
方案可结合录像与有目的讨论，但成功需按学习和包容评估，而非仅看哪种形式受欢迎。
B
A strong integrated response acknowledges tension, explains its possible sources, and offers a testable next step without claiming that careful synthesis eliminates every uncertainty in the evidence.
有力综合承认张力、解释可能来源并给可检验下一步，而不声称细心综合消除了全部证据不确定性。

practice.speaking: 做三分钟综合陈述：准确概括两来源、解释为何不矛盾、提出可检验安排，最后说出什么结果会使你改变建议。
practice.writing: 写 250 词 Task 2：部分人认为远程工作应成为默认方式，另一些人认为固定办公室合作不可替代。讨论双方并给出观点，可借用本课假设情境但不伪称真实研究。

listening.question: 员工满意度提高与新人指导困难为何可能同时成立？
listening.answer: 两来源衡量不同结果且覆盖不同群体；老员工满意并不代表新员工指导需求得到满足。

practice.review: 整合发言中至少三次区分资料、推断和建议；两来源均准确，不把满意度当学习或生产率。

title: 滨水社区防洪方案听证
scene: 居民代表比较防洪墙与迁居支持方案
objective: 综合数字、利益分配和不确定性形成可辩护建议
grammar: 条件推论；成本比较；让步后限定判断

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The waterfront council is comparing a floodwall with a voluntary relocation program, and residents want to understand what each option would protect or change.
滨水委员会比较防洪墙与自愿迁居计划，居民想知道各选项保护或改变什么。
B
For this hypothetical exercise, the wall costs twelve million dollars initially, while relocation support costs eight million and covers two hundred eligible households.
在此假设练习中，墙初始成本一千二百万美元，迁居支持八百万，覆盖两百户合格家庭。
A
The wall would protect the existing neighborhood against the specified design flood, but the briefing does not claim protection against every possible future event.
墙可保护现有社区抵御设计标准洪水，但简报没有声称可防所有未来事件。
B
Relocation reduces exposure for participating households, although it could disrupt social networks and does not automatically provide suitable housing near jobs or schools.
迁居减少参与家庭暴露，不过可能破坏社会网络，也不自动提供靠近工作学校的合适住房。
A
Some residents favor staying because their businesses depend on the waterfront, while others would prefer assistance moving before another emergency forces a rushed departure.
有居民因生意依赖滨水地而想留下，另一些想在下次紧急情况迫使仓促离开前获搬迁帮助。
B
A single average preference would conceal that variation, so consultation should identify different needs without assuming that property owners and renters face identical choices.
单一平均偏好会掩盖差异，所以咨询应识别不同需求，不能假定业主与租客选择相同。
A
The wall also requires annual maintenance of three hundred thousand dollars, whereas the relocation estimate excludes the cost of improving receiving neighborhoods' public services.
墙每年还需三十万美元维护，而迁居估算不含改善接收社区公共服务的成本。
B
Then the headline price comparison is incomplete, and we should request a consistent time horizon and clearly defined cost categories before calling either option cheaper overall.
那么表面价格比较不完整，应先要求统一时间跨度和成本类别，再称哪项总体更便宜。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
A defensible recommendation must distinguish financial estimates from distributional judgments, since the least expensive scheme may impose the greatest losses on residents with few alternatives.
可辩护建议须区分财务估算与分配判断，因为最便宜方案可能让选择最少居民受损最多。
B
The decision also involves residual risk, so public communication should explain what remains unprotected instead of treating a construction standard as a guarantee of permanent safety.
决定也涉及剩余风险，所以公共沟通应解释什么未受保护，而非把建设标准当永久安全保证。
A
I would support a phased approach that investigates both options further, while offering immediate assistance to households whose present circumstances make delay particularly costly or disruptive.
我支持继续调查两方案的分阶段方式，同时立即帮助处境使延误格外昂贵或扰乱生活的家庭。
B
That is reasonable only if the investigation has a deadline, because an open-ended process could become a way to postpone difficult choices while residents remain exposed.
只有调查有期限才合理，因为无限流程可能变成拖延困难选择，同时居民仍暴露于风险。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
For your hearing statement, identify one option you provisionally favor, the assumptions behind that preference, and two missing facts that could lead you to revise it.
听证陈述需指出暂时偏好的选项、偏好背后假设，以及可能使你修订判断的两个缺失事实。
B
I would also explain how affected residents participate in the decision, particularly those whose voices may be absent from meetings held during standard working hours.
还应解释受影响居民如何参与，尤其标准工作时间开会时可能缺席的群体。
A

The written comparison should report the supplied figures accurately, while keeping unpriced consequences visible through clear descriptions rather than assigning invented monetary values to social ties.
书面比较应准确报告数字，同时清楚描述未定价后果，而非给社会关系编造金额。
B
This case tests whether you can combine precise description with a qualified judgment, then defend that judgment when an interviewer changes one important assumption in the scenario.
此案检验能否结合精确描述与限定判断，并在采访者改变关键假设时为判断辩护。

practice.speaking: 进行三分钟听证陈述，选择暂定方案，引用所有相关成本与覆盖信息。随后自问：若维护成本翻倍，你会如何调整判断？
practice.writing: Task 1，至少 150 词，20 分钟。比较虚构方案表：防洪墙初始1200万美元、年维护30万美元、保护现有社区应对设计标准洪水；迁居初始800万美元、支持200户、接收地公共服务增支未计入。准确报告已知差异，不计算未给期限的总成本。

listening.question: 为何不能只凭 1200 万与 800 万就断定迁居总成本更低？
listening.answer: 两估计范围不同；墙有年度维护，迁居未计接收地公共服务，且缺统一时间跨度。

practice.review: 数字和范围无误；口语有暂定立场、两个缺失事实和反事实回应；写作不虚构总费用。

title: 大学作业中的人工智能规则
scene: 大学委员会讨论如何评估学生独立能力
objective: 整合伦理、教育和执行证据，设计可评估政策
grammar: 原则与例外；目的从句；反驳与再限定

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
Our department permits digital writing assistants, but several instructors worry that polished submissions no longer reveal what students can explain or produce independently.
院系允许数字写作助手，但一些教师担心精美作业不再显示学生能独立解释或产出什么。
B
A blanket ban might appear straightforward, yet enforcement would be difficult and could obscure legitimate uses such as brainstorming, accessibility support, or language feedback.
全面禁令看似简单，但难执行，还可能遮蔽构思、无障碍支持和语言反馈等合理用途。
A
Then the policy should begin with the learning objective, distinguishing tasks that assess independent composition from those that evaluate editing, collaboration, or critical judgment.
政策应从学习目标开始，区分评估独立写作的任务与评估编辑、协作或批判判断的任务。
B
For an independent writing assessment, supervised drafting may be appropriate, whereas a research project could require students to document how they used assistance and evaluated its suggestions.
独立写作测评可适合监督起草，而研究项目可要求记录如何使用辅助并评估建议。
A
Some instructors propose oral follow-ups, asking students to explain a central claim and respond to a new objection after submitting the written assignment.
一些教师提议提交书面作业后口头追问，让学生解释核心主张并回应新反对意见。
B
That could reveal understanding, although we should consider whether anxiety or language-processing differences make a brief oral performance an imperfect measure for some students.
这可显示理解，不过应考虑焦虑或语言处理差异是否让短口述对一些学生衡量不完美。
A
Offering several forms of verification might help, provided each one tests the same underlying competence and does not create an excessive workload for staff.
提供几种验证形式可能有帮助，前提是都测同一基础能力，且不过度加重教师工作。
B
We also need consistent guidance across courses, because students cannot make responsible choices if one instructor encourages a practice that another treats as misconduct without warning.
还需课程间一致指导，因为若一位鼓励、另一位不预告就认定违规，学生无法负责选择。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
The distinction is between assessing a process and merely judging a finished product, especially when external tools can improve surface quality without strengthening the author's reasoning.
区别在评估过程与只判成品，尤其外部工具可改善表面质量而未增强作者推理时。
B
However, requiring exhaustive logs would create another problem if documenting every minor correction consumes time that should be spent developing and testing substantive ideas.
但要求详尽日志也有问题，如果记录每次小改占用本应用于发展和检验实质思想的时间。
A
A proportionate record could focus on consequential decisions, such as accepting a suggested argument, changing an interpretation, or verifying a factual claim introduced by the tool.
相称记录可聚焦重大决定，例如接受建议论点、改变解释或核实工具引入事实。
B
The policy should be reviewed against evidence of learning and fairness, with students able to question inconsistent decisions through a clear and accessible process.
政策应依学习与公平证据复查，且学生能通过清晰可达流程质疑不一致决定。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
In your committee speech, defend a policy for one concrete assessment and explain why applying the identical rule to every course would be inappropriate.
委员会发言需为一种具体测评辩护，并解释为何所有课用完全相同规则不合适。
B
Then respond to a parent who believes any assistance makes the result meaningless, acknowledging the concern while distinguishing supported learning from misrepresenting independent performance.
再回应认为任何辅助都让结果无意义的家长，承认担忧并区分辅助学习与虚假呈现独立表现。
A
Your written argument should discuss implementation costs alongside educational principles, because a policy that cannot be applied consistently may undermine the fairness it claims to protect.
书面论证应同时讨论执行成本和教育原则，因为无法一致应用的政策会削弱其声称保护的公平。
B
Finish by specifying what students must demonstrate without assistance and how that requirement connects to the capability the course promises to develop by its conclusion.
最后明确学生必须无辅助展示什么，以及要求如何连接课程结束时承诺培养的能力。

practice.speaking: 两分钟陈述你对一门大学课程的 AI 辅助规则，再用一分钟回应全面禁止与完全开放两种反对立场。
practice.writing: Task 2，至少 250 词，40 分钟：一些人认为大学应禁止学生使用人工智能完成作业，另一些人认为大学应教授负责任的使用方式。讨论双方并给出观点。

listening.question: 为什么口头追问也不能被视为完美验证方式？
listening.answer: 焦虑、语言处理差异等可能影响短时口头表现，因此不能简单等同于真实理解。

practice.review: 立场始终清楚；明确独立能力、辅助范围、验证和申诉；论据含具体机制，不编造作弊率。

title: 清洁能源项目与土地使用
scene: 地方论坛比较三种虚构能源方案
objective: 比较多维数据，避免不同单位之间的无意义排名
grammar: 比较与限定；让步；数据来源和预测措辞

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The county is evaluating three proposed energy projects, and the public briefing compares annual output, land requirements, and expected construction time for each option.
县里评估三个拟议能源项目，公开简报比较各项年产出、用地和预计建设时间。
B
In this fictional dataset, the wind project produces ninety gigawatt-hours annually, requires twenty hectares of exclusive-use land, and takes eighteen months to build.
虚构数据中，风能年产九十吉瓦时，需二十公顷专用地，建设十八个月。
A
The solar option produces sixty gigawatt-hours, occupies fifty hectares, and takes twelve months, while the rooftop program produces thirty with no additional land and takes twenty-four months.
太阳能产六十吉瓦时、占五十公顷、建十二个月；屋顶项目产三十、不新增土地、需二十四个月。
B
Those figures do not establish a single winner because output, land use, and speed measure different aspects of the decision that communities may value differently.
这些数字不能确定单一赢家，因为产出、用地和速度衡量不同方面，社区可能赋予不同价值。
A
The wind estimate counts only land reserved exclusively for equipment, so we should not describe it as the entire area within the project's wider boundary.
风能估算只计设备专用土地，因此不能称其为项目更广边界内全部面积。
B
Likewise, no additional land does not mean no physical infrastructure; the rooftop program still requires suitable buildings, installation work, and agreements with property owners.
同样，不新增土地不等于没有实体设施；屋顶项目仍需合适建筑、安装与业主协议。
A
Residents near the proposed solar field worry about losing productive farmland, whereas others emphasize that the shorter build could deliver benefits sooner than either alternative.
太阳能拟建地附近居民担心丧失耕地，其他人则强调较短工期可更早带来收益。
B
We need further information about site quality and connection costs, since the table alone cannot determine whether those concerns outweigh the projected advantages of the project.
需更多场地质量与接入成本信息，因为仅凭表无法决定担忧是否超过预测优势。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
A useful overview would state that wind has the greatest expected output, solar the shortest construction period, and rooftops the lowest additional land requirement.
有用概述应说风能预期产出最大、太阳能工期最短、屋顶新增用地最少。
B
That overview preserves the trade-offs instead of combining unlike measures into an unexplained score whose weighting could silently favor one proposal over the others.
这种概述保留取舍，而非把不同指标合成未经解释、权重可能暗中偏向某方案的总分。
A
When discussing reliability, I should avoid inferring a continuous supply from an annual total, because the dataset says nothing about variation across hours or seasons.
讨论可靠性时不能从年总量推断持续供电，因为数据未说明小时或季节变化。
B
Exactly; identify the missing information and explain why it matters, rather than filling the gap with assumptions that make the preferred technology seem automatically superior.
正是；指出缺失信息及其重要性，而非用假设填补空白，让偏爱技术自动显得更优。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
Your public statement should recommend a next step under a clearly stated priority, such as minimizing new land use or meeting a particular completion deadline.
公共陈述应在明确优先事项下建议下一步，例如减少新增土地或满足特定竣工期限。
B
Then test your recommendation against a changed constraint: if completion within eighteen months becomes mandatory, the rooftop program would not meet the stated schedule without revision.
再按新约束检验：若必须十八个月内完工，屋顶项目不调整就无法满足既定时间。
A
The argument should also distinguish rejecting a proposal entirely from sequencing several projects, since a slower option may still contribute to a longer-term strategy.
也应区分彻底拒绝方案与为多项目排先后，因为慢方案仍可贡献长期战略。
B
Conclude with the evidence you would request before approval, making clear which judgments the existing figures support and which require information beyond the supplied comparison.
以批准前所需证据作结，明确哪些判断现有数字支持，哪些需要比较表之外的信息。

practice.speaking: 完成两分钟数据简报，先概述三项不同优势，再在新增土地最少与十八月内完工两种优先条件下分别建议。
practice.writing: Task 1，至少 150 词。虚构预计方案表：风能年产90吉瓦时、专用地20公顷、建设18月；地面太阳能60吉瓦时、50公顷、12月；屋顶太阳能30吉瓦时、不新增土地、24月。概述比较，风能土地仅为专用面积。

listening.question: 为什么年产能最大不能证明供电最稳定？
listening.answer: 年总量没有给出小时或季节波动，也未提供储能等可靠性信息。

practice.review: 九项数据与单位准确；不将专用地误当全部范围；口头建议随条件改变且理由明确。

title: 博物馆藏品归还的公共讨论
scene: 策展人与来源社区代表讨论一组历史藏品
objective: 公平复述文化争议，区分证据、价值与可执行协议
grammar: 让步论证；假设与事实分离；复杂名词从句

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The museum holds a collection acquired during a colonial administration, and representatives of the source community have requested its return along with access to the surviving records.
博物馆持有殖民管理时期获得的一组藏品，来源社区代表要求归还并访问留存记录。
B
The curator emphasizes preservation and public access, but those benefits do not by themselves resolve questions about how the objects were obtained or who should decide their future.
策展人强调保护和公众访问，但这些益处本身不能解决物品如何取得及谁决定其未来。
A
Some documents describe a purchase, although the community argues that the transaction occurred under conditions in which meaningful refusal may not have been possible.
一些文件记为购买，不过社区认为交易环境可能不允许有意义的拒绝。
B
Then the acquisition record is relevant evidence, but interpreting it requires attention to the surrounding power relations rather than assuming the written label settles the issue.
取得记录是相关证据，但解释需关注周边权力关系，不能假定书面标签已解决争议。
A
The museum proposes a long-term loan, which would allow display in the community while retaining formal ownership at the institution that currently holds the collection.
博物馆提议长期借展，让社区展出，同时由当前保管机构保留正式所有权。
B
That may improve access, yet it could leave the central disagreement untouched if the request concerns authority and recognition rather than simply the location of the objects.
这可改善访问，但若请求关乎决定权和承认而非单纯所在地，核心分歧仍未解决。
A
Could a joint research project establish a fuller history before a final decision, or would another investigation risk delaying a request that has already been pending for years?
共同研究能否先建立更完整历史再决定，还是再次调查会拖延已悬而未决多年的请求？
B
Research would be useful if both parties shape its questions and agree on a timetable, with disclosure of existing records proceeding without unnecessary delay.
若双方决定问题并约定时间表，研究会有用；现有记录披露应无不必要延迟地进行。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A

The strongest argument for continued museum custody should be considered seriously, but conservation expertise should not automatically confer permanent authority over another community's cultural heritage.
应认真考虑继续馆藏的最强理由，但保护专业知识不应自动赋予对他群体文化遗产的永久决定权。
B
Conversely, a return agreement should address practical arrangements openly, including transport, care, and future public access, without using those questions as excuses for indefinite postponement.
反之，归还协议应公开处理运输、照护和未来公众访问等安排，不将其当无限延期借口。
A

A precise discussion distinguishes legal claims, ethical judgments, and negotiated solutions, recognizing that each may require different evidence and may not lead automatically to the same conclusion.
精确讨论区分法律主张、伦理判断和协商方案，承认它们需不同证据，也未必自动同结论。
B
Since this exercise supplies no applicable law, we should avoid announcing a legal entitlement and instead explain the principles that would guide a fair decision-making process.
本练习未给适用法律，所以应避免宣布法定权利，而应解释公平决策流程的指导原则。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
For your mediation statement, summarize each side's strongest concern in terms its representatives would recognize before proposing a sequence of actions with a clear decision point.
调解陈述先用双方认可的语言概括最强关切，再提出带明确决策点的行动顺序。
B
Then answer a challenge that public access would decline after return, separating an assumption about likely visitor numbers from the broader question of whose access currently matters most.
再回应归还后公众访问下降的质疑，区分访客数假设与目前谁的访问最重要这一更广问题。
A
The final essay should use the hypothetical case to develop reasoning, without presenting disputed historical details as verified facts about a real institution or community.
最终作文应以假设案发展推理，不把有争议历史细节当成某真实机构或社区的已核实事实。
B

Your conclusion can remain conditional while being decisive about process: disclose evidence, include affected communities, and prevent practical discussion from becoming an indefinite substitute for a decision.
结论可有条件，但流程立场明确：披露证据、纳入社区，并防止实际安排讨论无限替代决定。

practice.speaking: 模拟三分钟调解陈述：双方最强观点各 40 秒，余下提出行动顺序。接受追问：借展是否足以解决所有争议？
practice.writing: Task 2，至少 250 词：一些人认为大型博物馆应保留来自其他地区的历史藏品以供广泛公众观赏，另一些人认为应归还来源社区。讨论双方并给出观点；用假设例子，勿编造法律。

listening.question: 为什么长期借展可能仍未回应社区核心请求？
listening.answer: 借展改变所在地和访问条件，却保留原所有权；社区也可能关注决定权和历史承认。

practice.review: 公平呈现双方，清楚区分伦理与法律；提出确定时间点而非无限调查；不将假设当史实。

title: 食堂减废项目的最终评估
scene: 完成带数据的阅读、听力、口语与写作综合任务
objective: 独立整合多源证据，限时表达并制定后续能力目标
grammar: 过去比较；因果限定；证据驱动结论与自我修订

sections.title: 情境对话
rows: A
The campus cafeteria reduced recorded food waste after introducing smaller default portions, but student feedback suggests that satisfaction varied across different meal choices and dietary needs.
校园食堂改默认小份后记录的浪费减少，但反馈显示满意度因餐食选择和饮食需求不同。
B
The hypothetical monitoring table shows daily waste falling from one hundred twenty kilograms in April to ninety in May and seventy-two in June.
假设监测表显示日浪费四月一百二十公斤、五月九十、六月七十二。
A
Over the same period, daily meals served fell from six hundred to five hundred and then four hundred eighty, so the raw waste total needs context.
同期每日供餐从六百到五百再到四百八十，因此浪费总量需结合背景。
B
Per meal, that is two hundred grams in April, one hundred eighty in May, and one hundred fifty in June, indicating a decline beyond the lower meal count.
每餐四月两百克、五月一百八十、六月一百五十，表明下降不只来自供餐减少。
A
The table still does not prove that portion size caused the improvement, since the menu changed and the examination period altered attendance during the same months.
表仍不证明份量引起改善，因为同期菜单变化，考试期也改变了出席情况。
B
Student interviews add another perspective: some appreciated wasting less, while others wanted a convenient way to request extra food without waiting in line again.
学生访谈提供另一视角：有人喜欢少浪费，有人希望无需重排队就能加餐。
A
Then the next version could retain smaller defaults while allowing quick additional servings, provided the process remains easy for students with different dietary requirements.
下一版可保留小份默认并快速加餐，前提是不同饮食需求学生都容易使用。
B
We should evaluate both waste per meal and the experience of getting enough food, because reducing disposal is not a success if some students regularly leave hungry.
应同时评估每餐浪费和能否吃够，因为若有人常饿着离开，减少丢弃就不算成功。

sections.title: 深入表达
rows: A
For the reading component, distinguish the measured decline from the proposed explanation and identify two details that limit a confident causal interpretation of the results.
阅读部分需区分实测下降与所提解释，并找出限制确定因果解释的两项细节。
B
For listening, close the transcript and summarize the interview contrast, including the condition that would make smaller portions more acceptable to students who need additional food.
听力时关文本，总结访谈反差，包括让需加餐学生更接受小份的条件。
A
For speaking, present a provisional recommendation in two minutes, then respond to a challenge about whether environmental benefits justify additional inconvenience for individual diners.
口语两分钟提出暂定建议，再回应环保收益是否足以支持给用餐者增加不便的质疑。
B
For writing, use the supplied monthly figures accurately, making clear whether each comparison concerns total waste, meal volume, or waste per meal rather than mixing those measures.
写作准确使用月度数字，明确比较总浪费、供餐量还是每餐浪费，不混淆指标。

sections.title: 迁移练习
rows: A
A meaningful final assessment should reveal both strengths and remaining gaps, so evaluate the quality of your reasoning separately from the speed or confidence of delivery.
有意义最终评估应显示优势与不足，所以推理质量应与表达速度或自信分开评估。
B
Review your recordings for clear stress and intelligible phrasing, your writing for developed support, and both for precise vocabulary that fits the intended meaning.
录音检查重音清楚和语块易懂，写作检查论据充分，两者都检查词汇准确贴合意义。
A
Progress toward a high examination score depends on your starting level, practice quality, and performance across all four skills, so this course cannot guarantee a particular result.
向高考试分数进步取决于起点、练习质量和四项技能表现，因此课程不能保证特定成绩。
B
Use the evidence from this capstone to choose the next month of focused practice, prioritizing the weakest demonstrated skill rather than simply repeating the exercises you already enjoy.
用结课任务证据选择下个月针对练习，优先补已展示的最弱技能，而非只重复喜欢的练习。

practice.speaking: 全程录音完成最终模拟。Part 1：Where do you usually eat lunch? Do you enjoy trying unfamiliar food? How have your eating habits changed? Part 2：Describe an improvement you helped make at school, at work, or in your community. Say what needed changing, what you did, who was involved, and explain the result. 准备一分钟，讲一至两分钟。Part 3：How do default options influence what people choose? Should public cafeterias use smaller default portions even if some diners find this inconvenient? Who should take more responsibility for reducing food waste: diners, food providers, or governments? 每题解释理由并举例；回应追问时准确使用本课数字，并承认因果局限。
practice.writing: Task 1，至少 150 词，20 分钟。虚构食堂数据：四月日均供餐600份/浪费120公斤；五月500份/90公斤；六月480份/72公斤。比较总量并可使用正确每餐值200/180/150克。再另用40分钟写至少250词的Task 2：公共食堂应否默认小份并允许免费加餐以减少浪费？给出明确立场。

listening.question: 为什么每餐浪费下降仍不能单独证明小份政策有效？
listening.answer: 菜单和考试期出席同时变化，缺少能排除这些因素的比较，因果归属仍不确定。

practice.review: 完成四技能证据表：阅读主张/推断各两项，听力两种态度及条件，口语四维各一处证据，写作核对数字与论证；据此写下一个月最弱项训练计划，不自保雅思分数。
